  • Increase reliability and scale by reducing manual work: automate onboarding and integration playbooks, standardize test frameworks, and build maintainable backend tooling that keeps pipelines stable.

  • Drive measurable outcomes that accelerate DualEntry’s product velocity and stability

What sets you up for success

  • 8+ years building backend systems, ideally in high-growth, high-ownership environments where you ship fast and own outcomes end-to-end

  • Deep expertise in Python and modern backend frameworks (FastAPI/Flask/Django)

  • Strong database fundamentals: PostgreSQL, SQL, schema design, migrations, ORMs

  • Experience building production-grade APIs

  • Hands-on with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and the full delivery lifecycle: CI/CD, deployments, monitoring and incidents

  • Experience in payments, fintech, or financial services is strongly preferred

  • Familiarity with payment rails and flows (SEPA, ACH, Wires, Faster Payments, CHAPS, Bacs) and payment messaging/file formats (PAIN, CAMT) is a plus.

  • Able to operate in messy, evolving requirements — you design systems that scale while staying pragmatic.

  • Clear communicator (C1+ English). You can collaborate with banks, customers, and teammates across time zones without things slipping.

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • Bonus: you’ve built bank integrations using H2H, SFTP or ISO 20022

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed culture

  • High-trust environment with high expectations

  • Ambitious mission - ERP is one of the largest B2B software markets in the world ($220bn per year), this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to build the next generation ERP in an industry that has not seen new entrants in 30+ years

📍 Location:Remote - this role is available across all countries with 4hr+ overlap for the US ET timezone (NYC HQ)

Benefits & Perks

  • Base Salary: $100K–$175K USD

  • Equity: ~$50K USD

  • Contract type: B2B

  • Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with

  • Time Off: 15 PTO days + 12 public holidays

  • Visa sponsorship option for relocation to NYC within 2+ years

  • Early-stage role with high autonomy and real long-term upside

  • Enjoy a learning & development budget for courses, certifications, and language learning to keep growing your skills

  • Work where you feel most productive at co-working spaces or from your home office with support for setup, internet, and phone

  • Plus, wellness perks and more to make your workday even better!

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a seismic shift like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll do this decade.

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard!

At DualEntry, we believe great products come from diverse teams. We’re an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to a culture where everyone feels included, supported, and able to do their best work.

El/la Especialista en MEL contribuye al diseño, implementación y fortalecimiento de sistemas de Monitoreo, Evaluación y Aprendizaje (MEL) para Soluciones Basadas en la Naturaleza (SbN) y otras estrategias de conservación de TNC Colombia. Integra análisis y modelamiento espacial con información biofísica, climática, social y económica para generar evidencia que apoye la toma de decisiones, el aprendizaje y la gestión adaptativa.


Te estamos buscando:

Buscamos un/a profesional con experiencia en MEL y análisis espacial aplicado a la conservación, capaz de coordinar procesos técnicos, integrar y analizar datos, desarrollar indicadores y herramientas de seguimiento, y comunicar evidencia para apoyar decisiones de proyectos y portafolios. La persona trabajará de manera colaborativa con equipos interdisciplinarios, socios y comunidades, y reportará al Especialista en Ciencias y Adaptación de TNC Colombia.


RESPONSABILIDADES Y ALCANCE

· Coordinar el diseño, la implementación y la mejora continua de sistemas MEL para proyectos y portafolios de SbN, articulando teorías de cambio, preguntas de aprendizaje, marcos de resultados, planes de monitoreo, líneas base, metas, criterios de éxito y mecanismos de retroalimentación para la gestión adaptativa.

· Diseñar, validar y estandarizar indicadores de gestión, producto, resultado e impacto, combinando dimensiones biofísicas, climáticas, sociales, económicas y de gobernanza; establecer fichas técnicas, métodos de cálculo, fuentes, periodicidad, desagregaciones, responsabilidades y criterios de calidad.

Communications Director Job Description

Position: Communications Director

Location: Fully Remote (Some travel)

Reports to: Co-Director

About BLMP

The Black LGBTQIA+ Migrant Project (BLMP) envisions a world where no one is forced to give up their homeland and where all Black LGBTQIA+ people are free and liberated. We build and center the power of Black LGBTQIA+ migrants to ensure the liberation of all Black people through Organizing & Basebuilding, Strategic Communications, and Viability & Sustainability. We are led by a directly impacted steering committee, staff and consultants, and operate organizing networks in New York City, DMV (DC, Maryland and Virginia region), Minneapolis, California, and the South. We build power, community, and knowledge in the U.S., while challenging the role that the U.S. plays globally in creating the conditions that force us to leave our homes.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Co-Director, the Director of Communications will set and guide the strategy for all communications, including digital, and public relations messages and collateral to consistently articulate BLMP’s mission. The Director of Communications will ensure that BLMP is viewed as the primary source, disseminator, and conduit of information within this diverse network and constituent base. The Director of Communications will lead the communications team, in collaboration with other staff members as the communications partner on a variety of strategic initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership: Supervise members of the Communications Team and lead department meetings.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop, implement, and evaluate comprehensive communications plans across the organization's diverse audiences in collaboration with BLMP’s staff team, consultants, members, and partner organizations.
  • Content & Narrative Strategy: Work closely with the Communications Strategist and Digital Organizer to lead the content strategy that engages audience segments, and build/implement narrative strategy in service of Black liberation, Black migrant justice, and abolition of the carceral state.
  • Digital & Web Presence: Mentor and lead the communications team through website administration, coordinating with the Communications Strategist to ensure new and consistent information (article links, stories, and events) are posted regularly.
  • Collateral Management: Manage development, distribution, and maintenance of all print and electronic collateral including, but not limited to, newsletters, brochures, annual reports, and website.
  • Brand & Media Relations: Strengthen BLMP brand and visual identity, create/manage media contact lists, and oversee departmental budget.
  • Rapid Response: Develop rapid response and crisis communication protocols.
  • Movement Building: Represent BLMP in communications-specific movement spaces/coalitions, infusing BLMP’s narrative strategy into the larger movement-wide narrative strategy.

Qualifications

  • Experience: At least 10 years of communications experience, ideally in an “in-house” leadership role within a nonprofit structure, covering areas such as website content, newsletters, and donor communications.
  • Strategy to Execution: Proven ability to take knowledge and transform it into exciting and useful messages, and disseminate it to the right audiences through the best distribution channels.
  • Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to build and incorporate organizational voice across platforms, organize/clearly share information, and stay up to date with ever-changing tools and best practices.
  • Leadership Style: Highly collaborative, mission-aligned relationship builder who welcomes and integrates feedback; a self-starter comfortable with a participatory leadership style.
  • Organization: Highly organized with the ability to manage a variety of deadline-driven initiatives concurrently.
  • Availability: Available to work nights and weekends during moments of urgent response.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Passionate about Black liberation, Black migrant justice, and abolition of the carceral state.
  • Committed to centering and building the leadership of Black migrants and 1st generation Black people who identify as TGNCI, women, femmes, and/or who are living with disabilities.
  • Bilingual.

Salary and Benefits

  • Salary: Competitive, $114,500.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive health (medical, dental, vision, and FSA)

Over one million drivers and 100,000 companies across every industry trust Motive’s integrated platform to power their operations, prevent accidents and reduce costs.

At Motive, we see our hard work rewarded in tangible ways every day, and we believe that intelligence is most powerful when paired with humility. We’re motivated by the opportunity to save lives on the road while impacting and improving every facet of multiple trillion-dollar industries that keep our physical economy moving. Motive is proud to be a Forbes Cloud 100 company, Forbes Best Startup Employer 2020, and an Inc Magazine Best Place to Work.

About the Role:

Motive is looking for an experienced Technical Lead Engineer to join our Global Technical Support organization as an internal technical enablement expert for TSEs.

The TL will help TSEs build the product knowledge, troubleshooting judgment, and investigation discipline needed to resolve issues independently and escalate directly to Backline when required. This role is the hands-on technical support layer for TSEs: when a TSE is stuck, the TL helps identify the next step, explains the technical reasoning, and ensures the TSE learns from the interaction.

The TL will also identify recurring gaps in product knowledge and investigation quality, then turn those gaps into coaching, product documentation, troubleshooting guides, reusable queries, and knowledge-base improvements. The role is internally focused and is not responsible for owning direct customer communication.

What You’ll Do:

  • Assist TSEs with complex or unfamiliar issues when they are unable to identify the next troubleshooting step or resolution path.
  • Review TSE investigations and provide actionable coaching on issue framing, hypothesis development, evidence gathering, testing, and documentation.
  • Build and improve TSE knowledge of Motive products, workflows, system behavior, known limitations, hardware, integrations, and common failure modes.
  • Model structured troubleshooting and teach TSEs how to move from symptoms to evidence-based conclusions.
  • Help TSEs become self-sufficient by guiding them through investigations instead of taking ownership of every issue.
  • Coach TSEs determine whether an issue is caused by configuration, workflow, data, hardware, firmware, integration behavior, expected product behavior, or a potential defect.
  • Review and improve the quality of TSE escalations to Backline, ensuring they include clear reproduction steps, scope, impact, evidence, troubleshooting completed, and a specific task.
  • Coordinate with Backline when technical clarification is needed and help TSEs understand Backline findings, resolutions, and root causes.
  • Create and maintain product-specific troubleshooting guides, known-issue documentation, diagnostic checklists, technical FAQs, and reusable SQL queries or scripts.
  • Identify common TSE blockers and recurring investigation mistakes, then deliver targeted coaching, examples, practice cases, and follow-up validation.
  • Share recurring patterns and documentation gaps with Sr TLs for inclusion in broader enablement plans and knowledge-base priorities.
  • Maintain accurate records of coaching themes and technical gaps so the TL function can measure whether TSE capability is improving.
  • Partner with other TLKs to calibrate coaching approaches and maintain consistent technical guidance across teams and regions.

What We’re Looking For:

  • At least 2 years of experience operating at a Technical Lead, or equivalent senior technical support level, with a strong record of solving complex technical issues and helping other engineers improve.
  • Deep knowledge of Motive products or comparable experience supporting complex SaaS, hardware, fleet, logistics, compliance, safety, or asset-management platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach technical professionals and explain complex product behavior in a clear, practical way.
  • Strong investigation skills using logs, SQL, APIs, DataDog, scripting, configuration analysis, and technical documentation where appropriate.
  • Experience diagnosing issues involving product workflows, data, hardware devices, firmware, integrations, and third-party systems.
  • Ability to review an incomplete investigation, identify the missing evidence or reasoning, and guide the TSE toward the next correct step.
  • Strong understanding of what makes a Backline escalation complete, actionable, and technically credible.
  • Ability to balance immediate assistance with long-term capability building; the goal is to teach TSEs, not create permanent dependency on TLs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for internal coaching, documentation, calibration, and technical discussions with Backline.
  • A technical background in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Fluency in spoken and written English.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across a global Technical Support organization.
  • Permanent employment status with no active warnings or Performance Improvement Plan, consistent with internal eligibility requirements.
  • Produce product documentation, troubleshooting guidance, queries, and knowledge-base content that TSEs actively use.
  • Demonstrate that coaching results in sustained behavior change, not only one-time

About the team

Zillow is strengthening how it manages and learns from production incidents, with greater focus on operational discipline, actionable data, improved tooling, and preventing repeat issues. This role offers the opportunity to directly improve system reliability and reduce customer impact.
The role sits at the intersection of technology, operations, and communication. You will independently manage small- to mid-scale incidents while supporting senior incident managers during complex, high-severity events.

The incident management practice is evolving. You will help improve processes, runbooks, tooling, root-cause analysis, and follow-through—not simply respond to incidents.

About the role

Zillow Group is seeking an Incident Manager (IC) to support the reliability and operational excellence of our production systems. This role coordinates incident response to minimize customer impact and improve system resilience through structured execution and clear communication.

At this level, success in this role is anchored in three core areas - Operational Execution: independently driving incidents to resolution through structured process and sound judgment; Communication: delivering timely, accurate updates to diverse stakeholders; and Information Synthesis: gathering, connecting, and applying data to drive RCA and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Operational Execution

  • Lead non-trivial production incidents from detection through mitigation
  • Facilitate incident calls, defining clear ownership, priorities, and next steps
  • Execute established incident management workflows, runbooks, and escalation paths
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams for timely resolution and minimal customer impact
  • Maintain accurate, real-time documentation of incident timelines and actions

Communication

  • Ensure stakeholder alignment on status, risks, and next steps
  • Document incident summaries and contribute to post-incident reporting
  • Proactively escalate risks and communication gaps early

Information Synthesis & Continuous Improvement

  • Support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) by gathering data and documenting contributing factors
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improving incident workflows
  • Contribute to retrospectives and track follow-up actions to completion
  • Apply lessons learned to enhance future incident response

Coordination & Collaboration

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and Support teams during incident response
  • Support Senior Incident Managers on high-severity or complex incidents
  • Facilitate collaboration and maintain alignment across stakeholders

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain a high standard of reliability and responsiveness in on-call rotations
  • Reinforce structured incident management practices
  • Contribute to the improvement of runbooks, tooling, and team processes

Scope & Impact

  • Owns end-to-end execution of small to mid-scale incidents
  • Contributes to larger, high-severity incidents with guidance
  • Influences improvements within team-level processes and workflows

Job Summary:
We are looking for a Coupa Integration Developer to design, develop, and maintain integrations between Coupa BSM (Business Spend Management) and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on Coupa Integration Cloud, API-based integrations, supplier onboarding flows, and data synchronization between Coupa and ERP, finance, HR, and payment systems. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful Coupa integrations in production, understands the source-to-pay process end-to-end, and applies disciplined integration engineering practices. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

  • Develop integrations supporting requisition, purchase order, invoice, and payment processes.
  • Implement chart-of-accounts, expense category, and lookup data synchronization between Coupa and source systems.
  • Build user, role, and approval-hierarchy synchronization between Coupa and identity systems.
  • Design error handling, retry, and reconciliation strategies for integration flows.
  • Implement integration security across Coupa endpoints, including OAuth flows, SSO patterns, and certificate-based authentication, ensuring that integration credentials follow least-privilege and lifecycle best practices.
  • Profile and optimize integration performance and batch sizing for high-volume scenarios, applying systematic measurement, targeted improvements, and data-driven validation to deliver quantifiable gains in throughput, latency, or resource efficiency.

  • Collaborate with procurement, finance, and IT stakeholders on integration requirements.

  • Stay current with Coupa releases and BSM platform evolution, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of integration engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience integrating Coupa with enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of Coupa Integration Cloud and Coupa Open APIs.
  • Experience with at least one major iPaaS such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Workato.
  • Strong understanding of source-to-pay and procure-to-pay processes.
  • Solid SQL and data transformation skills.
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, and integration security.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Coupa certifications.

About Us:

ChowNow is one of the leading players in off-premise restaurant technology. As takeout becomes a vital revenue stream for independent restaurants, our platform helps owners focus on what they do best—serving great food—by offering solutions across the entire digital dining experience. From building branded websites and mobile apps, to powering online orders, managing menus, consolidating delivery, and running targeted marketing, we give restaurants the tools to grow on their own terms.
We support thousands of restaurants across North America, helping process $1B+ in gross food sales while saving our partners over $700M in third-party commission fees. Through our white-label ordering solutions, a growing demand network (including Google, Yelp, Apple, and Snap), and a diner-friendly marketplace, we empower independent restaurants to own their customer relationships and avoid inflated pricing and fees charged by 3rd party delivery apps like Uber and Doordash.
Founded in 2012, we’ve navigated rapid growth and transformation—from startup roots through the pandemic boom—and are now beginning an exciting new era under our CEO, Kanika Soni. As we evolve with new leadership and cutting-edge tools, we’re deepening our commitment to helping local restaurants thrive in the digital economy.

About the Position:

The Senior Director, GTM Revenue Operations, is both the strategic and technical backbone of how ChowNow's Sales, Onboarding, and Customer Success teams operate day to day. This is not a reporting-and-dashboards role — it's an operator and systems-architect role. You'll need to understand the GTM motion deeply enough to sit in a rep's or post sales rep’'s shoes, spot exactly where a process is broken or a workflow is creating friction, and then personally architect the fix — not as an isolated patch, but as part of a coherent system that holds up as we scale.

This function exists because of where the business is today: years of incremental, band-aid fixes and one-off customizations have left us with real tech debt across Salesforce, HubSpot, PlanHat, and the tools connecting them. Small changes take too long, and they too often break something else in the process. We need someone who can see the whole board — not just the piece in front of them — untangle what's been glued together, and rebuild it so that future changes are fast, safe, and durable.

You'll lead three key functions: a Sales & CS Business Ops (who lives inside the sales and CS org, diagnosing friction and defining the fix), a Marketing & Partner Ops Manager (who owns the demand and partner tech stack end to end as our HubSpot admin), and a Biz Systems team who build and maintain our core systems. Your job is to make sure these three functions work as one connected system rather than three disconnected ones — translating GTM needs into technical requirements, and technical constraints back into GTM strategy, so nothing gets lost in either direction.

This role reports directly to the CEO and will own a team of 5-7 direct reports.

This is a remote role based in the United States. Please note: ChowNow is not eligible to employ in every state and the recruiting team will confirm location and eligibility before moving past initial stages.

WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT YOU:

You put restaurants first. You deeply understand the importance of local restaurants and put them at the center of everything you do. You aim to help them not only survive but thrive.
You celebrate diversity. You recognize that diversity and inclusivity matter. You’re committed to progress, which means everyone gets the support and resources they need, no matter who they are. You have an ability to listen to other team members' ideas and can thrive in an environment that embraces individuality. Everyone’s voice counts.
You raise your hand. You consistently go above and beyond what is asked of you. You help your peers accomplish their tasks while also excelling at accomplishing your own. When you have a smart idea, you raise your hand and share it.
You keep reaching. You set clear ambitious goals. You don’t allow yourself to become complacent with where you’re at and what you’ve done, so you seek out new opportunities and challenges.

Responsibilities Include:

    GTM Process & Team Leadership

  • Deep, ongoing immersion in how Sales, Onboarding, and CS actually operate — their blockers, their workarounds, and where the real friction lives, partnering closely with the Sales & CS Business Partner to diagnose it

  • Turning diagnosed problems into defined solutions: a new workflow, a re-architected process, a system redesign — and owning the decision on what the right fix actually is

  • Managing and developing the Sales & CS Business Partner and Marketing & Partner Ops Manager, ensuring their work stays connected rather than siloed

    • Systems Architecture

  • Acting as the systems architect across our GTM stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, PlanHat, Gong, PartnerStack, LeanData, Bookit and adjacent tools) — thinking through the full chain of impact before any change is made, not fixing one system in isolation

  • Leading the effort to unwind existing technical debt: legacy customizations, redundant automations, and fragile integrations that make small changes slow and risky

  • Setting technical standards and review processes so that new changes are built to scale rather than added as another layer of patchwork

  • Directly managing the Biz Systems team, prioritizing their roadmap against both the tactical fixes surfaced by the Business Partner roles and the larger architectural rebuild this function requires

    • Strategic Operations

  • Owning the connective tissue between diagnosis (GTM Strategy & Analytics function), execution on the sales/CS side (Business Partner), and execution on the marketing/partner side (Marketing & Partner Ops) — ensuring a fix identified in one place is implemented consistently everywhere it touches

  • Territory and compensation planning infrastructure, forecasting rigor, and cross-functional alignment on how GTM processes are designed and rolled out

  • Advising CEO on where the biggest process and systems risks or opportunities are, with a point of view on sequencing and tradeoffs

You Should Apply If You:

  • Have 8+ years of Revenue Operations experience in a SaaS environment, including meaningful time in a hands-on systems/technical capacity — not purely a reporting or analytics background

  • Have 5+ years managing a team across RevOps, MarOps, CS Ops and Business Systems (SalesForce)

  • Have deep, practical fluency in Salesforce and HubSpot; experience with PlanHat, Gong, PartnerStack, and LeanData is a strong plus

  • Have direct experience untangling legacy systems, customizations, or technical debt — not just building net-new

  • Think in systems, not tickets: you naturally trace a proposed fix through everything it touches before committing to a build

  • Have a proven track record of translating messy, ambiguous business pain points into a clear technical solution and seeing it through to execution

  • Are comfortable being both strategic (advising leadership on sequencing and risk) and deeply in the weeds (reviewing a workflow or automation yourself when needed)

  • Have experience partnering with Sales, CS, and Marketing leadership, and can speak credibly to both a rep on the floor and an engineer building the fix

  • Have managed compensation, territory, or forecasting infrastructure in a prior role

About Our Benefits:

At Included Health, the Associate Clinical Director, Integrated Care Quality (NP/MD) is responsible for the strategy, external representation, and program leadership needed to ensure our clinical services perform credibly in high-stakes client, consultant, and audit-facing settings.

This role leads the clinical quality approach to client audits, consultant engagement, and longitudinal quality assurance across relevant services. The Director will represent Included Health in consequential meetings with clients, consultants, health plans, and internal leaders; shape the vision for external-facing clinical quality work; build trusted relationships; and translate audit and quality findings into durable operational improvement strategies.

Establishing a robust longitudinal oversight process is a primary objective for this position. This leader will drive the development of systems to monitor member journeys, ensure care quality, and maintain service reliability over time. Furthermore, they will utilize AI-driven quality surveillance and pattern detection to modernize and scale quality operations.

Responsibilities

    Client and Consultant Leadership

  • Represent Included Health clinical services in high-stakes client, consultant, and audit-related discussions.

  • Build strong relationships with clients, consultants, health plans, and internal commercial partners.

  • Serve as a trusted clinical quality voice in escalations, performance reviews, corrective action discussions, and executive forums.

  • Translate complex clinical and operational issues into clear, credible, executive-ready narratives.

    • Client Audit Strategy and Execution

  • Own the strategy and operating model for clinical client audit readiness.

  • Lead audit planning, preparation, risk triage, file review standards, and executive readiness.

  • Serve as the senior clinical lead for audit content, responses, and remediation planning.

  • Ensure audit findings are converted into measurable action plans with clear ownership and follow-through.

    • Longitudinal Quality Assurance

  • Lead the design and maturation of longitudinal QA models that assess quality across the member journey.

  • Build proactive oversight frameworks that identify risks before they surface in audits, escalations, or client dissatisfaction.

  • Connect quality findings across service lines to identify systemic issues, not isolated defects.

  • Ensure longitudinal QA informs coaching, workflow redesign, policy refinement, and client readiness.

    • AI-Enabled Quality at Scale

  • Lead the use of AI and advanced analytics to scale quality surveillance, longitudinal review, and audit readiness.

  • Define where AI can responsibly augment human review, including trend detection, review prioritization, and documentation assessment.

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

RoleWe are looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer (TME) to join our team. This is a Remote role, reporting to the Director, Technical Marketing Engineer in the Product Management department. We are seeking a hands-on, self-starting Technical Marketing Engineer (TME) with deep networking expertise to drive technical enablement, customer validation, and field readiness for our next-generation Zero Trust Branch solutions. In this high-impact role, you will architect and maintain complex lab environments, lead hands-on Proof of Value (PoV) customer engagements, and provide technical troubleshooting to resolve escalations. As the bridge between engineering and field teams, you will author comprehensive deployment guides, technical collateral, and test plans while delivering interactive training to systems engineers and partners. This is an ideal position for a practitioner who thrives on solving real-world enterprise networking challenges and accelerating customer adoption across distributed edge environments.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead Customer Proof of Value (PoV) Engagements & Field Validations by directly owning and executing hands-on technical PoVs, architectural demonstrations, and pilot evaluations with enterprise prospects and customers to validate technical capabilities, eliminate sales friction, and accelerate enterprise deal closure

  • Architect, Build, and Maintain Advanced Lab Topologies by designing, deploying, and maintaining resilient physical and virtual networking lab environments simulating complex enterprise branch, edge, retail network topologies to rigorously test product behavior, interoperability, and real-world scale

  • Drive Complex Technical Troubleshooting & Escalation Resolution by serving as the direct technical escalation bridge between field teams and core engineering to diagnose, reproduce, and resolve critical L2/L3 networking escalations, network segmentation challenges, and packet-level anomalies during active customer pilots

  • Author Technical Documentation, Deployment Guides, and Reference Architectures by developing production-ready technical collateral, including step-by-step deployment runbooks, reference architectures, white papers, competitive test plans, and solution briefs to standardize best practices and accelerate post-sales time-to-value

  • Deliver Field Readiness & Enablement Training by creating and conducting high-impact technical training programs, interactive workshops, and technical webinars for Systems Engineers (SEs), professional services, and channel partner architects to scale deployment self-sufficiency across distributed enterprise environments

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • Operate with a strong ownership mindset, combining a passion for the mission with high integrity and the ability to navigate seamlessly between strategic planning and hands-on execution.

  • Maintain a customer-obsessed approach, building deep empathy for internal and external stakeholders to solve real-world problems and champion their success.

  • Move with a strong sense of urgency, focusing on execution and delivering high-impact, high-quality results rapidly in a growth-oriented environment.

  • Drive innovation through deep curiosity, enjoying complex technical challenges and leveraging technology to build secure, scalable solutions.

  • Lead with integrity and accountability, consistently aligning actions with words to build trust across teams.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in technical marketing, solutions architecture, or advanced systems engineering with deep subject matter expertise in enterprise routing, switching, TCP/IP, L2/L3 network segmentation, and tunneling protocols (WireGuard, IPsec, VxLAN)

  • Proven track record of leading and winning hands-on customer Proof of Value (PoV) pilots and executive architectural evaluations within complex enterprise and distributed edge networking environments

  • Hands-on proficiency in building and maintaining multi-vendor physical and virtual network lab topologies using bare-metal appliances, hypervisors (ESXi, KVM), and network emulation platforms (EVE-NG, GNS3)

  • Advanced packet analysis and troubleshooting expertise using Wireshark, tcpdump, and traffic generation tools to diagnose real-time routing anomalies, latency/jitter, MTU issues, and NAT/firewall traversal

  • Demonstrated track record of authoring production-grade technical collateral (deployment runbooks, reference architectures, white papers) and delivering technical enablement sessions to sales engineering, professional services, and partner teams

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency

  • Practical experience with Python, Bash scripting, or infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs) to automate lab deployment, test execution, and repetitive networking workflows

  • Working knowledge of public cloud networking architectures (AWS VPCs/Transit Gateways, Azure Virtual WAN, GCP Cloud Routers) or container networking environments (Docker, Kubernetes) connecting distributed branch edges to cloud workloads

  • Recognized networking or security certifications (e.g., CCIE/CCNP Enterprise or Security, JNCIP, PCNSE) or direct architectural experience with retail, kiosk, IoT/OT, or cellular WAN/5G failover deployments

Our CSRs serve an especially important role in delivering elevated, nuanced solutions to sometimes complex problems, due to the handcrafted nature of our products and production processes. Reporting to a Team Supervisor, you should be skilled at navigating multiple web-based tools at once while warmly engaging with customers. We are open 7 days a week, and team members should expect to receive a set schedule that will include some evenings and weekends.

We do not run an anonymous, mega-scale call center. You will work within a small pod reporting directly to a dedicated Team Supervisor and with regular connection to, collaboration with, and visibility to cross-functional senior leaders, including in other departments at Minted outside of CS. Our leadership team knows you by name, actively reviews order and customer insights you share, and supports your daily workflow through regular live huddles and 1:1 check-ins. If you want a role where your problem-solving is noticed, your voice is heard by leadership, and you aren't just a number in a queue, you will thrive here.

  • Handle phone, email, live chat, and social media interactions with a high degree of ownership and warmth.

  • Resolve unique customer concerns, custom product inquiries, and fulfillment challenges promptly and professionally without relying on a rigid script.

  • Leverage detailed internal knowledge base to augment your service approach: you don't have to know everything about design, photos, and printing, but you'll need to be great at using documented knowledge alongside your natural, elevated service skills to help find answers to customer questions and deliver great experiences.

  • Manage multi-system workflows by cross-referencing order information, checking custom design files, verifying inventory tools, and processing order adaptations on the fly.

  • Leadership Insight Sharing: Identify platform friction points or operational errors and share proactive insights directly with Customer Service leadership to improve the broader customer journey.

  • A thoughtful problem-solver who enjoys helping people through unique situations where there isn't always a "right" answer or a script to follow.

  • Tech-savvy and comfortable moving between different tools like our CRM and order databases while keeping a steady, helpful pace.

  • A fast learner who can quickly internalize evolving technical workflows, product customization rules, and platform updates, translating feedback immediately into improved queue performance.

  • Exceptionally patient, empathetic, and resilient, with the emotional intelligence required to deliver a warm, premium, and personalized brand experience to customers managing time-sensitive holiday timelines.

You set the bar when it comes to winning customers over by solving problems with a genuine and authentic approach.

Engineering Manager, DevEx

Ilir Sela started Slice with the belief that local pizzerias deserve every advantage available to major franchises—without sacrificing their independence. What began with his family’s pizzerias now supports tens of thousands of restaurants with the technology, services, and collective power they need to serve modern customers and build lasting businesses. We build for entrepreneurs who put everything into their shops. They deserve technology that is dependable, intuitive, and capable of creating meaningful economic value. We move with urgency, think from first principles, and measure success by the outcomes we create for pizzerias and their customers.

The Challenge to Solve

Slice’s DevEx Platform teams build and evolve the internal developer platform, GitOps workflows, Kubernetes infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tooling that power engineering across Slice. We are looking for a highly skilled Engineering Manager to lead the DevEx team, who can help raise the bar for reliability, security, and operational excellence. Management is key; your role is to create the conditions where platform engineers build reusable, high-impact systems that make every engineer at Slice more productive.

Our strongest managers:

  • Focus teams on customer outcomes rather than activity.
  • Create clarity when the path is uncertain.
  • Make decisions with incomplete information and adapt quickly.
  • Stay close to the details without becoming the bottleneck.
  • Challenge assumptions and look for asymmetric opportunities.
  • Build trust through candor, consistency, and follow-through.
  • Take responsibility for outcomes, including when things go wrong.

The Role

Own developer and business outcomes

Partner with engineering leadership to identify developer friction and platform opportunities. Measure success by improved deployment velocity, system reliability, platform adoption, and developer productivity—not just features shipped or tools built.

Lead technical direction

Guide architecture and technical strategy across our Internal Developer Platform, deployment workflows, and cloud infrastructure. Help the team build reusable patterns, self-service tooling, and strong guardrails that make the right thing the easy thing.

You should be comfortable leading teams working with:

  • Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, and cloud-native architecture.

Build a highly effective team

Give platform engineers context, clear decision boundaries, and meaningful ownership. Encourage an automation-first mindset, reducing toil and creating scalable self-service capabilities.

Raise execution standards

Help the team deliver platform improvements frequently and safely. Standardize workflows, improve observability, and embed operational excellence into everyday development.

Develop exceptional people

Hire, coach, and retain outstanding platform and software engineers. Provide meaningful ownership, direct feedback, and growth opportunities.

Lead across Slice

The Winning Recipe

Strong candidates will bring:

  • Experience managing high-performing platform engineering teams.
  • Skilled at project planning/tracking and creation of team roadmaps.
  • Technical expertise across Kubernetes, GitOps (ArgoCD), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), Python automation, AWS, Terraform, and Datadog.

jobs.excerpt: TEECOM hires by discipline, not by open requisition.
jobs.description:
TEECOM hires by discipline, not by open requisition. We are growing — multiple teams across the US, UK, and India are actively hiring to grow their teams.

When you apply here, you are applying to TEECOM for a role in Technical Project Management. Rather than interviewing for a single posted role, you will go through a structured Discipline Assessment that establishes your level and demonstrated capability. Once your level is determined, TEECOM's recruiting and leadership teams match your profile to the best available opening on a team that fits your skills, experience, and goals.

Roles span Technical Project Manager I through Technical Project Manager III. Your level — and your title — are determined by your assessment, not by the role you apply to.

If you have meaningful experience in more than one discipline, apply to your primary discipline and tell your recruiter about your secondary discipline(s) during your Introduction Call. You may be scheduled for a separate Discipline Assessment for each one.

Technical Project Management at TEECOM

    Technical Project Managers at TEECOM are the primary point of contact for client accounts — they own the relationship, the technology scope, and the delivery across multiple concurrent projects. This is a client-facing, field-active role: TPMs spend significant time on-site managing the technology scope of active projects alongside construction teams, contractors, and client stakeholders.

    TPMs are not pure project managers — they bring genuine technical depth in at least one discipline (ICT/Telecom, Security, AV, Wireless, or similar) and use that expertise to make real-time decisions in the field, review deliverables for quality, and maintain client trust through construction and commissioning. Work spans managing design team coordination, leading client meetings, driving construction administration, reviewing submittals and RFIs, and ensuring projects close out cleanly.

    At more senior levels, Technical Project Managers take ownership of major accounts with multiple active projects, mentor junior TPMs and engineers, and contribute to growing the account and TEECOM's presence with the client.

What We're Looking For

    We hire at all levels — the strongest Technical Project Managers are proactive, coachable, and take ownership of client relationships and outcomes: they're as comfortable with a stakeholder as they are in the field, they don't wait for problems to find them, they own the commercial and technical outcomes of every project they run, and they're always thinking about what comes next — growing the partnership, not just closing the project.

    If you don’t have everything on this list yet, that’s expected — TEECOM develops people through structured documentation, mentorship, and real project work.

    • Technical background in at least one technology discipline (ICT/Telecom, Security, AV, Wireless, or similar) — you can review drawings, discuss design decisions, and troubleshoot issues in the field
    • Experience managing technology consulting or AEC projects through the full lifecycle — design, construction administration, and commissioning
    • Comfort being on-site regularly — this role requires field presence across active projects
    • Client-facing ownership — you manage the relationship directly and are accountable for project outcomes
    • Strong commercial and financial management skills — managing scope, contracts, budgets, schedules, and risk
    • Strong technical communication skills — you translate technical issues into clear decisions and coordinate across disciplines, clients, and contractors
    • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects across a single client account or portfolio

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager- Inference
jobs.excerpt: Senior Product Marketing Manager, AI InferenceWEKA is the AI data and memory infrastructure company transforming how organizations build, run, and scale AI.
jobs.description:
Senior Product Marketing Manager, AI Inference

WEKA is the AI data and memory infrastructure company transforming how organizations build, run, and scale AI. NeuralMesh™ combines high-performance data storage and extended GPU memory in a single software platform, providing a foundation for training, inference, and agentic AI workloads that maximizes GPU productivity, accelerates AI outcomes, and improves the economics of AI at scale.

WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company backed by world-class venture capital investors and AI infrastructure leaders. Our technology is trusted by 30% of the Fortune 50, as well as leading hyperscalers, neoclouds, AI builders, and research organizations. Our team is customer-obsessed, accountable, bold, and collaborative, with a shared focus on helping customers succeed. If we sound like your kind of people, join us!

About The Role

WEKA is seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to help define and build our AI inference business, one of the fastest-moving and most consequential markets in technology. You'll own WEKA's inference proposition for the organizations that run inference at scale, including the AI clouds and service providers that deliver it to others.

This is an early-stage product marketing role focused on a market, not a single product. You'll define how WEKA wins in inference across the full NeuralMesh portfolio. That starts with Augmented Memory Grid, which extends GPU memory and changes the economics of serving models at scale, and extends to NeuralMesh Axon, model-weight loading and checkpointing, and agentic data services. You'll help decide where WEKA should focus, who we build for, and what makes us different by discovering what customers need, testing positioning in the market, and turning what works into proof and a go-to-market motion that can scale.

Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing, you'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Alliances, and Marketing, and alongside WEKA's Platform, Technical, Partner, Compete, and Industry product marketers. You'll also work directly with the early customers and design partners who run inference at scale: AI-native companies and model builders, enterprises putting AI into production, and the AI clouds and service providers that deliver inference to others.

Who We're Looking For

You're a product marketer who loves the early stage. You'd rather help shape a new market proposition and find the path to scale than optimize a playbook that's already working. You combine strong product marketing fundamentals with the technical depth to understand how inference really works: serving frameworks, KV cache, GPU memory hierarchies, time-to-first-token, multitenant GPU infrastructure, and the tradeoffs that set cost per token. You can go deep with an ML infrastructure engineer in the morning and build an economic argument for a CFO in the afternoon.

You're a builder who is comfortable with a blank page and an evolving answer. You treat positioning, segments, and use cases as hypotheses to test, not conclusions to defend, and you change direction quickly when the evidence says to. You're an excellent writer and storyteller who can turn an early customer result into proof, and you'd rather show specific numbers and named customers than make broad claims.

You also know that positioning only matters if it helps find and win the right customers. You stay close to customers, Product, and the market, and you watch how inference architectures, buyers, competitors, and budgets are changing. You measure success by early customer impact and by building the repeatable motion that follows.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Inference Positioning & Messaging: Define WEKA's positioning, messaging, value propositions, priority use cases, and competitive differentiation for AI inference across the portfolio. Treat them as hypotheses at first, and sharpen them into one differentiated proposition as patterns emerge.
  • AI Cloud & Service Provider Proposition: With Partner PMM, own the core proposition for AI clouds and cloud providers that serve inference. This includes multitenancy, Kubernetes-based operations, and the cross-cloud capabilities that make WEKA the storage standard for the category. You own the capability story that spans many clouds; Partner PMM leads joint propositions built with a named cloud partner.
  • Design Partners & Early Customers: Work with Product and Sales to find, recruit, and support design partners and early adopters, and learn from every engagement.
  • Inference Economics: Define and quantify WEKA’s economic value across GPU utilization, time-to-first-token, throughput, concurrency, tokens per GPU, and cost per token. Build the economic case customers need to justify investment.
  • Proof & Evidence: Partner with Technical Marketing, Engineering, and early customers to turn benchmarks and first production deployments into credible proof.
  • Shape the Product: Act as a strategic partner to Product in building the product that will win in AI inference. Bring customer and market evidence into decisions about which inference bets to pursue, what to build, and for whom.
  • Test, Launch, and Learn: Lead product marketing for new inference capabilities, integrations, and solutions. Test positioning, segments, use cases, and packaging with customers and the field, and use each launch to build market presence and sharpen the story.
  • Create High-Impact Content: Personally develop inference content including blogs, web pages, solution briefs, presentations, and customer stories that bring the story to life.
  • Build the Path to Scale: As winning patterns emerge, turn them into repeatable sales plays, discovery guides, objection handling, and enablement that help Sales, Solutions Engineering, and partners win.
  • Be an External Voice: Represent WEKA's inference story with customers, analysts, press, and industry audiences through briefings, events, and thought leadership.
  • Measure Impact: Track early signals of product-market fit, including a validated ideal customer profile, design partner engagement, lighthouse customers in production, and win rates in target segments. Build toward pipeline and revenue contribution.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in product marketing, product management, solution marketing, or a closely related role in enterprise technology.
  • Demonstrated experience taking a new product, category, market proposition, or business from early stage to traction, at a startup or as a new venture inside a larger company.
  • Strong product marketing fundamentals across customer discovery, positioning and messaging, content development, launches, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Working knowledge of AI inference and the infrastructure behind it, including accelerated computing, model serving, GPU memory, data infrastructure, and the performance and cost dynamics of running models in production.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand infrastructure architectures, benchmarks, and product capabilities, then translate them into clear customer value for technical and business audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to build quantified economic value arguments such as TCO, ROI, or cost-per-unit models, and defend them with technical and executive audiences.
  • Exceptional writing, storytelling, and presentation skills, with demonstrated experience personally creating high-quality content such as solution briefs, presentations, web content, blogs, whitepapers, sales tools, or similar assets.
  • Proven ability to work directly with product managers, engineers, sales teams, and customers, and turn input from multiple stakeholders into a clear point of view and high-quality deliverables.
  • Experience marketing to AI-native companies, ML/AI platform teams, cloud or service providers, or enterprise infrastructure buyers is a strong plus.
  • Ability to operate effectively as a senior individual contributor, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution and moving quickly from idea to finished work.
  • Strong, evidence-driven business judgment, with the ability to prioritize the work most likely to validate the market and drive early traction.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by a market and product strategy that can evolve quickly as WEKA learns.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical or business field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Located in North America with the ability to travel up to 25%.

How We Work: The WEKA Way

  • We are Accountable: We take full ownership, always, even when things don't go as planned. We lead with integrity, show up with responsibility and ownership, and hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards.
  • We are Brave: We question the status quo, push boundaries, and take smart risks when needed. We welcome challenges and embrace debates as opportunities for growth, turning courage into fuel for innovation.
  • We are Collaborative: True collaboration isn't only about working together. It's about lifting one another up to succeed collectively. We are team-oriented and communicate with empathy and respect. We challenge each other, resolve conflict constructively, and are transparent about our goals and the results we achieve. Together, we're unstoppable.
  • We are Customer Centric: Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We actively listen and prioritize their success, and every decision we make is driven by how we can better serve, support, and empower them to succeed. When our customers win, we win.

Concerned you don't meet every qualification? Don't let it stop you from applying!

Studies have shown that traditionally underrepresented groups may be less likely to apply for jobs if they don't meet every qualification specified. WEKA is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this position but are concerned your past work experience doesn't match up perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles at WEKA.

WEKA is an equal opportunity employer that prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. jobs.description:
Job Title: Director of Social Media

Department: Communications

Location: Washington, DC; Oakland, CA; or remote

Supervises: Up to 6 employees

Context: At the Sierra Club, we believe in the power of interdependence. Together, we remain committed to the fight for a healthy climate built on a foundation of environmental, racial, economic, and gender justice – a future where all people benefit from a healthy, thriving planet and a direct connection to nature. As the climate crisis and deeply entrenched systemic racism all fuel injustice, we will continue to fight for a bold, transformational agenda that recognizes the interconnectedness between our planet, our humanity, and our future. By recognizing that our destinies are tied, we continue to name that all things are fundamentally connected, and the overlap between ecology, race, gender, and representative government will move to either advance our collective humanity or to oppress it. Sierra Club has close to 700 staff across the country and a network of 64 local chapters that are led and fueled by thousands of volunteers. We are also proud to be a unionized employer, with three labor unions representing more than half of our employees.

Scope: The Director of Social Media is a strategic, creative leader who shapes how Sierra Club shows up on social media. They do this by leveraging data and audience segmentation and combining an understanding of the latest social trends and creative content to tell a cohesive public narrative, generate concrete campaign wins, and foster meaningful engagement. This position requires a proven track-record of managing people, projects, and platforms to achieve successful outcomes around list growth and retention, campaigning and organizing, culture change, fundraising, and brand objectives.

This person must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment and managing a small team within a much larger group of stakeholders. The Director of Social Media will advocate for the strategies and build and manage the systems, processes, and standards that enable effective social media collaboration across the organization. They will serve as a strategic partner and educator to a variety of internal stakeholders, helping our colleagues understand how to work effectively with the Social Media team and support them in translating their expertise and priorities into compelling content for our social media audiences.

To be successful, the Director of Social Media will be on the leading edge of understanding social media trends, platforms, technologies, and marketing techniques; with a track record of using metrics to adapt these strategies and improve results. The ideal candidate will have an understanding of climate and environmental issues, tracking movement in narratives and cultural trends that can help the movement do the vital work of protecting people and planet while advancing solutions.

Job activities include but are not limited to:

    • Social Media Identity Development: Leads on the creative development and delivery of Sierra Club’s social media identity – including voice, visual style, creative content, and innovative platform strategies – in close partnerships with key cross-departmental stakeholders. They will also coach and advise regarding social strategy for key organizational leaders and stakeholders.

      • Creative and Reflexive Content Strategy: Stays nimble and on top of latest industry trends, breakthrough creative campaigns, pop culture, and current events – taking advantage of moments and trends in real-time. Balances multiple issues and shifting priorities to unify and strategically use our organizational voice(s) to respond to the world in real time. Diversifies content and leverages different social media platforms to develop visual and story-based content and market the organization, including its campaigns. Drives content strategies that foster meaningful engagement and a sense of community for both existing and expansion audiences.

        • Developing and Advancing the Team: Develops a team of strategists, creatives, and content developers, managing individuals to contribute at their highest level. Fosters a team culture of innovation, collaboration and accountability alongside concrete near-term and long-term strategic planning. Works to create professional development and project management opportunities for staff.

        • Programming: Sets and achieves programmatic goals through the integration of marketing functions, fundraising, storytelling, list growth, crisis response, influencer engagement and organizing tactics. Supports the development of data-informed strategies, tracking and reporting insights from audience segments, content and platform engagement, with monthly and quarterly social media reporting.

        • Process and Governance: Develops, adapts, and supports a governance structure for our social program; including social media processes for internal and external Sierra Club audiences and key stakeholders. Establishes and enforces content intake, scheduling and review processes. Trains internal staff, chapters, and volunteers on social media best practices and brand standards. Manages contracts and projects with external vendors.

          • This position directly relates to the 24-hour news cycle which will sometimes require weeknight and weekend hours.

A successful candidate must have the following skills and experiences:

    • A Do-er and a Director. You have experience doing top-to-bottom of what is required of a Social Media team; and have a demonstrated track record of both directing a team to successful outcomes, and rolling up your sleeves to do the work alongside of your team as needed.

      • Creative. Your social media and change-making strategies have been driven through innovative and story-based content. You’ve worked with organizations to develop their tone and identity to successfully carve out their niche in the world. And you have the technical skill and creative tool proficiencies to bring these stories to life.

      • Building a Program. You have the ability to build a social media program from top-to-bottom: A proven history of developing the processes and infrastructure needed to establish and grow a program; experience with developing and executing qualitative and quantitative data-informed strategies; success navigating competing priorities with internal and external stakeholders; and managing a team through the creation and execution of effective story-based content.

        • Leadership. You’ve had significant management experience with a demonstrated ability to effectively communicate, coach, and support teams in working effectively together. You’ve navigated complex organizational structures to facilitate collaborative partnerships between stakeholders to keep workflow consistent and shared goals attainable. You are familiar with creating governance structures for social programming and strategies for training and educating content creators on best practices and brand standards.

        • Social Technology. You have deep expertise with social media platforms e.g., Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, and Substack; with a history of adapting technology, tactics, metrics, and innovation in line with social trends. In addition, you have robust knowledge of social media scheduling, monitoring, analytics and reporting software.

        • Equity. You model effective equity analysis and practice and demonstrate a sophisticated understanding of how group dynamics impact supervisory relationships, organizational culture, partnerships, campaigns and coalition work. Your decision-making is consistent, intentional, and committed to creating equitable outcomes at all levels. You have led high-performing and leaderful teams across group identities. You intervene when challenging group dynamics play out, in ways that build understanding, trust, and deeper self-awareness of team members.

The strongest candidates will also demonstrate the following experience, skills and competencies:

    • Knows Our Work. You have experience in the environmental movement or social justice advocacy space: Campaigning, creating public demand for a policy, training volunteers, holding the decision makers accountable, and/or taking delivery on campaign goals. You are in tune with the communities we work with; able to leverage cultural trends to generate enthusiasm, growth, and real power; and be able to convey this information through various digital media platforms.

    • Influencer Partnerships. Influencer cultivation and partnership have been a core part of your past social media strategy and programmatic development. You come to this work with existing influencer partnerships, are in tune with the communities we work with, and will be able to leverage these collaborations and cultural trends to generate enthusiasm, growth, and real power.

    • Top-Notch Organization Skills. There’s a lot to keep track of in this role, and things cannot fall through the cracks. Managing multiple priorities, timeliness, and attention to detail is key, as is knowing when to ask for support.

To Apply

The Sierra Club provides equal employment and advancement opportunities to all staff members. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, lived experience and skills. The Sierra Club does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, immigration status, socioeconomic status, ancestry, age, size, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, familial status, veteran status, disability, AIDS/HIV status, medical condition, prior conviction, arrest history, traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to, hair texture and protective hairstyles, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Job Description:

Job Title: Business Development Manager, Direct Markets

Location: Remote | USA - Southeast Region
Reports to: VP, Sales

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role: The Business Development Manager, Direct Markets is a quota-carrying individual contributor responsible for driving new business growth across automotive dealers, dealer groups, auctions, and related direct-to-dealer market segments. This role is designed for an experienced sales professional who can independently develop opportunities, manage an assigned book of business, and represent the full JD Power Dealer Solutions portfolio in customer-facing conversations. The Direct Markets team supports franchise and independent dealers, regional and national dealer groups, auctions, and other dealership-adjacent customers by representing the full JD Power Dealer Solutions portfolio. Operating with a One J.D. Power mindset, this role partners consultatively with customers to help improve dealership performance through solutions spanning digital retailing, F&I, inventory, marketing, customer experience, data and analytics, operational workflows, and business decision support. This individual will connect customer needs with portfolio capabilities, drive awareness of the broader Dealer Solutions value proposition, gather market insights, and translate evolving business priorities into effective account strategies and field execution.

In this role, you will:

  • Prospect, develop, and close new business across assigned Direct Markets territories, dealer groups, independent dealers, franchise dealers, auctions, and related dealership-facing customer segments.
  • Manage assigned opportunities, accounts, dealer groups, and customer relationships within the Direct Markets channel.
  • Build consultative relationships with dealer principals, general managers, F&I leaders, variable operations leaders, fixed operations leaders, marketing leaders, digital retailing leaders, and other dealership decision-makers.
  • Conduct discovery to understand dealership business needs across F&I, digital retailing, inventory management, lead generation, vehicle acquisition, customer experience, marketing, compliance-minded workflows, reporting, and operational performance.
  • Position JD Power Dealer Solutions as a connected portfolio of capabilities, clearly explaining how the broader offering helps dealers increase profitability, improve process efficiency, strengthen customer engagement, and support operational decision-making.
  • Deliver compelling product positioning, discovery, demonstrations, proposals, and executive-level presentations tailored to dealer needs, market conditions, and account strategy.
  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities across existing accounts and create account plans that expand customer relationships beyond a single product sale.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management, CRM hygiene, opportunity documentation, activity tracking, and forecast accuracy.
  • Coordinate with Product, Customer Success, Professional Services, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, and Executive Leadership to support account strategy, pricing, contracting, implementation readiness, launch readiness, billing readiness, portfolio messaging, and customer success.
  • Represent JD Power professionally at dealerships, dealer group meetings, trade shows, industry events, partner meetings, and virtual customer engagements.
  • Provide market feedback to leadership and Product teams regarding competitive activity, dealer buying behavior, customer objections, capability gaps, launch readiness, roadmap priorities, emerging opportunities, and field adoption barriers.
  • Support informal mentoring, onboarding, solution knowledge sharing, and best-practice development with newer sellers or adjacent sales teams.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree preferred but not required. Equivalent experience, training, and demonstrated success in a related field will be considered.
  • 3-5 years of successful quota-carrying B2B sales experience, preferably in automotive retail, dealership technology, SaaS, data, F&I, digital retailing, inventory, marketing, or dealer-service-provider solutions.
  • Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, longer decision timelines, larger revenue opportunities, and consultative solution selling.
  • Strong understanding of automotive dealership operations, including sales, F&I, digital retailing, inventory, service, marketing, customer experience, and dealership profitability drivers.
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, qualify, build pipeline, negotiate, close, and expand customer relationships.
  • Excellent presentation, communication, discovery, business writing, and executive relationship management skills.
  • Ability to learn and credibly represent a broad Dealer Solutions portfolio, including dealership software, workflow, data, analytics, retailing, inventory, marketing, customer engagement, operational performance, and decision-support capabilities.
  • Strong CRM discipline, forecasting accuracy, account planning, and ability to operate independently in a field-based sales environment.
  • Ability to travel to dealerships, dealer group offices, industry events, internal meetings, and customer-facing engagements as needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience selling directly to automotive dealers, dealer groups, auctions, or dealership decision-makers.
  • Background with dealership technology, retail operations, F&I, inventory, marketing, reporting, digital customer experience, marketplace, or dealer workflow solutions.
  • Existing relationships within automotive retail, dealership groups, OEM field teams, F&I agencies, auctions, or dealer technology providers.
  • Experience building territory plans, account strategies, campaign follow-up, and multi-product growth plans.
  • Comfort working in a fast-changing product environment where seller feedback helps shape go-to-market strategy, enablement, and future roadmap priorities.

Travel Expectations: This is a remote / hybrid remote and field-based role that requires regular customer engagement. Travel may include dealership visits, dealer group meetings, industry events, trade shows, internal sales meetings, product training sessions, and other business needs as defined by Sales Leadership.


Compensation and Benefits: This position has a Total Target Compensation (TTC) range of $90,000 USD - $110,000 per year, inclusive of base salary and target incentive opportunity. This position has uncapped earnings potential based upon sales commission plan achievement. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s compensation within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.


Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.
