jobs.excerpt: Who we are Our mission at Quandri is to transform insurance into a trusted and delightful experience using AI.
jobs.description:
Who we are
Our mission at Quandri is to transform insurance into a trusted and delightful experience using AI. We are building the AI operating system for North America’s best insurance agencies and brokerages.

For the first time ever, we have the technology to fundamentally change how insurance operates, and the stakes are human. Better insurance means families protected from harm, businesses able to take risks, and communities more resilient when the worst happens. For insurance practitioners, the ability to deliver this level of service finally becomes possible.

What we do

Quandri brings deeply specific, vertically-focused AI to the industry’s most critical stakeholders:insurance agencies and brokerages.

Agents are the lifeblood of the industry, the place where most property and casualty insurance is sold and serviced. Yet operating an agency is harder than ever. Peak product complexity, accelerating consolidation, a deepening talent crisis, and the AI revolution are all reshaping how agencies work.

Quandri sits at the cutting edge of this shift, rebuilding how agencies operate one workflow at a time. We pair a deep understanding of insurance processes, systems, and data with serious technical capability and proprietary models, so the transformation is tangible and operational rather than aspirational.

We’re making insurance better for policyholders, while helping insurance brokerages deliver a better client service, grow faster, and harness AI so that they control the future of insurance distribution.

Why join us?

This is a rare seat. You will build Quandri’s partnerships function from the ground up, own some of the company’s most important distribution growth bets, and report directly to the CEO with a real say in the company’s strategy.

You will define how this function works rather than inherit someone else's playbook, and you will have the equity, the mandate, and the runway to make it matter.

We are headquartered in beautiful Vancouver, BC, backed by leading US and Canadian investors, and the recognition has followed:

  • LinkedIn’s Top Canadian Startups in 2024 & 2025

  • Deloitte’s Fast 50

  • CB Insights’ Insurtech 50 and Fintech 100

  • The Globe and Mail’s Top Growing Companies in Canada.

About the Role

The Head of Partnerships will turn partnerships into a new distribution engine for Quandri, one that grows through partners rather than one deal at a time. You will define the model, build the function, and own the results, and serve as the face of Quandri to the partners who matter most.

You'll own three critical partnership domains:

  • Channel partnerships (primary focus). Build scalable distribution channels that enable one-to-many sales through agency networks, clusters, aggregators, private equity groups and statewide associations.

  • Carrier partnerships. These will ladder up from data sharing to distribution and eventually monetization.

  • Ecosystem partnerships. Strategic opportunities across the insurance value chain with AMS’ (agency management systems), technology vendors, and other key industry stakeholders.

What success looks like in year one:

In your first year, you will have built the foundation of Quandri's partnership channel: a defined strategy, the first signed partners live and producing, and a repeatable model others can scale behind. Early revenue through the channel is proof the engine works. The larger commercial impact compounds in year two and beyond.

What you'll do

  • Build the partnerships function and strategy. Create a multi-year partnership strategy with clear milestones tied to commercial and strategic value. Establish processes, playbooks, and infrastructure that can scale from single digits to dozens of partners

  • Drive channel partnerships and revenue. Build and scale partnerships with national and regional agency networks, clusters, and aggregators. Own the full deal cycle from prospecting through closure. Design scalable one-to-many distribution models and partner enablement programs. Work with the sales organization to drive continued revenue acceleration through channel partnerships once they are online.

  • Expand the ecosystem. Build strategic relationships with technology vendors, private equity groups, industry associations, MGAs, carriers, and other key insurance stakeholders. Track partnership performance with clear metrics.

  • Inform company strategy. Bring external market intelligence and partner insights back to shape company strategy and product decisions.

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration by partnering with Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and RevOps teams to ensure partnerships deliver value across the organization.

The ideal person for this role will have:

  • 5-8 years building channel partnerships that drove significant revenue. You've structured partner programs, enabled partner sales teams, and built one-to-many sales models from 0-to-1 or early-stage scaling. You understand partner economics, sales metrics, and quota attainment. You're used to being measured on outcomes and consistently delivering results.

  • Exceptional relationship-building and negotiation skills. You build genuine relationships from carrier executives to agency principals. You have high emotional intelligence, are a skilled negotiator, and are able to navigate complex dynamics and find solutions that work.

  • Ownership mentality. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, make decisions with imperfect information, and push through setbacks to close deals. Bonus points if you have operated in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment before.

You will enjoy and be successful at Quandri if you:

  • Have a customer-focused mindset

  • Can operate in a fast-paced environment where change and innovation are constant

  • Take high levels of ownership in everything you do

  • Have AI-first thinking and want to apply AI to solve the world’s problems of tomorrow

  • Operate with urgency, and aren’t afraid to move fast and make some mistakes along the way

  • Are low ego, and believe in achieving the best outcome for our customers

  • Want to have a big impact, and are not content with making changes at the edges

Compensation and Benefits

    The total compensation for this role is $180,000 - $250,000, including base and bonus, plus equity in the company. The bonus is performance-based and tied to partnership revenue and milestones.

    In addition, we offer:

  • Comprehensive health benefits, including Lifestyle Spending Account

  • Four weeks of paid vacation per year

Our guiding principles

  • Customers at the core. We put the customer at the center of all we do. At a basic level, we believe business success comes down to deeply understanding customers' wants and needs, and tying your success to the true success of your customers. We prioritize customer needs above everything else, and know that in the long term the weighing machine will tie our success together.
  • Move with urgency. The default state of organizations is to get slower and more bureaucratic as they grow. More time is spent getting on the same page rather than actually producing work. We embed default urgency into everything we do to fight back against this. If we need to move more slowly and deliberately for an important decision or project, we will, but we will do this intentionally and not let it become our default state, as velocity is our most important advantage
  • Be curious. We understand the world by being curious and asking why. We aren't satisfied with surface level understanding, and seek a deeper understanding of why things are the way they are. Don't take someone's word for it or the answer "because that's how we do it." Understand why and dig deep.
  • Excellence in execution. We know that what separates good from great is a high level of execution. We commit ourselves to excellence in everything that we do, from delivering an amazing product to writing a great email.
  • Act like an owner.We're all owners of the business and act like it. We follow through on commitments, own our results and think long-term. When everyone in a company exhibits high ownership, things don’t slip through the cracks and you need less process to ensure the right thing gets done.
  • Fight for simplicity. The law of increasing functional information states that systems evolve to become more complex over time. At Quandri, we believe there is sophistication in simplicity; as such, we intentionally fight for streamlined solutions and are committed to the uncomplicated.
  • AI-first. We aim to solve problems with AI. Not all problems can be solved with AI, and we know this, but there are an increasing number of problems that can be and we prioritize AI-first thinking with our customers and in our internal operations and decision making.

This role will report to the Medical Director, Value-Based Care Programs overseeing the accountable care organization (ACO) programs. The Lead will collaborate with cross-functional work groups to develop and implement ACO quality performance improvement workflows and a scalable data reporting program to maintain compliance with CMS quality reporting requirements. This role also utilizes advanced project management skills and builds strong organizational relationships to implement and manage initiatives. The Lead, Value-based Care Programs provides strategic guidance to ensure the successful completion of quality reporting requirements to maintain compliance with ACO regulations and addresses quality performance gaps in partnership with our provider market teams to improve physician engagement on key program outcomes.

What You'll Do

Qualifications

jobs.description:
Team: Customer Success / Engineering

Mindset:Do you like writing code to solve customer problems? Read on.

About Nametag

Nametag is a category leader in identity verification, security, and account protection. We are building a world-class, remote-first team where engineers thrive in both technical depth and customer engagement. We value intellectual curiosity, collaboration, and a strong sense of responsibility in protecting enterprise security.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Technical Customer Engineer to serve as the technical escalation point for customer-reported issues. This is an engineering-adjacent role focused on diagnosing complex integration problems, scripting and prototyping solutions, and collaborating directly with our core engineering team to drive fixes into production.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys debugging, writing lightweight code, and working closely with customers to unblock them quickly. This goes beyond ticket processing - it’s hands-on technical problem solving with real ownership.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the first technical responder for escalated customer issues, particularly those blocking integrations or deployments.
  • Debug in the wild - inspecting API payloads, webhook logs, OAuth exchanges, and race conditions that surface only under real-world load.
  • Provide interim solutions such as code snippets, pull requests, documentation updates, or configuration guidance.
  • Bridge the gap between customer and engineering: reproduce issues, isolate root causes, and ensure fixes are fully validated before release.
  • Gather structured context and relay actionable insights to engineering for long-term fixes.
  • Recommend integration best practices across authentication flows, REST APIs, and IAM platforms.
  • Improve internal support tooling, documentation, and runbooks based on recurring patterns.
  • Surface common pain points and influence product priorities.

Tech You’ll Work With

  • You need to be comfortable in our primary languages (Go, Typescript), as well as some experience in a few of the other common platforms our customers use (Python, Ruby, that kind of thing).
  • REST APIs, OAuth, Webhooks (reference: getnametag.com/docs)
  • Authentication and identity workflows (OIDC, SSO, Token Exchanges)
  • Scripting or debugging tools in Python, Node.js, Bash, or similar environments
  • Identity platforms: Okta, Microsoft Entra, Duo, Auth0, Ping, and custom IAM stacks.
  • Systems: AWS, CloudFormation, Postgres, Docker, GitHub Actions, modern observability stacks

Qualifications

Work Authorization (Required): Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future need for visa sponsorship. This is a firm requirement. The technical qualifications below are guidelines.

  • 2–5 years in technical support engineering, solutions engineering, DevOps, SRE, or adjacent engineering roles.
  • Client facing experience - ability to communicate clearly and empathetically with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong debugging skills across APIs, backend integrations, or authentication workflows.
  • Comfort writing lightweight scripts or tools to diagnose and unblock issues.
  • Familiarity with IAM platforms such as Okta, Microsoft Entra, Duo, or similar.

Who Will Succeed in This Role If

  • You like solving real customer problems more than sitting behind abstract tickets.
  • You don’t mind hopping between console logs, Slack threads, and cURL commands.
  • You stay calm when something is broken, and you don’t stop until it’s understood.

Why Join

You’ll join a fast-moving team where customer impact is immediate and visible. You’ll collaborate directly with engineering leadership, shape how we scale technical support, and build a reputation as a go-to problem solver.

If you’re the person others call when things break - let’s talk.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary: $120,000 - $160,000
  • Potential equity in a high-growth company
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • Flexible time off policies
  • 401(k) program with employer matching
  • Remote-first culture with opportunities for in-person collaboration during quarterly team off-sites

Why UJET?

  • Impactful Work: Be at the forefront of innovation, directly shaping the future of customer experience.

  • Think creatively about ways to increase the company’s value to customers.

jobs.excerpt: Column is the software platform for public information.
jobs.description:
Column is the software platform for public information. We build automated tools and workflow solutions that help governments, law firms, and media organizations notify the public. Today, thousands of publishers and tens of thousands of agencies, firms, and individuals rely on Column to keep their communities informed every day. We’re reimagining how public information connects people, institutions, and media.

We're a remote-first team of engineers, designers, and builders who are committed to creating software that supports an informed public.

About the Role

The Automated Affidavits Representative plays a key role in Column’s affidavit operations, supporting affidavits from generation through signing, notarization, and completion.

We are looking for an experienced notary who is comfortable working in a high volume, technology driven environment and can help us scale affidavit signing and notarization operations nationwide. This person will serve as an authorized affidavit signer on behalf of Column, perform Remote Online Notarization, manage exceptions within automated workflows, and work directly with our notary vendors to ensure affidavits are completed accurately and on time.

Compliance is also an important part of the role. You will help research and document state, jurisdiction, court, publication, signing, and notarization requirements and work with internal teams and external partners to translate those requirements into scalable operational processes.

This role is a strong fit for someone who understands notarial processes, is comfortable working directly with vendors, and enjoys improving processes as volume and complexity grow.

What You’ll Do

Affidavit Signing and Notarization

  • Serve as an authorized affidavit signer on behalf of Column
  • Perform Remote Online Notarizations for affidavits and related documents
  • Review affidavits for accuracy, completeness, proper execution, and notarization requirements before completion
  • Manage affidavit signing and notarization queues while meeting established service level expectations
  • Identify and resolve missing information, signing issues, failed notarizations, workflow errors, and other exceptions that could delay completion
  • Understand and correctly process different affidavit types, templates, and signing requirements

Notary Operations and Vendor Management

  • Work directly with Column’s external notary and affidavit vendors to support daily operations and resolve issues
  • Serve as an operational point of contact when vendor issues affect affidavit completion, signing, or notarization
  • Communicate clearly with vendors regarding requirements, errors, process changes, service expectations, and escalations
  • Help monitor vendor performance and identify recurring issues that create delays, rework, failed transactions, or unnecessary costs
  • Help develop scalable processes for managing increasing affidavit and notarization volume
  • Identify opportunities to improve how work is distributed between internal signers, notaries, automation, and external vendors
  • Partner with internal teams to improve signing and notarization workflows as Column expands affidavit operations

Compliance and Process Improvement

  • Research state, jurisdiction, court, publication, signing, and notarization requirements when questions arise
  • Help maintain clear documentation of affidavit and notarial requirements
  • Monitor changes to requirements and help determine whether existing templates, workflows, or processes need to change
  • Identify potential compliance gaps and escalate questions requiring additional legal or operational review
  • Work with internal teams to translate confirmed requirements into affidavit templates, processes, documentation, and automation
  • Identify recurring manual work, errors, and operational bottlenecks that could be addressed through stronger processes or automation
  • Contribute to Standard Operating Procedures and internal resources for affidavit signing, notarization, vendor management, and compliance

What We’re Looking For

  • Current notary commission and the ability to legally perform Remote Online Notarizations
  • Experience performing notarizations and a strong understanding of notarial responsibilities and requirements
  • Comfortable serving as an authorized affidavit signer on behalf of Column
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and potential compliance concerns
  • Experience working directly with vendors, partners, or other external stakeholders
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the confidence to troubleshoot and resolve operational issues with external partners
  • Strong organization and time management skills with the ability to manage high volume workflows and competing deadlines
  • Good judgment and the ability to determine when an issue can be resolved independently and when additional review or escalation is required
  • Comfortable learning and working across multiple systems, technology platforms, and automated workflows
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of problems, and follow issues through resolution
  • Comfortable working in an environment where processes are continuing to evolve and scale

Must Haves

  • Active U.S. notary commission
  • Legally eligible and authorized to perform Remote Online Notarizations in your commissioned state
  • Hands on notarization experience
  • Ability to serve as an authorized affidavit signer on behalf of Column
  • Experience managing high volume, deadline driven work
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate document execution
  • Strong communication skills and experience working with external partners or vendors
  • Ability to research and interpret notarial and jurisdiction specific requirements
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot operational issues and escalate appropriately
  • Experience with Remote Online Notarization platforms and workflows

Nice to Haves

  • Experience processing or notarizing affidavits
  • Experience with legal notices, proofs of publication, or other legal documents
  • Experience managing notary vendors or third party service providers
  • Experience working in compliance, legal operations, regulatory research, or document operations
  • Experience researching state, court, or jurisdiction specific requirements
  • Experience maintaining Standard Operating Procedures, compliance documentation, or internal knowledge resources
  • Experience identifying opportunities for process improvement or automation
  • Experience working in a technology or SaaS environment

What Success Looks Like

You keep Column’s affidavit signing and notarization operations moving reliably at scale.

You can independently manage daily affidavit queues, sign and notarize documents accurately, resolve routine exceptions, and work directly with vendors when issues arise. You understand when a requirement needs additional research and can help turn confirmed requirements into clear operational processes.

As you grow in the role, you do more than process affidavits. You identify where the process is breaking down, where vendors or workflows need improvement, and where automation can reduce manual work while maintaining the accuracy and compliance our customers depend on.

Your First 90 Days

First 30 Days: Learn the Operation

Your first month focuses on understanding Column’s affidavit lifecycle, signing responsibilities, notarization workflows, vendors, systems, and requirements.

You will:

  • Complete training on the Automated Affidavits workflow from generation through delivery
  • Learn Column’s affidavit signing and Remote Online Notarization procedures
  • Become familiar with the different affidavit types and templates processed by Column
  • Learn how work moves between Column, our signing processes, and external notary vendors
  • Understand when manual intervention is required within automated workflows
  • Become familiar with existing state, jurisdiction, court, publication, and notarization requirements
  • Learn how affidavit and notary exceptions are researched, documented, resolved, and escalated
  • Begin reviewing, signing, and notarizing affidavits with support as needed

By Day 30:

You can independently review, sign, and notarize standard affidavits, navigate our core systems, recognize common processing issues, and understand when an issue requires additional research or escalation.

Days 31 to 60: Own the Workflow

During your second month, you will begin independently managing daily affidavit and notary operations.

You will:

  • Manage affidavit queues, signing responsibilities, notarizations, and routine exceptions
  • Consistently complete work within established accuracy and service level expectations
  • Communicate directly with notary vendors to resolve routine operational issues
  • Research and document affidavit and notarial requirements when questions arise
  • Identify discrepancies between confirmed requirements and existing workflows or templates
  • Help keep notary and compliance documentation current as requirements are confirmed or changed
  • Identify recurring vendor, signing, or workflow issues and escalate patterns that need broader solutions

By Day 60:

You independently own your standard affidavit signing and notarization responsibilities, can manage routine vendor issues, and can research and apply common affidavit and notarial requirements with minimal oversight.

Days 61 to 90: Help Scale the Program

During your third month, the focus expands from executing the process to helping make it stronger and more scalable.

You will:

  • Independently handle more complex affidavit, signing, notarization, and vendor exceptions
  • Proactively identify operational and compliance gaps
  • Review workflows and templates against documented requirements
  • Identify recurring manual work, failed transactions, errors, and vendor issues that could be addressed through process improvements or automation
  • Help strengthen vendor processes and operational expectations
  • Contribute to stronger documentation and Standard Operating Procedures
  • Identify opportunities to make affidavit signing and notarization more efficient as volume grows
  • Serve as a reliable internal resource for routine affidavit and notary questions

By Day 90:

You operate independently as an Automated Affidavits Representative, Remote Online Notary, and authorized signer. You are also becoming a trusted resource for notary operations, vendor management, and affidavit compliance. You help ensure our workflows remain accurate and efficient while identifying ways to scale the operation as Column grows.

Why This Role Matters

Affidavits are the final proof that a public notice was published correctly, and their execution can depend on specific signing, notarization, court, publication, and jurisdictional requirements.

As Column processes affidavit volume at scale, we need more than someone who can sign documents. We need someone who understands notarization, can work effectively with our external partners, recognizes when something does not look right, and can help build a process that continues to work as volume grows.

The Automated Affidavits Representative helps make that possible by combining hands on affidavit processing and Remote Online Notarization with vendor coordination, compliance support, and continuous process improvement.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary of $55,000 to $62,000 based on experience
  • Equity participation in a high growth, mission driven company
  • 401K with match
  • Health, dental, vision, life, short term, and long term disability insurance
  • Flexible PTO

The Product:Dotdigital is an all-in-one customer experience and data platform (CXDP) that empowers marketing teams to exceed customer expectations with highly personalized cross-channel journeys. With Dotdigital, marketers can seamlessly unify, enrich, and segment customer data. Breaking down data silos, Dotdigital streamlines decision-making and paves the way for marketing creativity that delivers customer engagement at scale. With powerful AI capabilities, Dotdigital makes it easy to automate deeply personalized experiences across web, email, SMS, WhatsApp, chat, push, social, ads, and more.

About the Role

The Business Development Representative (BDR) is a targeted, commissioned role on the new business team in the Americas. Your job is to find and qualify leads and turn them into Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) for our Sales team to close, by uncovering Budget, Authority, Need, and Timeframe. You'll build and manage your own list of prospects across a wide range of businesses.

You'll build strong working relationships with Leadership, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and your fellow BDRs.

You'll have a monthly SQL target, and your commission is based on the number of SQLs you pass to Sales that get accepted.

The BDRs who do best here aren't the ones who know everything on day one. They're the ones who are curious about the people they're talking to, willing to try new approaches, and quick to learn from what works and what doesn't. We'll teach you how to spot the problem a prospect needs solving and how to lead with that in your pitch.

You'll work the inbound leads assigned to you in our CRM quickly and efficiently, and you'll also prospect and qualify your own outbound accounts. We track how many conversations you have and how many of those turn into opportunities. Those conversations will be with marketers about their email, SMS and multichannel marketing needs. Knowing a bit about marketing is a bonus, but it's not required. If you're curious, we'll get you up to speed.

About You

We care more about how you approach the job than what's already on your resume. Here's what we're looking for:

  • You're willing to try. You'd rather pick up the phone and get it a bit wrong than wait until everything is perfect. New messaging, a new tool, a new way of opening a call: you'll give it a go and see what happens.

  • You're curious. You ask "why?" a lot. You want to understand how a marketer's day works, what's getting in their way, and what makes a business tick before you reach out.

  • You love to learn. You don't need to know SaaS or marketing yet. What matters is that you can show us something you taught yourself and how you went about it.

  • You welcome feedback. We review calls and emails together every week. You listen, try the suggestion on your next call, and come back to tell us how it went. Hearing "here's what to change" feels useful to you, not personal.

  • You're a team player. You share what's working, cheer on your teammates' wins, and ask for help when you're stuck. We win as a team here.

  • You communicate clearly. Native-level English, written and spoken, and you're comfortable starting conversations with people you've never met.

  • You stay organized. There's a lot of activity in this role. You can juggle priorities, manage your time and keep your pipeline tidy when things get busy.

Bonus Points (Not Required)

  • Experience with tools like HubSpot, Salesloft or ZoomInfo

  • A general understanding of ecommerce, SaaS or marketing technology

  • Any customer-facing experience, like retail, hospitality or customer service

  • Spanish-language proficiency, written and spoken, as you may speak with Spanish-speaking prospects in Latin America and the US

Interview Process

  1. 15 minute screening call with Team Talent

  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager, including roleplay

  3. Interview with the Head of Sales

  4. Final panel stage interview

Some of Our Global Benefits

  • Commission & bonus opportunities

  • Annual leave that increases with service + option to buy more

  • Additional paid wellbeing days + annual wellbeing reward

  • Christmas office shutdown (extra time off)

  • Enhanced parental leave & family support policies

  • Employee recognition & reward schemes

  • Referral bonuses & long-service rewards

Authenticity in Our Hiring Process

At Dotdigital, we believe in genuine conversations and authentic expertise. While AI can be a valuable and legitimate tool in many contexts, we ask candidates not to use AI-generated content or live AI assistance at any stage of our recruitment process, including applications, assessments, and interviews.

We appreciate your cooperation in helping us keep our hiring process fair, transparent, and focused on real human insight.

DEI commitment

As an equal opportunities employer we are committed to equality in all its practices with regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or sexual orientation. If you have any additional requirements or adjustments to assist an application then please don't hesitate to contact us and advise us how we can best support you.

Legal statement

No agencies/recruiters please. We are only accepting applications directly from the applicants. If you are a recruiter, please refrain from reaching out to our staff about this position. Anything contrary will be treated as unsolicited approach under the applicable data protection law.

Whether onsite, remote, or hybrid, we stay connected through shared initiatives that bring our teams together. If you’re inspired by transparency, driven to make an impact, and eager to help foster community—we’d love to have you join us.

How You'll Have an Impact at Paula's Choice

The Sr. Trade Marketing Manager, Americas owns trade marketing strategy and execution across Paula's Choice's full Americas retail portfolio - Sephora US, Sephora at Kohl's, Sephora Canada, Sephora LATAM, and Dermstore.com, with authority to manage additional retail partners as the channel expands in partnership with sales.

You will be responsible for bringing Global Brand's campaigns to life at retailers across the Americas and set the Americas-specific retail strategy and execution needed to grow the business and meet retail sales goals by partnering with sales to manage the trade marketing budget, leading joint marketing planning directly with retail partners and sales and representing Trade Marketing in executive and cross-functional planning.

As the Senior Manager, Trade Marketing you will:

Trade & Retail Go-To-Market Strategy

  • Own the Americas trade marketing calendar and localization of Global Brand's GTM plans for core, newness, and tentpole moments — translating global strategy into retailer-specific execution across the full retail portfolio.
  • Own the management of Americas trade marketing budget: build the annual plan, allocate spend across partners and moments, and manage OpEx tracking, invoice timeliness, and quarterly reforecasting in partnership with sales lead.
  • Lead annual and quarterly Joint Business Planning (JBP) with retail partners— setting shared growth targets and investment priorities, in close partnership with Sales Lead.
  • Lead marketing strategy and execution needed for P.C Sephora LATAM expansion.

Retail Account & Partner Management

  • Serve as the senior marketing relationship owner —the day-to-day contact — for Sephora US, Sephora Canada, Sephora LATAM
  • Own strategy, kick-off, execution, and results reporting for Core, Newness, and promotional trade marketing plans, including tent-pole moments like SEPHORIA.
  • Lead executive-level partner relationships: represent Paula's Choice at market week, business reviews, and partner strategy sessions, escalating and resolving conflicts between Paula's Choice priorities and retailer asks.
  • Provide guidance in partnership with Sales Lead around retail media network strategy and off-site media needs across all Americas markets to Paid Media Team.
  • Own the monthly and quarterly 360 trade marketing readout across the full portfolio, translating retailer-level results into a portfolio view for leadership.
  • Develop and execute in app preview GTM retail in-app previews, digital programs, and "firsts"/beta opportunities — proactively pitching Paula's Choice as a strategic partner, not just responding to retailer asks.

Retail Digital, Media & Merchandising

  • Own all North American Retail PDP asset strategy for new launches and core, including brief standards, kick-off cadence, and timeline governance across partners.
  • Own digital shelf standards across the portfolio: PDP copy, imagery, and video freshness, and escalate gaps to Creative/Brand leadership.
  • Oversee retail PR and digital programs with Canada and LATAM agencies — evaluating performance, approving spend, and setting the annual product launch calendar and strategy in partnership with Sales Lead.
  • Partner with Brand Social & Influencer on influencer and social support tied to retail launches

Ratings, Reviews & Digital Shelf Governance

  • Own the Americas Ratings & Reviews vendor relationship, contract, and budget — setting strategy in partnership with sales and negotiating terms and ensuring seamless execution.
  • Set the audit cadence and standards for product ratings, reviews, copy, and badging across the portfolio, and hold partner and internal teams accountable to them.
  • Report digital shelf health and R&R performance to leadership as a standing trade KPI, with clear action owners when standards slip.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Manage and develop 1 direct report, setting goals, running regular development conversations, and building bench strength for the trade function.
  • Act as the NA senior trade voice in cross-functional planning with Sales, Education, Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, VM, Creative, and Finance — issuing directives to other teams rather than only receiving them.
  • Represent NA Trade Marketing in executive/leadership reviews, presenting portfolio strategy, results, and investment recommendations directly.
  • Own post-campaign analysis at the portfolio level, translating retailer-by-retailer results into strategic recommendations for the next planning cycle.
  • Partner closely with Sr. Manager of Digital Americas, VP of Sales, VM and Global Brand
  • Other responsibilities as assigned by your manager.

The Details

  • Location: Fully remote, within the US — ideal candidate on the West Coast or SF/Bay Area(PST alignment for retail partner cadence).
  • Hours: Typical PST business hours, with flexibility required around retail partner and executive calendars.
  • Travel: Up to 10-15% — Meeting Weeks, Planning Sessions, Tentpole Activations, and Joint Business Planning sessions with retail partners.
  • Physical requirements: Ability to handle long periods of both sitting and screen time.

What You'll Bring to the Table

  • 5+ years of experience in retail/trade marketing or brand management for a beauty brand (hair, color, skincare, fragrance and/or tools), with experience managing at least 1 direct report.
  • Robust, proven experience owning trade strategy and P&L for Sephora and at least one additional national or mass retail partner.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and lead integrated retail marketing programs across multiple accounts.
  • Strong acumen in Retail Paid Media, Retail Creator programs, and Retail Animations, with the judgment to know which lever drives results for a given moment or partner.
  • Proven ability to build and sustain strong retail relationships that translate into incremental support, placement, and visibility.
  • Relevant beauty/skincare industry experience and strong understanding of retail merchandising and digital shelf strategy.
  • Executive presence: able to represent trade strategy and results directly to senior leadership.
  • Strong communication skills, strategic and financial thinking, and the ability to lead cross-functionally without direct authority.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning budget and forecast accuracy.

What Can Help You Really Stand Out

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionNebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.
jobs.description:
Description

Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.

We are looking for an Application Security Engineer to own product security end to end — from threat modelling and secure design reviews to vulnerability management and security controls embedded into CI/CD.

You will work closely with product and platform teams to make security part of the engineering process, building secure defaults and helping prevent vulnerabilities from reaching production without slowing development down.

What you will do

  • Own application and product security end to end, from design reviews and threat modelling to vulnerability remediation and follow-up.
  • Partner with product and platform teams to embed security into the development lifecycle rather than treat it as a final review step.
  • Build and improve security controls in CI/CD, including SAST, dependency, secrets, container, and IaC scanning.
  • Review application designs and code where security risk is meaningful, and turn recurring findings into secure defaults, shared libraries, lint rules, and CI gates.
  • Drive vulnerability management across application code and cloud posture, including triage, risk-based prioritisation, remediation timelines, and external pentest findings.
  • Strengthen security in multitenant B2B systems, including tenant isolation, authentication, authorization, RBAC / ABAC, and access controls.
  • Work on cloud and Kubernetes security across AWS environments, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
  • Help translate GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 requirements into practical engineering controls and system properties.
  • Develop and support a security champions programme to help engineering teams adopt secure practices in their day-to-day work.
  • Address security risks specific to AI and LLM-powered features, including prompt injection, data leakage, and untrusted model output.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on Application Security or Product Security.
  • Strong software engineering background with the ability to read, review, and write production code; Python experience is highly preferred.
  • Deep practical knowledge of web application security, including OWASP Top 10, ASVS, authentication and session management, OAuth2 / OIDC / SAML, and authorization issues such as IDOR and broken access control.
  • Experience securing multitenant or B2B SaaS products, including tenant isolation, RBAC / ABAC, and access control models.
  • Hands-on experience embedding security into CI/CD, including SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container scanning, and IaC scanning.
  • Strong experience with threat modelling, secure design reviews, and secure code reviews in collaboration with product and engineering teams.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities based on risk, criticality, and exploitability, including remediation prioritisation and escalation when needed.
  • Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes security, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and auditors.
  • Fluent Russian and English at B2 level or above.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building a DevSecOps practice from scratch.
  • Experience running or participating in a Security Champions programme.
  • Hands-on penetration testing experience.
  • Experience securing LLM-powered or AI products.
  • Experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 from an engineering perspective.
  • Knowledge of software supply chain security, including SBOMs, SLSA, image signing, or similar practices.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 4000-6000 EUR Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

Talent Acquisition & Management at ServiceNow is building the systems and strategy behind AI-native hiring at scale. We're looking for a true subject-matter expert who can bridge deep TA process knowledge with strong systems and vendor management skills, someone who makes sure the technology recruiters rely on every day just works and keeps getting better. You'll work in constant partnership with Product and DT, and be the voice of TA in those rooms: someone who understands how recruiters actually source, screen, and move candidates, and who can translate a system change into what it means for hiring velocity and candidate experience. You'll own the future strategy design and day-to-day operations of Avature and our other foundational TA&M systems and program partnerships as we bring them online, acting as the translator between our business strategy and the systems that power it.

What You'll Own

● Avature Post-Implementation: full ownership of platform optimization, adoption, and operational excellence following our December go-live, including vendor relationship management and quarterly business reviews.

● Cross-Functional Collaboration: serving as the primary liaison between TA, the Project Madagascar program team, and People Product & DT, translating technical requirements into what they mean for the TA practitioner.

● TA Technology Stack Optimization: governance and design for our foundational TA systems (Avature, LinkedIn, HackerRank, Findem and more as we bring new tools online), ensuring interoperability and long-term reliability, with Customer Zero and Now on Now top of mind, always looking for where we can lean further into our own ServiceNow platform as part of our broader strategy heading into next year.

● Pre-Go-Live Implementation Readiness: partnering with the Project Madagascar change team on training, documentation, cutover planning, and day-one support.

● Vendor Relationship Management: receiving vendor handoffs from our Innovation team and owning ongoing partnership, SLA accountability, contract renewals, and optimization conversations.

● Operational Metrics & Governance: establishing and tracking system health, adoption, and performance KPIs that feed directly into our roadmap decisions.

What You'll Bring
  • Background in TA technology, operations, and strategy; Avature experience is strongly preferred.

jobs.description:
Our U.S.-based partner client is an experiential agency located in a major urban center. They design and execute immersive brand experiences for clients in technology, media, and consumer sectors. Their work spans strategic planning, creative direction, event production, and content creation. They value thoughtful, collaborative approaches to delivering quality projects and invite professionals who share a commitment to effective, clear communication and meaningful brand engagement.

We are seeking a rare hybrid talent: a Senior Designer who thrives at the intersection of big-idea conceptual design and flawless technical execution. In this role, you won't just dream up immersive environments, custom packaging, and high-end merchandise—you will also be the maestro ensuring concepts get printed, built and brought to life on spec and on brand. From creating elevated 3D renders that win pitches to delivering millimeter-perfect floor plans and print-ready mechanicals, you will bridge the gap between creative vision and physical reality.

This is a full-time role, on a US shift and on a Work From Home set-up.

If you have the right skill set, this may be your opportunity to enter this fast-growing organization.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Conceptual & 3D Design

  • Visualize Environments: Develop high-fidelity 3D renders and spatial layouts for experiential events, pop-ups, trade show booths, and brand activations.

  • Product & Packaging Ideation: Ideate and render custom structural packaging, influencer kits, and bespoke merchandise.

  • Creative Problem Solving: Translate internal creative briefs into tangible, innovative physical concepts that align with client branding and objectives.

Technical Execution & Production

  • Draft Technical Drawings: Generate accurate floor plans and structural tech specs for fabrication.

  • Pre-Press & Mechanicals: Build flawless, print-ready production files for large-format print, packaging dielines, and apparel/merch decoration.

  • Vendor Collaboration: Partner closely with fabricators, printers, and production managers to ensure design integrity and structural soundness.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Industrial Design, Interior Design, Architecture, Fine Arts, Visual Communication, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

  • Minimum of 8 years of professional design experience with a strong focus on print, packaging, and/or experiential event design.

  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.

  • Proven expertise in 3D modeling and rendering software such as Cinema 4D, Rhino, Blender, and/or KeyShot.

  • Strong working knowledge of CAD or Vectorworks for spatial planning, technical drafting, and design documentation.

  • Experience integrating AI-powered tools into the design workflow for concept development, visualization, and creative iteration.

  • Deep understanding of print production processes, including offset, digital, screen printing, and large-format printing, as well as paper engineering, substrate selection, fabrication methods, and production materials.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to identify and resolve design inconsistencies, production issues, and technical specifications such as alignment, bleeds, and file preparation.

  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You love the "how it's made" aspect of design just as much as the aesthetics.

  • You are a self-starter who can balance multiple fast-moving agency timelines without breaking a sweat.

  • You have a collaborative mindset and enjoy working alongside art directors, copywriters, and account teams.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

We are hiring a senior Generalist Engineer for our Research & Development Team who can own problems end to end and deliver complete production systems, not just components. This is a broad, high-ownership role for an engineer who can operate across software, distributed systems, infrastructure, data, and, where useful, machine learning, moving from vague problem statements to clear designs, robust implementations, reliable deployment, and effective operation in production.

Success in this role requires strong first-principles thinking, sound technical judgment, deep debugging ability, and the willingness to work across boundaries to get the job done. We are looking for a true engineering generalist: someone who reduces complexity, improves reliability and performance, and treats ML as one tool among many rather than a default answer.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design and build production-grade systems that are reliable, scalable, and observable.
  • Own systems end-to-end: problem → design → data → implementation → deployment → operations.
  • Work across application services, distributed systems, infrastructure, data pipelines, and ML systems
  • Debug complex production issues across multiple layers
  • Make engineering trade-offs grounded in first principles
  • Improve performance, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency
  • Contribute to architecture and technical direction
  • Write maintainable code and documentation
  • Raise the engineering bar
  • Machine Learning as Part of the Role
    • Frame problems correctly: when to use ML vs deterministic systems
    • Work with data end-to-end
    • Train, evaluate, and iterate on models
    • Build reproducible pipelines
    • Deploy models and monitor performance, drift, and cost
    • Debug system + model failures

What We're Looking For

  • Strong CS fundamentals (DSA, OS, networking, distributed systems)
  • Solid probability and statistics
  • Experience building production systems at scale
  • Ability to move across languages (Go, Java, Python, Rust, SQL)
  • Understanding of system behavior under load and failure
  • Comfort with Linux, containers, Kubernetes
  • Strong debugging skills
  • Ability to reason using invariants and failure modes
  • Data systems, streaming systems, ML infrastructure, performance optimization

What We Value

  • Ownership over problems
  • Simplicity over complexity
  • Curiosity about internals
  • Robust design thinking
  • Clear communication

What Success Looks Like

  • Deliver working production systems from ambiguous problems
  • Apply ML only when needed
  • Build reliable, scalable systems
  • Reduce complexity
  • Earn trust in technical judgment

If you are a builder, a systems thinker, and a technologist who loves exploring what’s next, we’d love to have you help shape the future of Moniepoint.

What we can offer you

  • Culture - We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, paid leave plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

Our interview process is designed to be thoughtful, transparent, and candidate-friendly, allowing you to showcase your strengths while getting to know us better:

  • Initial Conversation:A brief introductory call with our recruiter to learn more about your background, career goals, and to share insights about the role and our team.

Outbound Sales Development Representative

Location: Candidates must currently reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Texas, or Virginia. This is a remote role.

Employment type: Full-time

Work authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship​.

About Tivly

Tivly is one of the largest marketplaces for commercial insurance in the United States, connecting business owners looking to protect their businesses with insurance carriers that fit their needs. Since 2009, Tivly has established a network of over 200 trusted carriers, agents, and brokers serving a wide range of businesses.

About the Role

Tivly connects business owners actively shopping for commercial insurance coverage with the right agents to serve them - starting with a weekly educational webinar. We're looking for an Outbound SDR to reach those decision-makers and get them in the room.



This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys talking to people, likes having a clear process to work within, and wants to build a sales career from the ground up. You don't need industry experience. You don't need a specific degree. And while previous sales experience is helpful, we're more interested in how you work.



We're looking for someone who is curious, coachable, organized, comfortable picking up the phone, and motivated enough to own their day.



You'll join an established outbound motion with prospect lists, CRM note templates, an AI-powered resource hub, and training already in place. Your job is to learn the system, execute it consistently, and help us identify ways to make it even better.

What You’ll Do

  • Make 100–150 outbound calls per day to prospective leads
  • Reach and engage decision-makers over the phone
  • Invite and secure commitments from qualified prospects to attend our weekly webinar
  • Follow established outreach cadences and call frameworks - this role is not about pitching or presenting; it's about consistent, disciplined booking
  • Personalize CRM notes using approved templates, updating variables per conversation
  • Use our AI chatbot and resource hub as your first line of support for questions, keeping downtime low
  • Maintain accurate records of every call, outcome, and next step in the CRM
  • Surface patterns, objections, and prospect feedback to sales leadership
  • Participate in regular 1:1 coaching focused on development and performance
  • Adapt as messaging and workflows evolve based on what we're learning


Technology You'll Use

This is a systems-driven role supported by AI-assisted tools, so baseline technology comfort is important. You should be comfortable with:

  • CRM systems and accurate data entry
  • Professional email and calendar management
  • AI-powered support/chatbot tools
  • Browser-based applications, working across multiple systems
  • Video conferencing tools (Zoom, Google Meet, or similar)

Experience with automation or workflow tools such as Zapier is a plus, but not required. More important: you're comfortable learning new technology and troubleshooting basic issues independently.

What You Bring

Previous experience in any of the following is helpful, but not required:

  • Business Development / Sales Development
  • Inside or outbound sales
  • Lead generation or appointment setting
  • Customer service with a strong communication component

We believe sales skills can be taught. We're more interested in finding someone with the aptitude, work habits, and hunger to learn them.

Core Competencies

There isn't one personality type that makes a great SDR. We're looking for someone who can stay consistent through high call volume and real rejection, call after call.

For this role, there are a few things we consider essential:

  • Hungry: Genuinely motivated by the idea that your results determine your earnings
  • Coachable: You welcome feedback and put it into practice
  • Curious: You ask questions and want to understand the "why"
  • Resilient: You can handle repeated "no's" without losing energy or focus
  • Detail-oriented: You understand that good CRM data and documentation matter
  • Consistent: You're comfortable with the repetition required to get great at outbound
  • Disciplined: You can follow a defined process closely before trying to reinvent it
  • Comfortable on the phone: Outbound calling is the core of this position

How You'll Work

You'll receive structured onboarding, along with:

  • Targeted prospect lists
  • CRM note templates
  • Call frameworks
  • An AI-powered resource hub for first-line support
  • Direct coaching

You'll be expected to work within our established process while sharing what you're hearing from prospects. As you develop, we want you to become someone who helps us improve the system — not simply operate it.

Where This Role Can Lead

This position is a starting point, not a ceiling. As you demonstrate mastery and take on greater responsibility, there's real opportunity for advancement — including into roles such as:

  • Inside Sales Representative
  • Webinar hosting and presentations
  • Onboarding Specialist

Compensation grows alongside responsibility as you take on more. There's no fixed timeline for this - it's earned through demonstrated performance, not tenure.

How You're Paid

You'll earn a base salary of $45,000 plus commission. Commission is tied to converted webinar attendees - leads you book who attend and go on to become clients - not to sign-ups or attendance alone. This keeps your incentives aligned with real business outcomes, not just activity.

Benefits

We support our team with comprehensive benefits that promote health, balance, and financial well‑being, including:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Sick Time
  • Flexible Scheduling (Flex Time)
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for health and dependent care
  • Company‑paid Short‑ and Long‑Term Disability
  • No‑cost mental, emotional, and physical well‑being support through the First Stop Health app
  • 401(k) with 4% company match
  • Pay for designated holidays without having to work

Why Tivly?

You'll be joining a sales organization that believes good systems should make great people better. We're not hiring someone to reinvent our outbound strategy on day one. We're looking for someone who can learn what's already working, execute it consistently, ask good questions, and eventually help us make it better.

If you like clear expectations, meaningful autonomy, direct coaching, and the opportunity to grow as you prove yourself, we'd like to hear from you.

Inclusion: It's Simple, We All Belong

Tivly celebrates diversity and equality! We are committed to building a team with a diverse variety of experiences, talents, and perspectives. We believe that creating a culture where everyone can fit in and belong has a positive influence on our communities and our customers. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. Creating a culture of equality isn’t just the right thing to do; it’s what Tivly chooses to do.

jobs.title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Media buying is now the easy part. In 2026, the buying itself is piping.
jobs.description:
Media buying is now the easy part.

In 2026, the buying itself is piping. The levers that actually move a DTC account are creative, offer, and conversion rate, and the platform keeps getting better at rewarding whoever gets those right.

So we don't hire media buyers. We hire marketers who buy media.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands across our service lines, 20 to 25 of them on paid media, and we spend $6-9M a month on Meta. We're hiring one person to own a handful of those accounts end to end.

Here's what "end to end" actually means here.

You are the account manager. We don't have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership and accountability: when you're the person answering for the account, it's your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You are the creative strategist. You do the research, you find the angles, and you write the briefs and the scripts. You direct our editors and designers rather than filing requests with them. Creative isn't a ticket you submit. It's your job.

You build the things the account needs. If conversion rate is the bottleneck, you build the landing page. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You carry up to six accounts. That's the capacity we run at today, and the team averages about four and a half. You'll manage far fewer accounts than you would at most agencies. In exchange you get real ownership of the results and you get to work as an end to end marketer instead of one station on an assembly line.

You can live anywhere. We're a remote team and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you're the client's point of contact and there's nobody else to cover it. The rest of your day is yours.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we'll both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

Own 4 to 6 DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, the creative lead, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $30k/mo to $1M/mo.

Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you're the one who answers when something isn't working.

Run the research before the ads. Marketing is 80% research here. You mine customer reviews, ad comments, support tickets, and Reddit for the language and objections that become angles. You pull competitor ad libraries. You run our internal tooling that OCRs and transcribes the ads in your account and ties them to performance, so you know what winning and losing actually look like in this account.

Write the briefs and the scripts, and direct the work. Creative direction is yours. You run revision rounds with our editors and designers and you hold the quality bar.

Ship creative on a cadence. Roughly 8 to 10 new ad launches a week is where accounts hold, in batches every 1 to 1.5 weeks. Informed volume, not spray and pray. We want better hypotheses, not more randomness.

Build and test landing pages. Advertorials, comparison pages, PDPs. Built in Claude Code, deployed to Vercel, tested live on a subdomain before anything gets pushed into the client's theme.

Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.

Report on new customer economics. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended ROAS and not last click. You'll be expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.

You're a fit if

You've done this with real money. Hands-on Meta at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them.

You're AI-native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude (or equivalent) as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it. If you can research, write, and build a converting page from scratch, we can teach you the buying.

You can write direct response in English at a native or near-native level. Hooks, scripts, ad copy, advertorial. In the customer's own words, not invented. This is the single biggest source of leverage in the role and the thing we screen hardest for. If writing persuasive English isn't a strength, this isn't the job.

You can communicate your ideas. This matters as much as anything else on this list. You'll be in front of clients constantly with nobody in between, so you need to be able to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire.

You have taste and you know when to hand off. You direct creative, you don't half-build it yourself. AI slop shipped to a client is a habit we break, not a shortcut we accept.

You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.

Bonus: you've built or operated your own Shopify store or eComm brand. Several of our team have, and it shows.

You're not a fit if

  • "That wasn't my role" is in your vocabulary. It's the fastest way to end an interview here. If creative was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the creative.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.

Benefits

Why This Role Is Exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You will be surrounded by people who move fast, care a lot, and take the work seriously.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care through Counterpart Assistant, our technology platform for primary care. By supporting primary care physicians and their teams, we help identify patient needs earlier, make complex clinical information actionable, and support longitudinal management of chronic conditions.

As Senior Manager of UX Design for the Interventions Pillar, you will lead the team designing how clinical insight becomes action. Your portfolio will include decision support, treatment planning, intervention selection, treatment execution, care coordination, and longitudinal follow-through.

You will manage talented, experienced designers who already understand our product, systems, and clinical users deeply. Your role is to help them expand their strategic ownership, make stronger decisions through ambiguity, influence across the organization, and define the future of their domains.

AI will be an important part of this work. You will guide teams in applying AI where it can help clinicians synthesize information, evaluate options, plan care, and follow through—while preserving appropriate evidence, transparency, and clinical control.

Why this role?

The Interventions Pillar addresses a central challenge in healthcare: identifying an opportunity is not enough. Better outcomes require translating insight into an appropriate decision, treatment plan, action, and durable follow-through.

This role is an opportunity to:
● Shape how Counterpart supports consequential clinical decisions and treatment workflows.
● Develop senior designers into stronger strategic and organizational leaders.
● Define how AI can responsibly assist clinical reasoning and action.
● Connect clinical expertise, product strategy, design, and technology around measurable outcomes.

As a Senior Manager, UX Design, you will:

  • Lead the clinical UX strategy. Establish a coherent direction across clinical decision support, treatment planning, intervention selection, execution, coordination, and longitudinal follow-through.
  • Develop senior design talent. Coach experienced designers to lead through ambiguity, define strategy, make high-quality trade-offs, influence senior stakeholders, and increase their impact beyond their immediate product areas.
  • Advance AI-enabled clinical workflows. Help teams determine where AI should synthesize information, generate options, recommend next steps, automate work, or remain out of the workflow. Establish expectations for evidence, uncertainty, human oversight, review, and correction.
  • Create strong cross-functional decisions. Partner with Clinical, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Research leaders to connect clinical needs, model capabilities, user evidence, technical constraints, and business priorities.
  • Raise the quality and effectiveness of execution. Strengthen critique, research synthesis, clinical review, prototyping, evaluation, and learning practices so teams can move efficiently without oversimplifying consequential problems.

Success in this role looks like:This leader will bring deep expertise in clinical-product design while creating strategic alignment and design leverage across the Interventions pods.

  • In the first 90 days, establish leadership and strategic alignment by building strong partnerships with product directors, ensuring balanced workloads, and embedding design as a critical part of business strategy. Success will be measured by stakeholder feedback, stronger design integration, and improved operational effectiveness.
  • In the first 6 months, focus on delivering impact by deepening user understanding, embedding research insights into design decisions, and pushing for best-in-class UX. Accelerate iteration cycles, reducing time-to-insight by 30%, while fostering a culture of experimentation and autonomy. Guide the team in complex problem-solving, balancing constraints, and proactively shaping solutions.
  • Beyond six months, scale strategic impact and industry influence by positioning design as a key business driver, ensuring UX directly contributes to engagement, provider adoption, and overall user experience. You will push for consumer-grade, next-gen experiences that redefine digital healthcare while strengthening team expertise, fostering strategic thinking, and elevating design’s role in product direction. Success will be measured by design’s ability to drive best-in-class UX, shape industry standards, and create tangible product improvements that shift user expectations.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have 7+ years of design experience in a design environment (in-house, agency, or relevant industry), with 5+ years of managing people.
  • You have led complex, high-consequence workflows in healthcare or another expert professional domain.
  • You bring strong judgment in interaction design, information design, research, and product strategy— and know how to coach others without taking over their work. You can demonstrate how you have helped experienced designers grow from strong executors into strategic decision-makers and organizational leaders.
  • You have experience with AI-enabled products or can demonstrate sound judgment about recommendations, automation, evidence, uncertainty, and human oversight.
  • You have experience in complex systems and applications, knowing how to simplify the complex and create delightful, intuitive experiences.
  • You are an advocate for collaboration, working closely with product and engineering to ensure design is a driver of business outcomes, not just execution.
  • You are excited about shaping the future of healthcare UX – bringing the same level of quality and innovation seen in leading consumer products to an industry that desperately needs it.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents

About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.
