The Opportunity:

The Senior Compliance Solutions Engineer is the technical owner and primary engineer for an enterprise compliance and investigation platform built on Microsoft Power Platform. Power Pages provides the application and identity foundation, but this is not a traditional low-code role: the platform includes a substantial custom JavaScript application layer, custom HTML/CSS/Liquid, Dataverse, Power Automate, custom APIs/plugins, and supporting automation. The engineer is responsible for continuing to build, enhance, secure, document, and support the platform across the full software-development lifecycle.


This role uses modern agentic AI coding tools as a core engineering workflow. The engineer will use Claude Code and other AI tools to accelerate architecture, implementation, refactoring, debugging, testing, documentation, and delivery while remaining accountable for the correctness, security, maintainability, and supportability of the resulting code. The successful candidate will combine strong technical judgment with the ability to translate compliance and audit needs into scalable, user-friendly technology solutions.


Essential Job Functions:

  • Serve as the technical owner for the compliance solutions platform, translating business requirements into solution architecture, development plans, production releases, and ongoing enhancements.
  • Design, build, and maintain custom Power Pages experiences that rely on substantial JavaScript rather than only standard low-code forms; develop and troubleshoot asynchronous client-side logic, Dataverse Web API calls, OData/FetchXML queries, dynamic rendering, validation, file handling, and workflow-driven user experiences.
  • Design and evolve Dataverse tables, relationships, configuration data, metadata-driven features, forms, views, security roles, web roles, table permissions, and other data-governance controls.
  • Develop and maintain Power Automate workflows for case processing, approvals, notifications, contributor requests, imports, synchronization, AI-assisted processing, escalations, and operational monitoring.
  • Develop server-side extensions when low-code capabilities are insufficient, including Dataverse plugins/custom APIs using C# and related integration patterns.
  • Create and maintain supporting automation using PowerShell, TypeScript/Office Scripts, Excel/VBA, REST APIs, JSON, and other scripting technologies when needed for migration, administration, testing, reconciliation, or operational support.
  • Use Claude Code and/or OpenAI Codex as an integrated development environment for repo-level engineering work, including solution decomposition, multi-file code changes, debugging, refactoring, test generation, code review, documentation, and Git-based development workflows.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code before deployment; identify insecure, inefficient, brittle, incorrect, or unnecessarily complex implementations and improve them to production standards.
  • Integrate Power Platform solutions with enterprise services and data sources such as Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Workday, Excel, APIs, SQL/data platforms, and other internal or third-party systems.
  • Maintain source control, solution packaging, environment-specific configuration, ALM/deployment processes, release discipline, and technical documentation so changes can be understood, tested, promoted, and supported reliably.
  • Perform hands-on production support and root-cause analysis across Power Pages, Dataverse, Power Automate, identity/security, integrations, custom JavaScript, plugins, and supporting scripts.
  • Plan and execute developer testing, regression testing, role/security testing, integration testing, data-validation testing, UAT support, defect correction, and post-deployment validation.
  • Support historical and ongoing data migration activities, including source-to-target mapping, transformation, cleansing, backloads, reconciliation, and business validation.
  • Maintain architecture documentation, data-model documentation, module/page documentation, implementation guides, migration documentation, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks; use AI to accelerate documentation while keeping it accurate and current.
  • Partner with Compliance, Privacy, Internal Audit, IT, and business stakeholders to understand investigation and operational pain points and identify opportunities to automate repetitive work, improve data quality, and reduce investigation cycle time.
  • Develop and support AI-enabled capabilities such as case summarization, structured narrative generation, intelligent guidance, classification, and other approved uses of generative AI within compliance workflows.
  • Provide user support, technical guidance, training, and knowledge transfer to help operational teams effectively adopt new capabilities.
  • Demonstrate collaboration, accountability, trust, initiative, inclusion, customer focus, innovation, and a consistent commitment to excellence.

Employment Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may substitute for a degree.
  • 7 to 10 years of relevant experience in application development, solution engineering, enterprise systems, or comparable technical roles.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Microsoft Power Platform experience, including Dataverse and Power Automate; meaningful Power Pages development experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of JavaScript and modern browser application development. The candidate must be able to read, troubleshoot, modify, test, and safely deploy substantial custom JavaScript applications, including code originally generated or accelerated by AI.
  • Demonstrated experience taking ambiguous business requirements from concept through architecture, development, testing, release, and production support.
  • Experience with Git/source control and disciplined software-development practices.
  • Experience leading technical workstreams, mentoring others, or acting as the primary technical owner for an application or platform is preferred.

Required AI-Augmented Development Experience:

  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience using at least one agentic coding environment - Claude Code or OpenAI Codex - to deliver real software changes in a repository. General chatbot use, prompt-only assistance, or generating isolated code snippets does not satisfy this requirement.
  • Experience using Claude Code or Codex for multi-file implementation, debugging, refactoring, code review, test creation, documentation, and source-control workflows, with the ability to explain specific production work completed using the tool.
  • Ability to direct AI agents effectively by decomposing complex work, supplying appropriate repository and business context, reviewing proposed changes, iterating when results are incomplete, and validating the final implementation.
  • Strong engineering judgment when working with AI-generated code, including the ability to recognize hallucinated APIs, security weaknesses, broken assumptions, regressions, performance problems, and maintainability concerns.
  • Commitment to using approved AI tools responsibly and in accordance with organizational security, privacy, data-handling, and software-development requirements.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Advanced Power Pages development, including custom JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Liquid, Dataverse Web API, OData, FetchXML, authentication patterns, web roles, and table permissions.
  • Strong Power Automate skills, including expressions, nested control flow, child flows, error handling, retries, idempotent processing, scheduled automation, and integration patterns.
  • Strong Dataverse design skills, including relational modeling, alternate keys, lookups, metadata/configuration-driven design, security, and performance considerations.
  • Working knowledge of C# and Dataverse plugins/custom APIs, or the ability to maintain and extend existing .NET server-side components with AI assistance and appropriate code review.
  • Working knowledge of PowerShell, TypeScript/Office Scripts, Excel/VBA, SQL, REST APIs, JSON, and data-transformation techniques.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Workday, Azure services, and enterprise identity/integration patterns.
  • Experience with Power Platform ALM, solution packaging, environment variables, PAC CLI, deployment profiles, CI/CD concepts, and environment promotion.
  • Experience with data migration, reconciliation, historical data conversion, and validation of high-volume or sensitive business data.
  • Strong testing and troubleshooting skills across UI, workflow, integration, permissions, data, and production-support scenarios.
  • Ability to create and maintain high-quality technical documentation, architecture decisions, runbooks, and implementation guidance in Markdown or comparable formats.
  • Experience with Copilot Studio, AI Builder, Azure/OpenAI services, or other enterprise AI capabilities is beneficial but secondary to hands-on agentic software development experience.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA, SOX, privacy, compliance, audit, investigations, access controls, and regulated-data handling is preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work directly with business stakeholders, challenge assumptions constructively, explain technical decisions, and independently drive work to completion.
  • Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.
  • This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.

Description

Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

We are looking for an Application Security Engineer to own product security end to end — from threat modelling and secure design reviews to vulnerability management and security controls embedded into CI/CD.

You will work closely with product and platform teams to make security part of the engineering process, building secure defaults and helping prevent vulnerabilities from reaching production without slowing development down.

What you will do

  • Own application and product security end to end, from design reviews and threat modelling to vulnerability remediation and follow-up.
  • Partner with product and platform teams to embed security into the development lifecycle rather than treat it as a final review step.
  • Build and improve security controls in CI/CD, including SAST, dependency, secrets, container, and IaC scanning.
  • Review application designs and code where security risk is meaningful, and turn recurring findings into secure defaults, shared libraries, lint rules, and CI gates.
  • Drive vulnerability management across application code and cloud posture, including triage, risk-based prioritisation, remediation timelines, and external pentest findings.
  • Strengthen security in multitenant B2B systems, including tenant isolation, authentication, authorization, RBAC / ABAC, and access controls.
  • Work on cloud and Kubernetes security across AWS environments, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
  • Help translate GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 requirements into practical engineering controls and system properties.
  • Develop and support a security champions programme to help engineering teams adopt secure practices in their day-to-day work.
  • Address security risks specific to AI and LLM-powered features, including prompt injection, data leakage, and untrusted model output.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on Application Security or Product Security.
  • Strong software engineering background with the ability to read, review, and write production code; Python experience is highly preferred.
  • Deep practical knowledge of web application security, including OWASP Top 10, ASVS, authentication and session management, OAuth2 / OIDC / SAML, and authorization issues such as IDOR and broken access control.
  • Experience securing multitenant or B2B SaaS products, including tenant isolation, RBAC / ABAC, and access control models.
  • Hands-on experience embedding security into CI/CD, including SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container scanning, and IaC scanning.
  • Strong experience with threat modelling, secure design reviews, and secure code reviews in collaboration with product and engineering teams.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities based on risk, criticality, and exploitability, including remediation prioritisation and escalation when needed.
  • Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes security, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and auditors.
  • Fluent Russian and English at B2 level or above.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building a DevSecOps practice from scratch.
  • Experience running or participating in a Security Champions programme.
  • Hands-on penetration testing experience.
  • Experience securing LLM-powered or AI products.
  • Experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 from an engineering perspective.
  • Knowledge of software supply chain security, including SBOMs, SLSA, image signing, or similar practices.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 4000-6000 EUR Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

We're adding a director of data and platform architecture to a small, high-leverage AI engineering team.   • Translate business and executive priorities into data strategy and architecture decisions, so technical investments map directly to what the business needs next. You own the outcome of those decisions.

Education/Experience/Competencies

About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

The Business Process Lead, Order to Cash owns the end-to-end design of the business processes that run from order acceptance through cash collection and recognized revenue. This role is the connective tissue between the business stakeholders who operate these processes and the technology teams that build supporting systems, and is accountable for the detailed capability decomposition of this value stream. Process design decisions in this role have direct consequences for billing accuracy, revenue recognition, and financial reporting integrity, and the role carries a corresponding financial control responsibility.

Importantly, this role owns the business capabilities in this value stream — their definition, design, decomposition, and governance — in close partnership with the business teams that operate the underlying functions day to day. It does not own those functions themselves; success depends on heavy partnership with business and technology leads rather than on direct authority. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role: the person hired personally facilitates working sessions, maps processes, writes requirements, and stays engaged through delivery and adoption. It also sits within a newly created function whose operating model and standards are still being defined, giving the person hired real influence over how the broader practice takes shape. The role holds several formal agreements with peer process owners covering shared boundaries, and maintaining those agreements is a core, ongoing part of the job rather than an occasional task.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and continuously maintain a detailed (L2/L3) decomposition of order and subscription management, software provisioning and fulfillment, usage consumption and rating, billing and invoicing, invoice-to-cash, and revenue recognition capabilities, keeping documentation accurate as the operating model and systems landscape evolve, and using standards shared across the Business Process Lead team.
  • Facilitate structured working sessions with business stakeholders across this value stream to document how processes work today and design how they should work going forward, producing process maps, documented decisions, and requirements a technical team can act on without extensive follow-up.
  • Translate future-state process designs into system requirements, partner with Product Owners and Engineering Leads through design, build, and testing, and confirm that what gets delivered reflects the intended process design.
  • Support two parallel delivery tracks — current, in-production systems and the next-generation platform build — correctly identifying which track an incoming request belongs to, and ensuring lessons learned in day-to-day operations are reflected back into documentation and forward-looking design work.
  • Own change management, enablement, and adoption for process changes in this value stream — stakeholder impact assessment, readiness planning, training materials, and post-launch verification that new processes are being used as intended — and define and report the process performance metrics that show whether they are working.
  • Hold and maintain documented agreements at shared boundaries with peer Business Process Leads, so handoffs between value streams are explicitly agreed rather than assumed.
  • Own the capability design for software provisioning and fulfillment — manual provisioning, provisioning error handling, feature enablement, software suspension and reinstatement, and trial extension — partnering with the teams who operate those processes.
  • Own the capability design for usage consumption and rating, including overage management and how rated usage flows into billing and revenue treatment.

Required Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of revenue recognition standards (ASC 606) and subscription billing mechanics, with the demonstrated ability to reason independently through how a mid-contract order change flows to invoicing, revenue schedules, and unbilled or deferred revenue balances. This is a firm screening requirement given the financial control responsibilities of the role, not a general preference.
  • 5+ years of experience in business process design, business analysis, business architecture, or operations in a relevant domain.
  • Demonstrated experience decomposing business capabilities into detailed, multi-level structures.
  • Strong facilitation skills with cross-functional business stakeholders, including experience working at a director level, and comfort holding formal cross-functional agreements with peer process owners rather than treating a boundary handoff as a one-time conversation.
  • Experience translating business process requirements into system requirements or work items for a technical delivery team, along with strong documentation habits.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with contract modification accounting and its process implications in a subscription business.
  • Billing operations, collections, or revenue accounting process design experience.
  • Experience with consumption or usage-based billing and rating models, including how overages are handled and billed.
  • Experience with software provisioning, license entitlement, or feature enablement process ownership.
  • Indirect tax process design experience, including taxability determination, nexus, and exemption certificate management.
  • Prior experience partnering with a shared platform engineering team on roadmap sequencing and prioritization.
  • Experience with Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced, a dedicated revenue recognition engine such as RightRev, Oracle and NetSuite, and indirect tax engines such as OneSource or CertifyTax.

You'll be the bridge between complex technical value and business outcomes, driving Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) and Professional Services bookings by converting marketing-generated leads into qualified opportunities and building your own pipeline through proactive prospecting.

  • Manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to close, across your assigned territory.
  • Understand and articulate how Revalize's Pipe-Flo platform solves engineering challenges in fluid system modeling and energy optimization.
  • Deliver compelling, technically credible product demos and presentations via web and in-person meetings.

Preferences/Nice to have

  • Prior hands-on experience with hydraulic modeling, piping design, or fluid system simulation software
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in technical or engineering-driven B2B sales, ideally within industrial, fluid systems, or process engineering markets.
  • Master's degree in Mechanical or Chemical Engineering.
  • Comfortable in a high-activity, KPI-driven sales environment.

On-Target Earnings $150-000-$170,000 per year with uncapped commissions.

Washington, DC Metro Area preferred. Open to remote.

We're hiring a BDR who treats an empty pipeline as a problem to solve.

This is a pure outbound role. You'll go after enterprise accounts - major brands and agencies - and get senior decision-makers to take the meeting. The accounts are big, the buyers are senior, and the product is one you can sell with real conviction.

Resonate is a predictive consumer intelligence company. Our data and AI tell marketers what people are going to do before they do it: what they'll buy, what they care about, and what will move them to act. Companies use it to win customers their competitors never saw coming. Your job is to get those companies on the phone.

What you'll do

  • Build pipeline through outbound - cold calls, personalized email, LinkedIn, account-based Fplays. Whatever gets the meeting.
  • Research target accounts and find the people who actually make the call.
  • Book qualified meetings with enterprise buyers and hand your AEs real opportunities, not noise.
  • Hit your number every month, then beat it.
  • Work with Marketing and Account Executives to pick which accounts to go after and how.
  • Bring back what you hear in the field, so we sharpen the pitch and the targeting.

Who wins here

  • You'd rather pick up the phone than wait for a lead to land in your inbox.
  • A "no" just means you haven’t found the right angle yet.
  • You're organized enough to run a territory or vertical, not just work a to-do list.
  • You want clear targets and a way to measure how you’re doing.
  • You learn a complex product fast and explain it simply.
  • You own your results - the wins and the misses.

What you bring

  • Experience in outbound sales, BDR/SDR, or demand gen. Bonus if it was MarTech, or selling to marketing, insights, research, or analytics buyers.
  • A track record of hitting quota and a story about the quarter you blew past it.
  • Comfort with Salesforce, LinkedIn, and ZoomInfo.
  • Sharp listening skills. The best at this ask better questions, they don't just talk more.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred, not required.

What's in it for you

  • Base salary plus uncapped commission. The more you book, the more you make.
  • Direct partnership with your Account Executives on target accounts. You'll see the full sales process up close and learn what separates a good seller from a great one.

Compensation & Benefits

At Resonate you'll work with smart, down-to-earth people on AI-powered data and identity products that are changing how the marketing industry works. Resonate is a leading provider of high-quality, AI-powered consumer data, intelligence, and technology, empowering marketers to create a more personalized world that increases customer acquisition and lifetime value. These attributes are the foundation of how we work and grow together!

jobs.description:
Our Opportunity:

The Associate Dean will provide support to Purdue University Global’s College of Social and Behavioral Sciences and School of Aviation. Building on Purdue University's mission to provide greater access to affordable, high-quality education, Purdue University Global is a public, nonprofit institution offering a world-class education online.

Job Summary:

The Associate Dean, in collaboration with the Dean and Vice President, is responsible for the oversight and leadership of all the programs and activities within their scope, with an emphasis on program innovation and student persistence. This role focuses on strategy to ensure the school meets its academic and financial goals, including but not limited to student & faculty persistence, program quality & growth, and creating a supportive environment which provides students a clear path to graduation.

The Associate Dean selects, hires, manages performance, and supports Academic Department Chairs, Program Chairs, and Chairs of Special Projects. This includes the training and orientation of new chairs, supporting chairs in the management of their faculty and programs, and providing opportunities for chair and faculty professional development.

The Associate Dean participates in intra school and interdisciplinary activities and initiatives. The role collaborates with curriculum to assess program needs and development of courses.

The Associate Dean currently supports the following programs: Public Safety, Legal Studies and Aviation.

What to expect in this role:

Responsible for the oversight and coordination of all the programs and activities that support student and faculty recruitment, education and persistence of the school/college:

  • Provides direction to ensure the college/school’s overall goals and missions are aligned with and supportive of the PG strategic missions and goals.

  • Works collaboratively with counterparts within his/her/their college/school and other colleges/schools within PG or the Purdue University family to realize new academic programs and ensure that support services, academic courses and programs meet the needs of faculty members and students.

  • Follows best practices in the management and oversight of programs and initiatives.

  • Develops and implements strategies and methods to grow the college/school with particular emphasis on the bachelor and master degrees and improving the conversion rate of bachelor students into the graduate degree programs.

  • Maintains, interprets and executes administrative procedures and practices, including but not limited to the procedures, rules and standards for the college/school.

  • Contributes to the overall success of the college/school through positive, collaborative relationships with peers and external departments.

  • Responsible for managing and reporting on appropriate school metrics.

Supervises the Academic Department Chairs, Assistant Chairs and faculty:

  • Develops a strong leadership team of Academic Chairs, Assistant Chairs, and other academic staff members to ensure expeditious course scheduling, optimum use of faculty, and resolution of administrative issues.

  • Ensures the recruitment, training and development of qualified faculty. Works with Chairs to ensure faculty understand job expectations and receive performance feedback throughout the year.

  • Coordinates with Assistant Deans of Curriculum (ADoC) to ensure Chairs and faculty are trained on development and deployment of degree plans and programs including the designation of Course Leads and supporting Course Level Assessments.

Ensures meaningful support and engagement of students:

  • Works collaboratively with Academic Department/Program Chairs in addressing academic issues and student complaints.

  • Works with Student Affairs or other appropriate resources to resolve issues for students facing academic, professional and/or financial challenges.

  • Monitors student attendance and retention. Works with Chairs, faculty and other departments to ensure students receive the appropriate level of support.

Experience:

  • Doctoral Degree in a relevant field from a regionally accredited university.
  • 7+ years experience in Higher Education, preferably in a remote or online environment in a relevant discipline.
  • Plus 3 to 5 years experience teaching at the postsecondary level, with a history of demonstrated leadership roles in an educational setting.
  • Proven background in student & faculty persistence, specifically with program quality & student growth.

What we're looking for:

  • Demonstrated leadership with a proven ability to train, supervise, motivate, and evaluate employees/staff/faculty.
  • Capability to prioritize multiple demands with attention to detail.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively communicate with a professional demeanor with people at all levels within the organization.
  • Extensive knowledge of curriculum development and academic policy; possess required knowledge of best practices in higher education pedagogy.
  • Thinks strategically, effectively analyzing data and implementing data-informed, student-centered decisions.
  • Ability to adapt to changing technologies and policy requirements.
  • Exceptional computer skills using Microsoft Office applications, Google, and Zoom or similar meeting technology.
  • Capable of building strong working relationships across teams, departments and Schools.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and discretion at all times.

Additional Information:

  • The target salary for this position is $110,000, learn about our Benefits HERE!
  • Priority will be given to applicants that apply by August 24, 2026
  • Purdue University Global will not sponsor employment authorization for this position.
  • A background check will be required for employment in this position.
  • We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. You may wish to review the Purdue Virtual Meeting Professional Standards.
  • FLSA: Exempt (Not Eligible For Overtime) This position is generally classified as exempt unless a non-exempt classification is required by applicable state law.
  • Purdue Global is an EEO/AA employer. Our goal is to recruit and retain talent from a broad pool of applicants. Purdue Global celebrates a variety of perspectives, experiences, and skills to support a success-focused environment for employees and students. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. All are encouraged to apply.

jobs.excerpt: Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across platforms such as Meta and UAC, and will later move into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Spanish localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.

Key Responsibilities

  • Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series.
  • Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance
  • Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series.
  • Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production.
  • Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series.
  • Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Spanish.
  • Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Spanish audience.
  • Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market.
  • Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts.
  • Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity.
  • Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments.
  • Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction.
  • Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery
  • Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required.
  • Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute.
  • Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed.
  • Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution.
  • Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement.
  • Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization.
  • Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos.
  • Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration
  • Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams.
  • Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines.
  • Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets.
  • Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization
  • Use GenAI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement.
  • Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards.
  • Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content.
  • Excellent command of Spanish, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences.
  • Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Spanish.
  • Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers.
  • Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred.

jobs.excerpt: UX and UI Design• User experience (UX) refers to the user’s journey when interacting with a product or service.
jobs.description:
UX and UI Design

  • User experience (UX) refers to the user’s journey when interacting with a product or service. UX design is the process of creating products or services that provide meaningful experiences for users, involving many different areas of product development including branding, usability, function, and design.
  • UI design, on the other hand, refers to the actual interfaces with which users engage. The UI design process may include buttons or widgets, text, images, sliders, and other interactive elements. UI designers ensure that every visual element, transition, and animation included within a product or service is setting the stage for a fluid, positive experience.
  • Since UX and UI designers often work closely together, it’s common for UX and UI to be confused with one another — even though they represent different components of a product or service’s design. While there is some overlap between the two roles, there are several key differences to consider.

⚡️ Our Stack

As one of the first senior engineering hires in the company, you will have a lot of freedom and agency to choose and work with the technology you love. Our tech stack includes:

  • Infra & monitoring: AWS (ECS, Postgres), Datadog, Sentry…
  • Languages & Frameworks: Typescript (Node.js), NestJs, Rails
  • Other day-to-day Tools: Notion, Slack, Jira, GitHub, and more

🚀 Product

Our integration platform is unique for SaaS because:

  • It’s easy and fast. To add dozens of integrations, you only need to integrate once with our unified API and we take care of the rest. This is way faster, cheaper, and more reliable than building every integration to each tool one at a time (it can take weeks/months per integration).
  • We enrich and standardize APIs: Don’t worry about the headache of figuring out how every tool’s API works. We add features that don’t exist out of the box (like using filters in your query or triggering a webhook when data changes) and make all APIs behave in the same consistent way. It’s easier and better to go through StackOne than to connect to the tools directly.
  • Extreme security and privacy: We will soon be SOC2 certified, we have data residency options for GDPR compliance, and more features to protect your customers’ data.

About Us

We are developing a next-gen API platform that allows SaaS businesses of any size to integrate their product with third-party products in a fast, powerful, and secure way.

🎖️ Our vision

The number of SaaS companies is exploding. But making great integrations is still too expensive and slow. We are building StackOne to solve this and become the platform that powers a connected ecosystem of apps that customers love.

💪 Well-funded and backed by top-tier angels and VCs, we're now growing extremely rapidly and we are currently raising a multi-million dollar round. We're seeking talented and driven individuals who can help us achieve our vision and continue to grow the product and the overall company at a record pace.

jobs.title: Head of Customer Account Management
jobs.excerpt: Our MissionSwapcard is the leading AI-powered event platform designed to drive revenue growth and foster meaningful connections at in-person and hybrid events.
jobs.description:
Our Mission

Swapcard is the leading AI-powered event platform designed to drive revenue growth and foster meaningful connections at in-person and hybrid events. We recognize the importance of teamwork in successful events; that's why Swapcard is fueled by a team of innovators who are passionate about helping organizers build future-proof events.

Our Vision

At Swapcard, we believe in the power of meaningful connections. This belief fuels our commitment to pioneering modern solutions that empower organizers to create engaging event experiences.
Guided by our commitment to excellence and collaboration, we aim to redefine the landscape of event technology, setting new standards for engagement, accessibility, and impact.

Our Beliefs

At Swapcard, diversity is at the core of our success. With 42 nationalities represented among our 180+ team members, we champion diversity as a catalyst for creativity, collaboration, and unparalleled innovation.
We believe that by embracing a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and viewpoints, we can truly understand and cater to the needs of our global community of event organizers and participants.
Our full remote opportunities empower our team to thrive, no matter where they are in the world, fostering a culture of flexibility and inclusion.

Swapcard is the platform behind some of the largest trade shows, conferences and association events in the world, and our Customer Account Managers own the relationship with the organisers who run them.

We're investing in the next stage of that relationship: growth. Our clients don't run one event — they run portfolios, sometimes more than a hundred events, each with its own calendar, its own team and its own decision points. Growing alongside them at that scale is a discipline in its own right: a repeatable motion, a shared qualification standard, and a rhythm built around the client's event cycle rather than our fiscal quarters.

The CAM team sits inside our Customer organisation, alongside Solution Design, Implementation and Support. Whoever leads it works shoulder to shoulder with the teams that scope, deliver and support everything the CAMs sell.

Today, two team leads run the CAM function reporting directly into leadership. As we accelerate the growth motion, we want a single senior leader to bring that work together — someone who builds the playbook with the team, coaches them on live calls, and holds a clear analytical view of where the opportunity sits. That's the role.

Scope

  • Portfolio. 500+ events across our installed base, run by organisers whose portfolios range from a handful of events to well over a hundred.
  • Team. 10+ people spread between the US and Europe. Two CAM leads report to you directly who run the rest of the team.
  • Target. +20% growth on the installed base, delivered through an account-based strategy.
  • Two levers. Higher penetration of each client's event portfolio, and upsell of digital add-ons and additional modules on the events already running on Swapcard.
  • Mandate. Renew, expand, and prevent churn and downsell.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the CAM team. You'll lead the Customer Account Manager teams across North America and EMEA through your Strategic Account Managers and Team Leads, and set the standard for the wider CAM organisation.
  • Own the number. Carry the +20% growth target and build the account-based plan behind it: which accounts, which events inside their portfolio, which modules, in which order, and what has to be true for each to land.
  • Protect the base. Churn and downsell are rarely a surprise to someone who is looking. Build the early-warning discipline, get ahead of the competitive and budget conversations, and treat renewal as a managed motion rather than a date on a calendar.
  • Build the growth motion. Shape the qualification standard the team works to, the criteria that let an opportunity enter the forecast, and the discipline that keeps the picture current. You'll define what counts as good evidence and help the team hold to it consistently.
  • Coach on live calls. Join discovery calls alongside the CAMs, debrief together afterwards, and help shape how the next conversation goes. This is where most of the value of the role sits. We expect a lot of hands-on coaching.
  • Own the KPIs and the weekly rhythm. Activity, contact creation, qualification progress, outreach, forecast. You'll build the pack, read it before anyone else does, and bring attention to where it's needed early rather than explaining it late.
  • Run the enablement programme. Build it, run it, and certify the team on real accounts. Enablement here is a line responsibility that sits with you, not something handed off.
  • Align the system. Marketing, Revenue Ops, Sales Enablement, Solution Design and Product. An account-based motion only works when those move together, and making that happen is your job rather than someone else's favour.
  • Partner with Marketing on account-based campaigns. Work as Marketing's counterpart rather than a requester — personas, account selection, sequencing against each client's event cycle, and an honest, shared read of what worked.
  • Influence the roadmap. Bring structured insight from the account base back to Product: what's blocking expansion, what competitors are winning on, what the industry is moving toward. Opinions with evidence behind them, early enough to shape what gets built.
  • Keep the data trustworthy. Account context, classification, CRM hygiene. A stale account brief is worth a real conversation with the team, because the whole motion depends on the data being sound.
  • Escalate what matters, early. Surface what stands between a client and a decision — product, commercial terms or timing — with the evidence attached and early enough for the decision to change the outcome.

What we're looking for

  • A growth builder in SaaS. You've delivered growth of this order inside an existing SaaS customer base — qualification, cadence, forecast, expansion pipeline — not just managed a book of accounts well. No event industry experience needed. We can teach you the industry; we can't teach the motion.
  • Account-based, in practice. You've led, structured and implemented an account-based strategy for a SaaS business, with Marketing alongside you rather than downstream of you.
  • A complex seller. Long sales cycles, several business units inside the same account, top-down and bottom-up in parallel. You know how to find the blocker — budget, politics, product, timing — name it, and work it rather than wait it out.
  • An account manager who became a strong coach. You've carried a portfolio yourself, and you develop people in the moment: you can hear what's missing in a discovery call and help the CAM get there themselves next time.
  • A leader of distributed teams. You've managed managers and a fully distributed team across time zones, ideally between North America and Europe, and you set a standard others want to work to.
  • A systems thinker with an engineer's mindset. You think in processes, inputs and feedback loops. Strong analytically, fluent in data at portfolio level (CRM, complex spreadsheets), and very organised. Evidence, not instinct, is how you make and defend a call.
  • Direct. Straight to the point with your team and with clients. Comfortable in difficult customer conversations, willing to push back, and not afraid to ask the hard question early rather than discover the answer late.
  • Composed under pressure. You do your best work in a fast-moving, high-stakes commercial environment, and you keep the team steady when timelines compress around clients' event dates.
  • A clear, credible communicator. You report upward without being chased and you partner naturally across functions.
  • Useful, not essential: experience in events, media or B2B marketplaces, where the buying unit is an event and its date sets the deadline.
  • Experience: 7 to 10+ years in account management, customer success or commercial roles, including at least 3 managing managers or a distributed team.
  • Language: fluent English. French is a plus, not a requirement.

Swapcard’s Interview process

Our thorough interview process aims to identify exceptional talent to advance our mission while offering you a chance to explore your career potential at Swapcard.
1. Screening Interview with a recruiter from our people team.
2. A remote exercise to demonstrate and assess your skills.
3. Manager review with your future reporting manager
4. Leadership review with one of our department leaders
5. Reference check conducted by our people team
6. Offer

Swapcard's Values

🧠 Curious: We ask questions, try new things and take risks. We learn from one another and see mistakes as opportunities to grow—what matters most is how we react and learn from them. We are curious about what something is and why something is. Innovation thrives when curiosity drives.
🗝️ Value-Driven:At Swapcard, we focus on making each decision count by prioritising outcomes that create meaningful value for our customers, team members, and partners.
💚 Human:At Swapcard, being human means fostering empathy, openness, and diversity to create a caring and collaborative community. We’re driven by a strong team spirit and a shared goal of building meaningful connections—both through our product and within our team.
✊ Resilient:We embrace challenges with optimism, creativity, and adaptability, constantly seeking innovative solutions and opportunities for growth.
👑 Ownership: At Swapcard, we take responsibility and are accountable for our actions, driving success through initiative, trust, and accountability. True ownership means more than just completing tasks; it's about being proactive, investing ourselves fully in the outcomes, and fostering a culture of trust.

Benefits & Reasons to Join Swapcard

- International team with 40+ nationalities (more on the way!) 🌍
- Remote-first policy with headquarters in Paris 🗼
- Thriving startup with career growth opportunities 🪴
- Open-minded culture that appreciates differences 👽
- Feedback-driven, supportive & curious team with a DIY mindset 🤔 🛠
- Generous Paid Time Off to ensure you have time for what matters most ❤️🏡
- Remote perks designed to optimize your working experience 🎁
- In-person social gatherings to celebrate our achievements 🏝️
- 100% of your health insurance contribution paid by Swapcard 🏥
- Work-from-home budget (one-off contribution for equipment in addition to your initial equipment setup) 🖇️
- Co-working space budget to support remote work in professional environments 💼
- Learning budget to help you develop new and existing skills 🤓
- Mental health care initiatives to support your well-being 🧘

Equal Opportunity

Swapcard is committed to upholding equal employment practices and making merit-based employment decisions. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences to apply, regardless of race, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy status, age, marital status, and status as a veteran

About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs, and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate, and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value. By centralizing conversations, automation, intelligence, and customer operations into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity, and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily, with 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices, and over 1 million domain names supported. The architecture is built for performance, resilience, and long-term scalability.

Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads, and 20 million conversations for more than 1 million businesses. Behind those numbers are agencies, entrepreneurs, and SMBs building independence, expanding opportunity, and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Why This Role Exists

Voice is one of the highest-intent customer interaction channels for SMBs. Missed calls, delayed follow-ups, poor qualification, inconsistent appointment booking, and manual outbound outreach directly translate into lost revenue for local businesses and agencies.

HighLevel’s VoiceAI product is designed to change that.

VoiceAI enables businesses to deploy AI-powered voice agents that can answer inbound calls, hold natural conversations, collect customer information, book appointments, trigger workflows, send post-call summaries, and support both phone-based and browser-based voice experiences. VoiceAI also supports outbound calling from workflows for use cases like lead follow-up, appointment outreach, prospect engagement, and reactivation campaigns.

The Staff Product Manager – VoiceAI will own the strategy, execution, and quality bar for one of HighLevel’s most important AI products. This role sits at the intersection of AI agents, telephony, CRM, workflow automation, knowledge retrieval, compliance, analytics, and user experience.

You will be expected to deeply understand agencies, local businesses, call-heavy industries, and the real operational jobs that VoiceAI must perform: answer calls, qualify leads, route conversations, book appointments, follow up, summarize outcomes, and help businesses scale without adding headcount.

This is not a generic AI PM role. This is a hands-on, technically fluent, customer-obsessed product leadership role for someone who can build a reliable, scalable, commercially meaningful AI voice product inside a complex, high-volume SaaS platform.

Strategic Priorities

  • Make VoiceAI the default AI receptionist for SMBs: Build a product that reliably handles inbound calls, understands caller intent, answers questions, captures lead information, books appointments, and escalates when needed.

  • Scale outbound VoiceAI responsibly: Build workflow-driven outbound calling for lead follow-up, appointment reminders, reactivation, and prospect engagement while respecting platform limits, consent requirements, call quality, and compliance obligations. HighLevel’s current outbound VoiceAI supports workflow-based calls, up to 1,000 outbound VoiceAI calls per location per day, and time-zone-based scheduling between 8 AM and 8 PM based on the contact’s phone-number timezone.

  • Improve agent setup and time-to-value: Simplify agent creation, phone number assignment, prompt configuration, knowledge base selection, working hours, call actions, testing, and deployment so agencies can launch high-quality VoiceAI agents for clients quickly.

  • Drive call quality, reliability, and trust: Improve latency, interruption handling, speech recognition, natural conversation quality, escalation logic, call summaries, transcripts, recordings, and post-call workflows.

  • Deepen CRM and workflow integration: Ensure VoiceAI can update contact records, trigger workflows, generate summaries, collect structured fields, and feed downstream automation. VoiceAI currently supports post-call workflow triggers, email notifications, call summaries, contact information, transcripts, and actions taken.

  • Build VoiceAI as a platform capability: Advance public APIs, webhooks, call logs, agent configuration APIs, action APIs, voice catalog APIs, and developer-facing extensibility so agencies and developers can build repeatable voice agent solutions at scale.

  • Support multilingual and brand-personalized voice experiences: Expand use cases across languages, voices, locales, and branded voice experiences. HighLevel VoiceAI supports multi-language configuration and a voice library, and voice cloning is currently available in Labs for creating on-brand custom voices.

  • Own VoiceAI monetization and adoption: Work closely with Product Marketing, Support, Trial Experience, Implementation, Account Management, Affiliates, RevEx, and Finance to drive activation, usage, retention, packaging, and revenue for VoiceAI and AI Employee plans. VoiceAI is part of HighLevel’s AI pricing structure across pay-per-use, AI Employee Growth, and AI Employee Unlimited plans.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and success metrics for HighLevel VoiceAI.

  • Own the full VoiceAI product surface, including inbound calling, outbound calling, web/widget voice experiences, agent setup, prompt configuration, voice selection, call actions, testing, analytics, call logs, summaries, transcripts, and workflow integrations.

  • Deeply understand customer use cases across agencies, SMBs, and high-call-volume verticals such as home services, medical spas, fitness, legal, real estate, insurance, dental, automotive, and local professional services.

  • Translate customer problems into clear product requirements, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, launch plans, and measurable success metrics.

  • Partner closely with engineering on telephony architecture, LLM behavior, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency, call routing, retries, failure handling, observability, and infrastructure scalability.

  • Work with design to simplify VoiceAI setup, agent testing, debugging, prompt management, call review, and performance reporting.

  • Build strong integrations between VoiceAI, Contacts, Conversations, Calendars, Workflows, Opportunities, Payments, Knowledge Base, Custom Values, and AI Employee.

  • Improve the quality of AI agent behavior through better prompts, guardrails, prompt evaluation, knowledge retrieval, call simulations, QA workflows, and customer feedback loops.

  • Define instrumentation across activation, agent creation, test calls, phone number assignment, first successful call, call completion rate, booking rate, human escalation rate, workflow trigger rate, outbound answer rate, transcript quality, cost per successful outcome, revenue, retention, and support ticket trends.

  • Partner with Product Marketing on positioning, GTM, use-case packaging, launch readiness, help docs, enablement, and agency-facing education.

  • Partner with Support, Implementation, Trial Experience, Account Management, and Affiliates to identify friction, improve onboarding, reduce ticket volume, and make VoiceAI easier to sell, configure, and support.

  • Own compliance-sensitive product decisions around outbound calling, consent, KYC requirements, acceptable use, timezone restrictions, call recording, transcripts, data handling, and abuse prevention.

  • Use customer calls, support tickets, NPS/CSAT, ideas board feedback, usage analytics, and call quality reviews to continuously improve the product.

  • Act as the product thought partner to engineering leadership for VoiceAI architecture, platform extensibility, reliability, and scale.

What Success Looks Like

  • Agencies can launch useful VoiceAI agents for their clients quickly, without needing heavy technical setup or prompt engineering expertise.

  • VoiceAI becomes a meaningful revenue and retention driver inside the broader AI Employee offering.

  • Inbound VoiceAI reliably handles common SMB calls: FAQs, lead qualification, appointment booking, missed-call recovery, basic routing, and follow-up.

  • Outbound VoiceAI becomes a scalable and trusted workflow action for follow-up, reactivation, reminders, and lead conversion.

  • Customers see measurable business value: fewer missed calls, faster response times, more booked appointments, higher lead conversion, and reduced manual work.

  • VoiceAI quality improves consistently across latency, naturalness, interruption handling, accuracy, escalation, summaries, transcripts, and workflow outcomes.

  • Support tickets per active VoiceAI location decrease as setup, debugging, permissions, billing clarity, and documentation improve.

  • VoiceAI becomes more extensible through APIs, webhooks, reusable templates, marketplace assets, and better developer/admin tooling.

  • Internal teams clearly understand what VoiceAI does, how to sell it, how to support it, and how to measure success.

  • You are viewed as the strategic and executional anchor for VoiceAI across Product, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Support, Trial Experience, Implementation, Account Management, Affiliates, and RevEx.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 8–12 years of product management experience, with meaningful experience owning complex B2B SaaS, AI, communication, automation, CRM, or platform products.

  • Strong product judgment in AI-driven user experiences, especially where reliability, trust, latency, and outcome quality matter.

  • Strong customer empathy and ability to translate messy real-world use cases into simple, scalable product experiences.

  • Strong analytical ability. Can define metrics, diagnose funnel drop-offs, interpret product usage, and separate noisy feedback from real product problems.

  • High ownership and execution velocity. Comfortable operating in a fast-growth, remote-first, high-context environment.

  • Excellent written and asynchronous communication skills. Can write clear PRDs, crisp trade-off documents, launch notes, and executive updates.

  • Comfortable making hard prioritization calls across customer asks, quality improvements, revenue opportunities, technical debt, and compliance constraints.

Bonus Points For

jobs.excerpt: Engagement OverviewCambridge Spark is an education technology company that enables corporate and government organisations to achieve their business goals by educating their workforce with critical data transformation skills to succeed in the AI era.
jobs.description:
Engagement Overview

Cambridge Spark is an education technology company that enables corporate and government organisations to achieve their business goals by educating their workforce with critical data transformation skills to succeed in the AI era. We currently hold Cyber Essentials Plus and are seeking an independent, Fractional Chief Information Security Officer (vCISO) to define our strategic security direction and provide independent assurance.

This engagement is strictly deliverable-focused. You will not be integrating into our day-to-day operations or managing staff. Instead, you will provide senior, independent judgment and set the overarching security strategy, which will be executed by our internal IT & Systems Manager. This deliberate separation between control definition and operational execution ensures the objective assurance required by our regulated client base.

Key Deliverables & Outcomes

You will maintain full autonomy over how these outcomes are achieved as an external advisor, partnering with our Head of Engineering (acting SIRO) as your primary internal contact.

  • Security Strategy & Roadmap: Define a clear, costed security strategy and sequenced improvement roadmap tailored to our evolving estate, threat landscape, and risk appetite.
  • Risk & Assurance Stewardship: Architect a security-specific risk register and conduct regular, independent reviews of the control environment operated by the internal IT team.
  • Board Reporting: Deliver periodic board-level reporting on organisational risk.
  • Certification Direction: Deliver a formal, evidence-based recommendation on whether to pursue ISO 27001 or maintain Cyber Essentials Plus with a documented ISMS.
  • Incident Framework: Design an incident response framework, testing plans, escalation pathways, and playbooks. (Note: Hands-on involvement in a live serious incident will be treated as a separate, ad-hoc call-off engagement).
  • Client Assurance & Board Reporting: Mature the existing reusable security assurance evidence library for complex client due-diligence.

Operational Boundaries

To ensure unambiguous B2B boundaries and maintain focus on strategic deliverables, the following operational execution remains firmly with Cambridge Spark:

  • Execution & First Response: Hands-on operations (patching, endpoint hardening, configuration) and incident first-response are owned by our internal IT & Systems Manager.
  • Routine Questionnaires: Standard client security questionnaires will be completed by the internal team against the standards and evidence library you define.
  • Accountability & Compliance: Final accountability sits with our SIRO. Data protection (DPO duties) and AI compliance (e.g., EU AI Act classification) sit with internal compliance owners, whom you will advise on security overlaps.

Engagement Model & Commercials

This is a phased, fractional engagement designed around project deliverables rather than a fixed weekly schedule. The cadence will naturally follow the required outputs:

  • Setup Phase (~First 3 months): Estimated at 1.5 days per week (approx. 17–19 days total) to deliver the initial risk assessment, strategy, certification recommendation, and incident playbooks.
  • Transition Phase (Months 4–6): Tapering to approximately 2 days per month as the roadmap moves into internal execution and the first independent assurance reviews commence.
  • Steady State (Month 6 onwards): A lightweight retainer of 1–2 days per month for ongoing independent assurance, board reporting, and advisory services.
