jobs.description:
THE ORGANIZATION

The Charter School Growth Fund (CSGF) is a leading nonprofit venture philanthropy fund dedicated to identifying the nation’s best public charter schools, investing in their expansion, and helping to increase their impact. Our “portfolio” includes 200+ charter school networks that operate 1,700+ schools and serve more than 800,000 students. We are committed to expanding the impact of schools that are closing achievement and opportunity gaps. CSGF operates with the same strategies, discipline, and focus as a venture capital firm by awarding multi-year grants and loans to talented education entrepreneurs building networks of high-quality charter schools that enroll traditionally underserved students. Our goal is to serve 1,000,000 students by 2030 and 1.4 million by 2035.

This is an exciting time to join the Charter School Growth Fund. We are launching Fund V, our most ambitious fund yet, building on our 20-year track record of success. Fund V will add 250,000 new high-quality seats while helping our portfolio become durable, bedrock institutions in their communities for decades to come. We invest in the strongest charter leaders and networks in the country, and we partner closely with them to sustain excellent outcomes as they grow. Our portfolio continues to serve student populations of roughly 90% students of color and 75% students from low-income backgrounds, and we remain committed to being proximate to the lived experiences of the students and communities we serve.

THE ORGANIZATION

The Charter School Growth Fund (CSGF) is a leading nonprofit venture philanthropy fund dedicated to identifying the nation’s best public charter schools, investing in their expansion, and helping to increase their impact. Our “portfolio” includes 200+ charter school networks that operate 1,700+ schools and serve more than 725,000 students. We are committed to expanding the impact of schools that are closing achievement and opportunity gaps. CSGF operates with the same strategies, discipline, and focus as a venture capital firm by awarding multi-year grants and loans to talented education entrepreneurs building networks of high-quality charter schools that enroll traditionally underserved students. Our goal is to serve 1,000,000 students by 2030 and 1.4 million by 2035.

This is an exciting time to join the Charter School Growth Fund. We are launching Fund V, our most ambitious fund yet, building on our 20-year track record of success. Fund V will add 250,000 new high-quality seats while helping our portfolio become durable, bedrock institutions in their communities for decades to come. We invest in the strongest charter leaders and networks in the country, and we partner closely with them to sustain excellent outcomes as they grow. Our portfolio continues to serve student populations of roughly 90% students of color and 75% students from low-income backgrounds, and we remain committed to being proximate to the lived experiences of the students and communities we serve.

THE TEAM

The Seed Team at CSGF finds early-stage charter leaders and organizations across the country — with a unique focus on BIPOC leaders, underserved student populations, untapped geographies, and diverse models — and provides them with catalytic resources for growth as they expand their impact in the communities they serve. We do this by focusing on:

  1. Smart sourcing that produces a diverse, high-quality pipeline of early-stage charter leaders and organizations
  2. Impactful investments in early-stage charter organizations
  3. Strategic supports for leaders and their teams
  4. Streamlined operations and actionable data analysis
  5. A strong team that brings unique gifts and expertise to the work

The Seed Team culture is built on a deep belief in the potential of leaders and students — especially our BIPOC communities across the country. We see people first. We strive for excellence, equity, and efficiency. We have fun. We don't take the work personally even though it's personal for all of us. We are "gifts-forward" thinkers who work to create opportunities for leaders and each other to radiate and shine.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a high-capacity, entrepreneurial leader to join the Seed Team as Vice President at a pivotal point in the team’s evolution. This leader will participate across Seed’s early-stage investment work, from founder and first-school selection through replication, while holding particular responsibility for supporting organizations as they move from a strong first school or small network toward sustainable multi-school growth. The VP will help CSGF make rigorous investment decisions and support portfolio leaders in building the organizational capacity and judgement required for successful growth.

This VP will bring strong investment judgement and organizational leadership: leading and participating in rigorous diligence across the Seed pipeline, developing and stewarding investments, and serving as a trusted strategic advisor to portfolio leaders. While the VP will contribute to founder and first-school selection, their portfolio work will focus primarily on organizations navigating replication and early multi-school growth. The VP will also help strengthen the frameworks, systems, and practices that enable the Seed Team to make consistent investment and portfolio decisions as the work scales.

The ideal candidate has senior K-12 leadership experience and a strong understanding of what it takes for a strong school or small network to replicate successfully. Experience leading, growing, or advising a multi-school organization is strongly preferred.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Early-Stage Investment and Selection

  • Lead and contribute to rigorous diligence across founder, first-school, replication, and early-growth investments and develop investment recommendations, synthesizing academic, financial, organizational, leadership and growth evidence.
  • Prepare and present investment memos to CSGF's senior management and board of directors
  • Shape and continuously improve how Seed identifies, assesses, and selects organizations for investment, including strengthening the frameworks and judgment used across stages of growth.

Portfolio Strategy and Leadership

  • Serve as a relationship manager and strategic advisor to a portfolio of Seed organizations, with primary responsibility for organizations navigating replication and early multi-school growth. Help leaders navigate consequential decisions related to organizational health, growth and sustainability.
  • Build trusted relationships with portfolio leaders that enable candid dialogue, sound judgment, and effective partnership at consequential moments.
  • Identify the organizational capabilities, risks, and decisions that will determine whether portfolio members are positioned to grow successfully, and help leaders act on those insights.
  • Help define and evolve Seed’s portfolio strategy across stages of organizational development, including where differentiated support is warranted, where CSGF should primarily monitor progress, and where additional investment is likely to create value.

Strategy, Systems and Learning

  • Translate Seed’s strategy into clear frameworks, decision processes, and operating mechanisms that enable consistent decision-making and execution across sourcing, investment, and portfolio management.
  • Help shape Seed’s annual strategy and priorities and identify where changes in portfolio evidence or organizational context require shifts in approach.
  • Synthesize learning across investments and the portfolio and translate those insights into better investment judgment, portfolio strategy and team practice.
  • Build alignment across Seed and other CSGF teams where shared decisions, handoffs, or collaboration are necessary for portfolio impact.

Cross-Team and Organizational Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives where Seed strategy, investment decisions, or portfolio needs require coordinated action across CSGF.
  • Represent CSGF externally with portfolio leaders, funders, sector partners, and other stakeholders relevant to Seed’s investment and portfolio strategy.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Skills and Characteristics

  • Deep commitment to CSGF's mission and to expanding opportunities for leaders and communities historically underserved by public education
  • Senior leadership experience in K-12 charter schools; experience leading or supporting the growth of a multi-school organization is strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of the needs of early-stage charter networks embarking on growth and expansion
  • Demonstrated ability to assess organizational strength, identify the few issues that matter most, and make sound judgement under ambiguity
  • Investment or diligence experience, or demonstrated ability to conduct rigorous organizational analysis
  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and creative problem-solving skills
  • Ability to move from complex information to clear judgment, priorities, and action while maintaining a high bar for execution.
  • Ability to design scalable approaches that improve decision quality, consistency, and team effectiveness
  • Ability to manage multiple complex projects concurrently
  • Relationship builder who earns trust quickly and sustains it across a diverse set of internal and external stakeholders
  • Capacity to work as part of a collaborative, entrepreneurial team
  • Willingness to travel (~40%)

Educational Background and Work Experience

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • Ten or more years of work experience

COMPENSATION

Compensation is commensurate with experience and education. The target salary range for this role is $140,000-$160,000 annually. CSGF offers a very competitive package of benefits, including: health, life, disability, and dental insurance coverage; vacation/holidays and parental leave; and participation in CSGF’s 403(b) plan. Candidates must have permanent authorization to work in the US.

START DATE

CSGF is seeking candidates who can start as soon as possible; flexible for the ideal candidate.

WORKING AT CSGF

We are focused on hiring and developing great people and believe that building diverse perspectives across our team makes us more effective in expanding our impact. (This is reflected in Our Commitment Statement.) Our core values are:

Why you'll love working here:

  • Join a team driven by purpose, collaboration, and a commitment to identifying and responding to the needs of the public charter schools that we support
  • Access to professional development and learning opportunities

Our core values are:

Results

  • We believe that student success is the ultimate measure of our performance.
  • We work with urgency and intentionality for the portfolio and their schools.
  • We hold ourselves accountable to strong outcomes.
  • We relentlessly prioritize our resources to drive positive, measurable, attributable impact for the charter leaders, their schools, and ultimately students.
  • We believe strong results come from good decisions, and the best decisions are made when we use data - both quantitative and qualitative - and gather input from diverse perspectives, especially those most impacted by the work.
  • We celebrate our wins and learn from our losses.

Teamwork

  • We value organization over team, and we value team over individual.
  • We actively break down silos and collaborate across teams.
  • We believe building strong, healthy relationships is critical to move our work forward.
  • We seek to proactively communicate across teams to strengthen our outcomes and add value for the portfolio.

Integrity

  • We believe that trust is our most important asset, and we must earn and maintain the trust of the portfolio member leaders, investors, and our team to achieve our goals.
  • We are often entrusted with sensitive and confidential information about the portfolio - we do not ever violate these confidences.
  • We show ownership for our successes and our failures.
  • We speak directly to the person, even when it's messy and hard, and get ahead of potential problems.
  • We do the right thing, even when no one is watching.

Respect

  • We understand and acknowledge our place in the value chain – the students, teachers, principals, and other leaders at portfolio networks are doing the hardest, direct, and most impactful work in their schools each day.
  • We prioritize humility and embrace getting better every day.
  • We are curious and open-minded.
  • We are aware of our own biases and how they might affect our judgment, and we take ownership to mitigate their impact.

Entrepreneurship

  • We take calculated risks, looking for new ways to add value and improve how we work.
  • We are problem solvers in all aspects of our work.
  • We actively connect people and ideas in strategic ways to foster new ideas and learning.
  • We acknowledge not all investments will succeed and embrace failure as it facilitates deeper learning for our organization and the portfolio.

E-VERIFY STATEMENT

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you. Including terminating employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the I-9 form.

jobs.description:
About Haven Safety:
Haven Safety AI is building the enterprise learning intelligence layer for safety. Co-founded with The AES Corporation and AI Fund, the venture studio founded by Andrew Ng, Haven helps high-risk organizations learn faster from what goes wrong so they can prevent what comes next.

Haven works alongside existing EHS enterprise systems to improve how organizations investigate, assess, and learn from incidents. INVESTIGATE guides evidence synthesis, timeline development, multi-threaded causal analysis, and corrective actions. ASSURE continuously reviews completed investigations for evidence quality, causal coverage, guideline adherence, and CAPA strength. LEARN reasons across incident history to surface recurring control failures, repeated corrective-action patterns, CAPA debt, and emerging signals.

The platform combines current incident evidence, company knowledge, historical cases, and an industry knowledge graph. A coordinated team of specialized AI agents examines evidence, controls, engineering factors, procedures, regulations, training, and organizational history, then produces one traceable assessment for human review. Customers have reported an 80% reduction in root cause analysis labor time using Haven.

About the Role:

You will work on the AI and LLM engineering layer that connects Haven’s evidence base and knowledge graph to the product experiences investigators and safety leaders use. This is a build-and-operate role reporting to the CTO. You will design the reasoning, ship it, instrument it, and improve it using production evidence.

The work is technically demanding and operationally consequential. Haven serves enterprise customers in regulated, safety-critical industries through multi-tenant and dedicated deployments. A plausible answer and a correct answer can look the same until someone acts on it, so precision, traceability, evaluation, and human oversight are core product requirements.

Haven Safety is a VC-backed pre-seed venture. This role will be a important member of the founding team and will require wearing multiple hats.

What You Will Own:

    • Production reasoning systems. Build and operate multi-step LLM pipelines that coordinate model calls, tool calls, graph queries, retrieval, quality gates, and specialist-agent handoffs.
    • Agent orchestration. Extend Haven’s coordinated agent team and the orchestration layer that carries an incident from evidence through analysis, review, and enterprise learning.
    • Grounding and retrieval. Design the context layer across Neo4j graph traversal, vector search, and hybrid retrieval so every model call receives the right evidence and organizational knowledge.
    • Evaluation. Build datasets, scoring, regression suites, model comparisons, human-label loops, and per-stage quality attribution for extraction and reasoning tasks.
    • Production AI operations. Implement tracing, tool-call audits, cost and latency monitoring, failure handling, and quality dashboards; catch loops, hallucinations, and silent drift before customers do.
    • Technical direction. Select models by task across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google; partner with product and knowledge engineering; and help shape the AI roadmap.

Requirements For the Role Include:

    • Production LLM systems. AI or ML engineering, including shipping LLM systems that real users depend on.
    • Agentic workflows. Hands-on experience building and debugging multi-step, tool-calling workflows with LangGraph, LangChain, or an equivalent framework.
    • Evaluation discipline. A repeatable approach to LLM evaluation, including representative datasets, regression testing, LLM-as-judge techniques, or human review loops.
    • Retrieval judgment. Experience assembling context for LLMs and a clear point of view on what to retrieve, how much, and why.
    • Production ownership. A track record of owning systems from deployment through monitoring and incident response, including a strong story about a failure or regression you diagnosed and fixed.
    • Model judgment. Comfort working across model providers and explaining tradeoffs in quality, latency, cost, context, and operational risk.
    • Graph reasoning. Comfort with Neo4j and Cypher, or a comparable graph store, and the ability to ramp quickly on graph data modeling. Strongly preferred.
    • Strong Python. Production habits around FastAPI, asynchronous services, testing, observability, and maintainable interfaces are required.

Nice To Haves Include:

    • Deep graph experience. Cypher fluency, schema evolution, MERGE patterns, embeddings, and operating a live knowledge graph.
    • Enterprise AI security. Prompt-injection awareness, context-leak prevention, tenant isolation, role-based access, and policy-layer separation.
    • Azure and hybrid search. Experience running production AI services in Azure and using Azure AI Search, Pinecone, MongoDB Atlas, pgvector, Elasticsearch, or a similar platform.
    • B2B Enterprise SaaS. Prior experience operating in an enterprise-level environment is strongly preferred.

Why Join Haven Safety:

    • Meaningful reasoning problems. Work across evidence, causal pathways, controls, organizational history, and corrective actions in a domain where correctness matters.
    • An evaluation-first culture. Make quality measurable, observable, and improvable instead of relying on demos or intuition.
    • Visible customer impact. Build for safety teams in energy, utilities, infrastructure, construction, and manufacturing, with direct feedback from the people using the output.
    • Small team, high ownership. Work closely with the CTO, product, and knowledge engineering, make consequential technical decisions, and see your work reach customers quickly.

jobs.description:
What We Do

At Leading Educators (LE), we know that excellent teaching is the most important driver of student success. The moment a student steps foot in the classroom, their opportunity to learn depends on how prepared their teacher is to translate complex content knowledge, standards, and their knowledge of that student into lessons that help them learn deeply and apply their thinking to the real world.

That’s a big lift, and it often happens alone. As a national nonprofit, we partner with school systems to overcome persistent instructional challenges, foster intentional collaboration and adult learning by design, and ignite new possibilities through systemic solutions at the intersection of teaching, talent, and technology.

We work shoulder-to-shoulder with educators at every level of the education system to strengthen their instructional and leadership practices, bring a vision for excellent instruction to life with consistency, and ensure every student reaches their full potential.

Through direct support, strategic advising, innovation pilots, and best-in-class research, we help educators work toward a future where every student is ready to thrive. Learn more about our work at .

Internal Candidate Application Deadline: Oct 5, 2026

External Candidate Application Deadline:Oct 5, 2026

Position

Leading Educators is seeking a Director, UX Design & Engineering to lead the design and front-end development of AI-enabled product experiences across our innovation portfolio. In this role, you'll close the critical gap between product vision and usable, working tools—translating product requirements, user research, and emerging ideas into clear, coherent, testable front-end experiences that educators and students will actually use. This is your opportunity to shape the future of educational technology by designing interfaces and experiences that make a tangible difference in how teachers teach and students learn.

You'll operate as a thought partner to product leaders, directors, and user researchers, helping teams make stronger product decisions by clarifying front-end possibilities, identifying design tradeoffs, and translating ambiguous concepts into tangible experiences. Your work will have particular impact across MAIN, LEAP, and emerging initiatives, where you'll help LE move beyond current platform limitations by designing and building high-fidelity prototypes, shaping reusable interface patterns, and strengthening the quality and consistency of product experiences across tools.

This is a highly independent Director role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and can move fluidly between structured product requirements and early-stage concepting. As LE's first internal technical hire in this space, you'll bring strong initiative, sound judgment, and the ability to recommend a path forward without waiting for fully defined processes. You'll also work closely with external development partners, representing LE's product priorities clearly while navigating shared dependencies with professionalism and clarity. Reporting to the Senior Director, AI Enabled Instruction, Math, you'll have the autonomy and influence to shape how our products serve educators and students.

Do you have expertise in…

  • UX/UI design, including interaction design, visual design, information architecture, and usability-centered product thinking that puts users at the center of every decision
  • Building high-fidelity prototypes and functional front-end experiences using modern technologies such as React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Translating both detailed product requirements and ambiguous early-stage concepts into usable front-end designs that teams can test, refine, and implement
  • Interpreting user research and usability-testing findings and translating them into prioritized design improvements that strengthen product outcomes

Do you enjoy…

  • Working independently across multiple initiatives, exercising strong judgment about priorities and advancing work in emerging environments where processes are still being built
  • Cross-functional collaboration with product leaders, researchers, and external development partners to align on vision and move decisions forward
  • Designing for clarity, usability, and consistency by developing reusable interface components and patterns that reduce friction across tools
  • Prototyping and iterating quickly—adjusting as product direction changes and using repeated cycles of design, feedback, and revision to maintain momentum

If you've answered affirmatively to these questions and meet the following prerequisites, we urge you to seize this opportunity. This role calls for the following:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in UX design, product design, front-end development, UX engineering, or a closely related field
  • Demonstrated strength in UX/UI design, including interaction design, visual design, information architecture, and usability-centered product thinking
  • Demonstrated ability to build high-fidelity prototypes and functional front-end experiences
  • Professional experience using front-end technologies such as React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Ability to translate both detailed product requirements and ambiguous early-stage concepts into usable front-end designs and prototypes
  • Demonstrated success interpreting user research or usability-testing findings and translating them into design improvements
  • Experience working across cross-functional teams and managing multiple projects or priorities simultaneously
  • Ability to make sound independent recommendations about user experience direction, prototype design, and front-end tradeoffs
  • Comfort working in an environment where processes, pathways, and technical structures are still being built

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience designing and prototyping AI-enabled products
  • Experience conducting or closely supporting user testing for digital tools
  • Education or education technology experience
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards, including ADA and WCAG guidelines
  • Portfolio evidence demonstrating shipped interfaces and/or functional prototypes, along with the ability to explain design and technical decisions

Travel Requirements

  • This is a remote position that requires moderate travel. You'll work from a home office located anywhere within the U.S., with national travel expected for:
    • Org retreats, programming, job related travel, or professional development

Questions? We’re here to help.

If you have questions about this role or about our hiring process at any point, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at . This inbox is monitored regularly, and we aim to respond within two business days. To ensure your question receives a thoughtful and timely response, we kindly ask that you refrain from emailing individual staff members or members of our HR team directly. The best way to connect with us is always through .

Why Work at Leading Educators?

Imagine being part of an organization where your ideas and perspectives are highly valued. At Leading Educators, we believe in fostering individual strengths, encouraging personal growth, and embracing innovative ideas. If you thrive in a remote working environment, with the added excitement of travel, we're the perfect fit for you. By joining us, you become part of a powerful community of peers nationwide. Regardless of your location, you possess the power to make a significant impact on both students and teachers who rely on us daily. Join Leading Educators and become an integral part of driving progress in education.

Learn About Our Mission & Values:

Mission:Leading Educators partners with school systems to sustain the teaching, leadership, and conditions for every student to succeed in school and in life.

Values:

  • Build on strengths: We affirm and begin with the unique and collective talents, experiences, and wisdom of ourselves and others.
  • Continuously learn: We develop ourselves and others. We apply new learning and deepened self-awareness to our relationships and practices.
  • Prioritize people: We build trust and reflect on the impact of different perspectives and experiences.
  • Champion success for all: We re-imagine structures, habits, and mindsets to ensure every learner has access to evidence-based learning opportunities.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring

  • We use artificial intelligence–enabled tools throughout our hiring process, from the moment a candidate applies through the offer stage, to support administrative tasks and the initial review of candidate materials. These tools help us organize, analyze, and surface relevant information efficiently, but they do not make hiring decisions.

  • All candidate materials—including applications, resumes, assessments, and interview feedback—are reviewed and evaluated by people. All hiring decisions, including interview selection, advancement, and offers of employment, are made by humans.

  • We use AI solely as a support tool to assist with early-stage reviews and process efficiency. We do not use AI in ways that discriminate based on protected characteristics, nor do we use ZIP codes or similar data to target or exclude protected groups. Our hiring practices are designed to be fair, consistent, and aligned with equal employment opportunity standards.

Benefits

  • Compensation:
    • If hired for this position, the base compensation range is $113,714 to $144,157 annually. New hires typically enter the range at a set comp ratio (e.g., 0.95 or 0.98), depending on the role. For this position, the salary entry point is $125,354. Candidates may move up the range based on additional years of relevant experience beyond the role’s minimum years of experience qualification. If you have more than 8 years of directly relevant experience, your starting salary may be adjusted higher within the range, up to a maximum starting salary of $133,413. This approach ensures that candidates with additional experience beyond the minimum are recognized in the initial salary offer.
  • Benefits:
    • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for individual employees. Additional premium costs are covered 60% by Leading Educators for partners and dependents on medical, dental, and vision plans. 4% matching 401k plan, Flexible Spending Accounts for medical, childcare and commuter expenses, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Benefits are valued at or above $9,000 for employees.
  • Time Off:
    • First three years of employment, full-time staff accrue 22 days a year.
    • Five additional days are accrued after the third and sixth year of employment.
    • Leading Educators also offer 16 additional paid days off for various holidays, including three floating holidays staff may use at their discretion.

Equal Opportunity Employment

Leading Educators is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

About Salsa

Salsa is rebuilding the most important piece of the business stack: paying workers. We think workers should be paid faster, more easily, and more transparently, so we build next-generation payroll infrastructure for the future of work.

Salsa is an embedded fintech company. We think payroll belongs inside the tools businesses already love, so we give software platforms the APIs and infrastructure to launch their own modern payroll products. Turning every modern SaaS platform into a payroll provider will finally go after the $50bn a year that goes to legacy payroll providers. We think it's about time.

We're a team of payroll technology experts who love to build. We've worked on this problem at startup stage and at large scale, in the US and abroad. We're well-funded, ready to grow, and we love offsites in interesting corners of the world, so bring your ambition and your passport.

About the Role

Our partners sell payroll to their customers, and we make sure those employers get onboarded and paying their workers. This role starts in the trenches and grows into teaching others how to do it.

First, you'll roll up your sleeves and do the onboarding work yourself. You'll help the employers our partners sign up get set up for payroll: gathering what they need, building their accounts, and getting them to a clean first payroll. Doing the work is how you'll learn where employers get stuck, what partners misunderstand, and what a great onboarding really looks like.

Then, the role evolves into train-the-trainer. Most of our partners are software companies, not payroll companies, and their teams are often new to payroll. You'll educate those teams on onboarding best practices and the payroll knowledge they need to onboard employers on their own, using Salsa for support and guidance. You'll design the training programs, materials and exercises that make payroll concepts click for people who've never run a payroll.

We're still writing the playbook. You'll keep improving our payroll onboarding guidance and processes based on what you learn across partners and employers.

Responsibilities

Hands-on employer onboarding

  • Onboard new employers end to end: company setup, federal, state and local tax accounts and rates, pay schedules, earning and deduction codes, garnishments, benefits, and worker records

  • Move settings and deductions over from the employer's prior provider and confirm they're configured correctly

  • Work with our migration team so each account's configuration and migrated data are ready together for first payroll

  • Audit builds before go-live and catch configuration errors before they reach a paycheck

  • Manage a pipeline of onboardings toward clear go-live dates, chasing down what's missing (tax IDs, registration letters, prior-provider reports) from employers and partners

  • Work directly with employers by Zoom, phone or email to guide them through setup and their first payrolls

  • Know where setup help ends and tax or legal advice begins, and route those questions to the right place

Training and enablement

  • Design and deliver training programs that teach partner teams how to onboard employers onto payroll

  • Create engaging training materials, exercises and job aids across different learning modalities: live sessions, recorded walkthroughs, written guides, hands-on practice and knowledge checks

  • Explain payroll concepts in plain terms to people new to payroll, and check that the learning sticks

  • Train partner onboarding and support teams, and coach them through their first months of live employers

  • Review partner-built accounts, spot patterns in their mistakes, and update the training or process that caused them

Improving the model

  • Turn what works across partners and employers into Salsa's standard payroll onboarding guidance and playbooks

  • Keep training materials current as our product, processes and payroll rules change

  • Spot where onboardings keep breaking, bring specifics to product and engineering, and help automate what should be automated

Requirements

  • 5 to 7 years in payroll operations or onboarding, including 2 to 3 years training, coaching or educating people in the payroll operations domain

  • Experience creating training materials and building training programs from scratch

  • Experience educating people new to payroll, and making complex payroll concepts simple and practical

  • Proven skill creating engaging training materials, exercises and learning modalities that people actually use

  • Hands-on payroll onboarding or implementation experience, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves and do the work

  • Strong working knowledge of multi-state payroll tax, pre- and post-tax deductions, benefits and retirement (including 401(k)), and garnishments

  • Experience resolving payroll issues directly with employers (PTO, 401(k), deductions, garnishments, W-4s, tax discrepancies)

  • Obsessive about accuracy: a payroll that's a few cents off bothers you until you find out why

  • Comfortable in spreadsheets, including reviewing and uploading YTD balances and mapping settings and deduction data from other providers' reports

jobs.excerpt: Na Neon, nossa missão é simplificar a vida financeira de milhões de brasileiros de forma segura, ágil e escalável.
jobs.description:
Na Neon, nossa missão é simplificar a vida financeira de milhões de brasileiros de forma segura, ágil e escalável. Para que possamos continuar crescendo e inovando sem limites, a nossa blindagem perimetral e arquitetura de redes em nuvem precisam ser impecáveis. Como Cloud Security Engineer Specialist, você será a liderança técnica responsável por desenhar, automatizar e sustentar a segurança de nossas redes e perímetros na nuvem (com foco massivo em AWS). O seu desafio será garantir a integridade de um ecossistema financeiro complexo utilizando o que há de mais moderno em soluções de borda (Palo Alto e Zscaler), atuando de forma estratégica e hands-on para guiar o nosso time em direção a um ambiente cada vez mais resiliente e seguro por design.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetura de Nuvem Segura: Desenhar, implementar e otimizar arquiteturas de rede seguras no ecossistema AWS, utilizando as melhores práticas de segmentação, isolamento e privilégio mínimo.
  • Gestão de Perímetro e SASE: Configurar, administrar e evoluir nossos firewalls de próxima geração (Palo Alto Networks / VM-Series) e nossas plataformas de acesso seguro e borda (Zscaler - ZIA/ZPA), liderando a estratégia de SASE/Zero Trust.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Desenvolver e manter nossa infraestrutura de rede e segurança de forma totalmente automatizada (Security as Code) utilizando Terraform, mitigando riscos e promovendo padronização.
  • Monitoramento e Resposta Ativa: Atuar na linha de frente para detectar, analisar e mitigar ameaças ou incidentes de segurança de rede em tempo real, implementando melhorias contínuas para blindar novos vetores de ataque.
  • Conformidade de Alto Nível: Garantir que todos os ambientes de rede em nuvem estejam em conformidade com as diretrizes internas de segurança e com frameworks regulatórios de mercado (PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks).
  • Disseminação de Cultura: Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico do time, mentorando engenheiros e analistas, e sendo a referência em Security by Design para desenvolvedores, POs e outras áreas de tecnologia.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Sólida experiência técnica atuando em Segurança de Redes e Cloud Security em ambientes complexos e escaláveis.
  • Domínio avançado do ecossistema de redes e segurança nativo da AWS (VPC, Security Groups, NACLs, Transit Gateway, Route 53, AWS WAF, Shield, GuardDuty e CloudTrail).
  • Prática consolidada na administração de firewalls de próxima geração Palo Alto Networks (VM-Series, Panorama).
  • Vivência técnica robusta com soluções de SASE/Zero Trust da Zscaler (Zscaler Internet Access - ZIA e Zscaler Private Access - ZPA).
  • Profundo conhecimento em fundamentos de redes: protocolos de roteamento dinâmico (BGP, OSPF), topologias de VPN (IPsec, SSL), modelo TCP/IP, OSI e análise avançada de pacotes.
  • Experiência prática na criação e manutenção de códigos de infraestrutura (IaC) utilizando Terraform.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento prático de segurança em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (Microsoft Azure ou Google Cloud Platform - GCP).
  • Experiência com plataformas modernas de CNAPP/CSPM (ex: Prisma Cloud, Wiz, Orca Security).
  • Certificações técnicas ativas, tais como:
  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking ou AWS Certified Security - Specialty.
  • Palo Alto Networks PCNSE.
  • Zscaler Certified Cloud Specialist (ZCCS).
  • Certificações de mercado agnósticas (CISSP, CCSP, CEH).

Location: Remote

Salary Range:~$2,000–$2,500 USD per month
Schedule: Monday–Friday, typically 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET or CT
English Proficiency: Excellent written and spoken English required

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing professional community and membership organization serving thousands of accomplished entrepreneurs and founders who have successfully built and exited companies.

The organization creates meaningful connections and high-quality experiences through local chapters, curated groups, forums, events, workshops, and real-time community interaction.

The team operates with a high level of ownership, moves quickly, works remotely across time zones, and integrates AI deeply into day-to-day operations.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and relationship-oriented Community & Events Associate to help shape the day-to-day experience of a large and highly engaged founder community.

This role sits at the intersection of community management, content, communications, events, and program coordination.

You will own the content calendar, help determine what communications members receive and when, coordinate events and workshops from beginning to end, stay closely connected to conversations happening across the community, and help identify the topics, people, and opportunities that matter most.

This is a writing-heavy and execution-oriented role for someone who combines excellent communication skills with attention to detail, sound judgment, curiosity, and a genuine interest in people.

Why This Opportunity?

You'll have the opportunity to work closely with a community of thousands of experienced entrepreneurs and business leaders while having a meaningful impact on their member experience.

You'll also join a small, fast-moving remote team where:

  • You can take meaningful ownership early.
  • Your ideas and observations can directly influence programs and communications.
  • AI is actively used to make work faster and more effective.
  • You can see the measurable impact of the campaigns, events, and initiatives you manage.
  • There is significant room to grow based on your strengths and interests.

What You'll Do

Content & Communications

  • Own and maintain the community content and communications calendar, determining what goes out, when, and why.
  • Write, edit, and refine communications sent to members while maintaining a clear, natural, and consistent brand voice.
  • Build, test, and send email campaigns.
  • Select and manage appropriate audience segments for different communications.
  • Review campaigns carefully before launch, including links, formatting, dates, names, and other details.
  • Track campaign performance and identify what content and messages resonate most strongly with members.
  • Share insights and recommendations based on engagement and performance data.

Events & Programs

  • Coordinate virtual and occasional in-person events from planning through execution.
  • Create and manage registration pages, reminders, logistics, and event-day support.
  • Promote events to the most relevant members to drive attendance.
  • Coordinate speakers and workshops, including scheduling, confirmations, logistics, and run-of-show preparation.
  • Manage program communications including applications, deadlines, participant updates, and waitlists.
  • Follow up with attendees and participants after events.
  • Track which events, speakers, and topics perform best and use those insights to improve future programming.

Community Engagement

  • Stay closely connected to daily conversations happening within the community.
  • Develop a strong understanding of what members are discussing, asking about, celebrating, and struggling with.
  • Identify recurring themes, community wins, concerns, and opportunities for meaningful member connections.
  • Welcome new voices and help encourage thoughtful participation.
  • Provide first-line community moderation when needed.
  • Escalate situations requiring additional review or decisions to the appropriate internal team member.
  • Proactively identify members who may benefit from meeting or connecting with one another.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

You'll focus on understanding the community, its members, communication style, tools, and existing programs.

You'll begin supporting campaigns and events with guidance from the team.

By 60 Days

You'll independently manage much of the weekly communications calendar and take greater ownership of events and program execution.

By 90 Days

You'll have a strong pulse on the community and proactively surface what members need, what topics are gaining traction, and where the organization should focus next.

How We Work

AI-Assisted by Default

AI is an important part of the team's workflow.

You'll use AI tools to help with first drafts, summaries, reporting, research, organization, and repetitive tasks so that more of your time can be spent on judgment, relationships, creativity, and execution.

You should already be comfortable experimenting with AI tools and interested in becoming even better at using them.

Attention to Detail Matters

You'll be communicating with thousands of experienced founders and business leaders.

Small details matter.

You'll be expected to catch incorrect links, formatting issues, outdated dates, inconsistent names, typos, and other mistakes before anything is published or sent.

Async and Remote

The team works remotely across multiple time zones and communicates heavily in writing.

You'll be expected to:

  • Share updates proactively.
  • Flag blockers early.
  • Manage your time effectively.
  • Take ownership without waiting for constant direction.

Measure and Improve

Your work doesn't stop when a campaign is sent or an event ends.

You'll review what happened, understand what worked, identify what didn't, and help the team improve the next iteration.

Tools You May Use

The organization currently works with tools such as:

  • Customer.io or similar email marketing platforms
  • Event management platforms such as Luma
  • Notion
  • Google Workspace
  • Slack
  • WhatsApp
  • ChatGPT and other AI tools

You do not need previous experience with every tool listed above.

What matters most is your ability to learn new tools quickly and figure out how to use them effectively.

Required Qualifications

  • Excellent written English, with the ability to communicate naturally, clearly, and professionally.
  • Strong writing and editing skills.
  • Ability to adapt to an established brand voice rather than imposing your own writing style.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines, events, communications, and priorities simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Proactive working style: you identify what needs to happen and take action.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and genuine interest in building relationships.
  • Comfortable communicating with entrepreneurs, founders, executives, and senior professionals.
  • Strong judgment, discretion, and professionalism.
  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow.
  • Ability to learn new software and systems quickly.
  • Willingness to communicate openly when blocked or when something requires additional attention.

Preferred Qualifications

These are helpful but not required:

  • Experience with Customer.io, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Braze, or a similar email marketing platform.
  • Previous community management or moderation experience.
  • Experience managing communities through WhatsApp, Slack, or similar platforms.
  • Event coordination experience, either virtual or in person.
  • Experience supporting a founder, investor, executive, professional, or membership-based community.
  • Previous experience working remotely and in an asynchronous environment.
  • Experience tracking engagement metrics and using data to improve communications or programming.

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity for someone who wants more than a narrowly defined coordination role.

You'll have exposure to a highly accomplished entrepreneurial community while developing experience across:

  • Community building
  • Content and communications
  • Events and programming
  • Email marketing
  • Member engagement
  • AI-enabled workflows
  • Performance measurement
  • Relationship building

Because the team is small, strong performers will have opportunities to take on increasing responsibility and grow into the areas where they demonstrate the most strength.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Product Leader - Data

Job Location: Berlin, Germany

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

At Veeva Data Cloud, we are building the next generation of data products and software for the global Life Sciences industry across Clinical and Commercial domains.
As a Product Leader on the Data team, you will head a cross-functional squad of data engineers, data scientists, analysts, and operations managers. You will be responsible for defining the product strategy and driving end-to-end execution. This includes high-throughput data pipelines and curation tools to web applications and direct data APIs. In this role, you will leverage both modern GenAI and traditional technologies to innovate constantly, ensuring unmatched data quality and operational efficiency.

What You'll Do

    • Drive Strategy and Execution. Define, own, and execute the roadmap for impactful data products that serve internal teams and external customers
    • Lead Cross-Functional Squads. Direct multi-disciplinary teams from 10 to 100 FTEs toward a shared product vision
    • Deliver Data and Product Excellence. Establish key success metrics, design quality assurance frameworks, and ensure high-standard features are seamlessly deployed into production
    • Innovate continuously. Apply cutting-edge tools such as GenAI, and human-in-the-loop data curation, analytics, and software applications
    • Engage Users and Stakeholders. Conduct user interviews, gather insights, and closely collaborate with core Software Product and Engineering teams to align roadmaps

Requirements

    • 10+ Years of Experience in Product Management. Basics from designing ERD to understanding high-level product patterns that determine long-term success
    • Data Product Track Record. Demonstrated experience driving data-centric product management (data pipelines, analytics, APIs, or data platform tools)
    • AI and Automation Mindset. Proven track record of leveraging AI and automation technologies to boost speed, efficiency, and data quality
    • Technical and Analytical Depth. Ability to dive into operational details, including human data curation workflows and complex data quality metrics, without losing sight of the strategic big picture
    • Cross-Functional Leadership. Proven ability to rally cross-functional technical teams (engineering, data science) around a unified outcome
    • Core Attributes are fast learner, team-first attitude, exceptional work ethic, and strong communication skills

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Health and wellness programs
    • Social events for your team and across teams
    • Personal budget for charity

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 120,000 - 220,000 EUR
    • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, can multitask, and is a proven team player. You will design, develop, manage, and maintain our open-source data platform, including our Data Lakehouse (S3, Apache Iceberg, and ClickHouse), ETL processes, and orchestration.

What You Will Do

  • Develop a scalable data platform integrating multiple sources for easy access.
  • Design and enhance data tools (orchestration, governance, data lakehouse, BI, etc.).
  • Ensure smooth operation of data systems for analysts, scientists, and engineers.
  • Optimize data pipelines (ingestion, processing, and output) in a microservices environment.
  • Build, maintain, and monitor ETL/ELT processes .
  • Troubleshoot and improve the performance, scalability, and reliability of the data infrastructure (S3, Apache Iceberg, ClickHouse).
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, analysts, and backend engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions.
  • Implement and champion data quality, governance, and security best practices across the platform.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar data infrastructure role.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience with data modeling.
  • Experience with data lake/lakehouse architectures (e.g., Apache Iceberg, S3, or similar).
  • Experience with analytical / columnar databases (e.g., ClickHouse or similar).
  • Experience building and orchestrating ETL/ELT pipelines .
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or Scala/Java.
  • Experience working within a microservices architecture and cloud environments (AWS preferred).
  • Self-motivated, strong multitasking skills, and a demonstrated team player.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Spark (or similar technologies) for large-scale data processing.
  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.
  • Note: this role is focused on batch data processing (not real-time streaming).

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with and contributing to open-source data platforms and tools.
  • Familiarity with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Superset, Looker, Tableau, Metabase, or similar).
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience with AWS EMR and running Apache Spark workloads in a cloud environment.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to boost engineering productivity.

jobs.excerpt: Location: home-based; ideally South Africa or another location in similar time-zone Duration of contract: 1 year (possibility for extension) Supervisor: Global Coordinator for PMER, Complaints and Safeguarding Start date: as soon as possibleLutheran World Federation (LWF) World Service LWF World Service is the humanitarian and development arm of the Lutheran World Federation.
jobs.description:
Location: home-based; ideally South Africa or another location in similar time-zone
Duration of contract: 1 year (possibility for extension)
Supervisor: Global Coordinator for PMER, Complaints and Safeguarding

Start date: as soon as possible

Lutheran World Federation (LWF) World Service
LWF World Service is the humanitarian and development arm of the Lutheran World Federation. We are a widely recognized, international, faith-based organization working in more than 20 countries globally. We seek to bring people of all backgrounds together in the common quest for justice, peace, and reconciliation in an increasingly complex and fragmented world. A commitment to the human rights of every individual, regardless of their status, guides our work, actions, and operations. We are particularly known for our timely, compassionate, and professional humanitarian work, and for our field presence in hard-to-reach areas. Our work is people-centered and community-based. Above all, we work with the most vulnerable, and to claim and uphold their rights, we engage proactively with local government and community structures. For additional information, please see LWF World Service.

Purpose
Complaints and PSEA Advisor supports the Global Coordinator PMER, Complaints and Safeguarding in the implementation and strengthening of complaints handling and PSEA systems across LWF World Service.

The position provides operational and technical support in complaint intake and case management, investigations, CRM monitoring and reporting, PSEA, capacity strengthening, and digital and knowledge management. The position requires a high level of confidentiality, sound judgment and the ability to work independently while knowing when matters need to be escalated to the Global Coordinator.

The Advisor works closely with CRM and PSEA Focal Points in LWF Country Programs to support consistent implementation of LWF policies, systems and requirements across the Country Programs. The position also works with relevant Geneva-based functions, when required.

Required qualifications
University degree in a relevant field such as social sciences, law, human rights, international development or another related field.
Recognized training or certification in investigations.

Knowledge and experience
At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in complaints handling, investigations, PSEA, safeguarding or related areas.
Practical experience in complaint intake, assessment, referral and case management.
Good knowledge of complaints handling, PSEA and safeguarding standards and practices in humanitarian and development contexts.
Experience conducting workplace or misconduct investigations, including interviews, evidence review and investigation reporting.
Experience providing training, coaching or technical support, preferably in humanitarian or development settings.
Experience working with digital information systems, databases or collaboration platforms.

Language skills
English required: fluent

French and/or Spanish are an asset

LWF Core Skills

Achieving results – advanced*

Accountability – resourced

Working effectively with others - advanced
Analytical thinking - advanced
Initiative - advanced

Leadership - resourced

LWF Functional Skills

Attention to detail - advanced

Capacity building / Training – advanced

Confidentiality Management – advanced
Analytical Thinking - resourced

Information Management – advanced

  • LWF 3 skills levels are: basic - advanced – resourced

Main duties
Complaints Handling and Investigations
Supports the day-to-day management of the LWF Complaint mailbox, including acknowledgment, initial assessment, referral, intake analysis, registration and follow-up of complaints.
Reviews and analyses complaints and recommends appropriate handling or escalation in line with LWF policies and procedures.
Maintains accurate and confidential case information in the complaints database and supports CRM Focal Points with complaint handling and documentation.
Conducts or supports investigations when assigned, including planning, interviews, evidence review and preparation of investigation reports.
Acts as the designated backup for the LWF Complaint mailbox during the absence of the Global Coordinator and ensures continuity of complaint handling.

CRM Monitoring, Systems and Implementation
Supports the monitoring of CRM implementation across Country Programs and follows up identified gaps with CRM Focal Points.
Coordinates the quarterly CRM reporting process, reviews the quality and completeness of submissions and follows up where information is missing or incomplete.
Supports the review and improvement of the CRM quarterly reporting tool and process.
Supports the rollout and consistent use of ActivityInfo for complaint recording and monitors the quality and completeness of information recorded by Country Programs.
Reviews CRM information and complaint data to identify recurring gaps, trends and areas requiring additional support.

PSEA
Supports the Global Coordinator with the review, update and rollout of the LWF World Service PSEA Policy.
Provides technical support to PSEA and CRM Focal Points on the implementation of PSEA requirements at Country Program level.
Supports and follows up PSEA self-assessments and UN PSEA assessments, including review of evidence, identification of gaps and follow-up of agreed actions.
Develops and delivers PSEA induction, training and refresher sessions and supports focal points in strengthening staff awareness.
Identifies recurring PSEA gaps and brings significant or systemic issues to the attention of the Global Coordinator.

Capacity Strengthening and Technical Support
Supports the induction and onboarding of new CRM Focal Points and provides ongoing coaching and technical support to CRM and PSEA Focal Points.
Develops and delivers practical training and refresher sessions on complaint handling and CRM based on identified needs.
Supports focal points in strengthening complaint mechanisms and related processes and facilitates learning and exchange between focal points when useful.

Digital Systems and Knowledge Management
Reviews and organizes existing CRM, complaints, investigation and PSEA resources, helping to reduce duplication, archive outdated materials and simplify the resources available to Country Programs.
Supports the development and maintenance of a structured SharePoint site where Country Programs can easily access current guidance, templates, training materials and other resources related to Complaint and PSEA.
Supports the effective use of ActivityInfo, SharePoint and other relevant digital systems and works with Data & Analytics and other colleagues when technical support is required.

Major Challenges
Handling sensitive and confidential information while managing several priorities at the same time.
Supporting more consistent implementation of CRM and PSEA requirements across different Country Program contexts.
Turning policies and technical requirements into practical and user-friendly approaches.
Managing multiple priorities, taking initiative and ensuring timely coordination on sensitive or complex matters.

jobs.description:
Oracle Cloud Technical Architect

Location: Canada – Remote

Department: Finance

Position: Oracle Cloud Technical Architect

The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei. Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We are dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

Your Mission

Nuvei is looking for an Oracle Cloud Technical Architect to lead the Oracle technical layer of the UFS Reimagined program within the Global Finance organization. The program is delivering Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and EPM across the Nuvei finance landscape in two waves, alongside a systems integrator and a number of specialist partners for 3rd party solutions being implemented in parallel. This role sits on the Nuvei side of that program and holds the Oracle technical authority for Global Finance.

The person in this role sets the standard and stands behind it. They will review and approve the integration architecture proposed by the systems integrator, define connectivity, identity, and environment requirements across the Oracle ecosystem, lead the architecture and security clearance work for the Oracle connections to Kyriba and Sovos, and cover the Oracle Integration Cloud posting path from the business rules platform into the general ledger. Where a design decision has to be made, defended, or refused, this person makes it.

The role reports to the Director, Oracle Solutions and works in close collaboration with functional business process leads, the systems integrator's technical team, Nuvei's enterprise architecture and information security teams, the incoming application managed support partner, and the owners of the upstream and downstream systems that Oracle Fusion Cloud connects to. It is a hands-on architecture role, not a coordination role, and it continues beyond go-live as the permanent Oracle technical owner within Nuvei.

This role will suit someone with ten or more years of Oracle technical experience, including several full Fusion Cloud implementation lifecycles from requirements through cutover and hypercare, who has carried architecture accountability through a security and compliance approval process and has taken a newly implemented ecosystem into a sustained support model.

Responsibilities

The role covers four areas. The balance of work shifts across the program, moving from integration architecture and clearance work during the build, through cutover and hypercare at each wave, into sustained ownership of the Oracle ecosystem once the application managed support model is running.

Integration Architecture and Oracle Integration Cloud

  • Review the systems integrator's solution design for every in-scope interface and confirm the appropriate Oracle Integration Cloud or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure integration pattern, including orchestration, scheduling, retries, idempotency, and recovery behaviour.
  • Define endpoints, authentication, service accounts, certificates, encryption, privileged access, network routes, and environment-specific configuration for each connection between Oracle Fusion Cloud and the surrounding application ecosystem.
  • Facilitate the technical discussions between the systems integrator and the peripheral system teams, covering systems governed by Finance, Corporate-IT, systems outside its current footprint, and third-party managed platforms, and hold the functional and technical flow of each interface.
  • Document the standards the build is held to for orchestration, scheduling, retries, error handling, logging, monitoring, and alerting, and review partner-produced designs against them.
  • Own the Oracle Integration Cloud posting path from the business rules platform on Azure and Snowflake into the Oracle general ledger, including file-based data import, aggregated journal delivery, drill-back lineage, and reconciliation points.
  • Lead architecture checkpoints during build and testing, approve deviations from the agreed standards, and authorize the technical transition of each interface into production.

Architecture, Security, and Cloud Clearances

  • Lead the Oracle side of the architecture and security clearances required for Oracle Fusion Cloud to connect to the Kyriba and Sovos cloud platforms, both of which hold Nuvei data on third-party infrastructure and clear on their own merits.
  • Produce the evidence the enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, and third-party risk forums require, including context and data-flow diagrams, control assessments, test results, and remediation status.
  • Translate approval conditions into actionable design, configuration, testing, and evidence requirements, and drive them to closure with the partner, vendor, security, and infrastructure teams before production deployment.
  • Contribute the Oracle integration and technical assurance view to the business rules management platform being built on Nuvei's own Azure tenant, including its architecture and security clearance packs.
  • Confirm environment topology, segregation, capacity, availability, performance, scalability, configuration management, deployment paths, and separation of duties across the Oracle landscape.
  • Accept the formal handover from the enterprise and infrastructure architects, validating decisions, conditions, accepted exceptions, dependencies, risks, and open actions, and carry them forward as the standing Oracle technical authority.

Post Go-Live Sustainment and the Hybrid Support Model

  • Represent Nuvei in the selection and onboarding of the application managed support partner, including responses to vendor clarifications, evaluation of proposed support models, and technical assessment of the bids.
  • Own the in-house share of the hybrid support model, covering infrastructure, IT service management, and the portion of the integration ecosystem that is retained rather than outsourced.
  • Lead the knowledge transition from the systems integrator into Global Finance and the support partner, and confirm that support ownership, service expectations, incident routing, and escalation paths are agreed for every production interface.
  • Govern the hypercare period at each wave, then the steady-state support model, ensuring month-end close and year-end are treated as the critical windows they are.
  • Define the technical side of the proactive operations monitoring model, including thresholds, observability, alert routing, dashboards, and the runbooks each participating team operates from.
  • Carry wave-one lessons into wave-two readiness for the larger and more complex regional scope and maintain technical authority for clearance-related changes and exceptions through the sustainment period.

Environment, Ecosystem, and Technical Governance

  • Own the Oracle Fusion Cloud environment landscape, including refresh planning, environment scheduling across workstreams, quarterly update readiness, and regression coverage.
  • Govern the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure tenancy supporting the ecosystem, including compartments, identity domains, policies, network topology, service limits, cost, and service health.
  • Set the technical standards for Fusion security, including role design support, data access sets, and segregation of duties, and review changes against them.
  • Assess non-functional requirements for availability, performance, scalability, resilience, disaster recovery, auditability, and supportability before any build is approved.
  • Review deployment and support artefacts, approve the final technical evidence and handover, and ensure the ecosystem remains compliant and supportable after implementation.

Requirements

  • Ten or more years of hands-on Oracle technical experience, including multiple full Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation lifecycles from requirements through cutover and hypercare.
  • Demonstrated architecture accountability on an Oracle Fusion Cloud program, including ownership of integration architecture, technical standards, and design approval across a partner-delivered build.
  • Deep, current Oracle Integration Cloud experience covering orchestrations, adapters, mappings, fault handling, scheduling, and the review of designs produced by others.
  • Strong command of Oracle Fusion Cloud integration surfaces, including REST and SOAP web services, the ERP Integration Service, file-based data import, and business events.
  • Practical Oracle Cloud Infrastructure experience across identity and access management, compartments, policies, networking, and service limits, sufficient to govern a tenancy rather than only operate in one.
  • Experience taking an Oracle ecosystem through enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and third-party risk clearance, including evidence packs, conditions, compensating controls, and formal approval.
  • Experience integrating Oracle Fusion Cloud with third-party software-as-a-service platforms hosted outside the corporate network, including connectivity, certificate, and identity design.
  • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms such as Azure and Snowflake, sufficient to design and assure the interface between a rules-based subledger and the Oracle general ledger.
  • Strong SQL and PL/SQL, together with reporting knowledge across BI Publisher and OTBI, sufficient to review, challenge, and troubleshoot technical objects built by others.
  • Experience transitioning a newly implemented Oracle ecosystem into a managed support model, including hybrid arrangements shared between an internal team and a support partner.
  • Clear and direct communicator, able to hold a position in an architecture or security review and to work effectively with finance leadership, partner technical teams, and system owners.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Assets

  • Experience across the Oracle Fusion Cloud financials footprint, particularly General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, Cash Management, and Projects.
  • Exposure to Oracle EPM Cloud and its integration with Fusion ERP through Data Management or Data Integration.
  • Experience with high-volume transactional integration in a payments, fintech, or financial services environment, including daily settlement and reconciliation cycles.
  • Familiarity with treasury and indirect tax cloud platforms such as Kyriba and Sovos, and with the integration patterns they require.
  • Oracle certification in Integration Cloud, Cloud Infrastructure architecture, or Fusion Financials.
  • Experience of a business rules engine, decision-table, or rules-driven subledger platform, and of the controls that make one auditable.
  • Working knowledge of DevOps practice for cloud integration, including source control, automated deployment, and release governance.

Benefits

Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they are empowered to be their true, authentic selves. So, please come as you are. We can't wait to meet you.

• Competitive holiday allowance

• Group Insurance Benefits

• Flexible working model

• Employee Assistance Program

Working Language

English (written and spoken) is the language used most of the time, as work colleagues, clients, and strategic suppliers are geographically dispersed.

This position offers an expected compensation range of [$130,000-$150,000] per year, in accordance with Ontario’s pay transparency requirements.”

jobs.description:
About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the Role

We're looking for an exceptional product leader to join our Consumer Product team as Director of Product Management. This team is responsible for building a delightful digital consumer experience — from onboarding users and helping them understand their families' needs, to purchasing the right insurance products to protect what matters most. As Director, you will own the strategy and execution of our core consumer product surface, leading a team of product managers and partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Marketing. The ideal candidate combines first-principles thinking, deep consumer empathy, and organizational leadership to drive both team excellence and meaningful business outcomes. You'll set the vision, build the team, and be accountable for results at scale. We're looking for an entrepreneurial product leader who is passionate about advocating on behalf of users, building and developing high-performing PM teams, and driving sustainable business growth — all while operating with a high degree of ownership in a product-first company.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Leadership & People Management

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of product managers, fostering a culture of ownership, experimentation, and continuous improvement
  • Set clear goals and development plans for direct reports; conduct regular performance reviews and provide ongoing coaching
  • Partner with recruiting to grow the PM team as the business scales, identifying talent and building a strong hiring pipeline
  • Create clarity and alignment across the team on priorities, roadmap, and success metrics

Product Strategy & Vision
