The Staff Accountant supports the Accounting & Finance team through daily accounting activities, general ledger maintenance, and compliance monitoring. This role plays a key part in month-end close, account reconciliations, financial reporting, and ensuring employees follow company travel and expense policies.

Key Responsibilities

General Accounting

· Prepare and record journal entries, accruals, and adjustments in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States (U.S. GAAP).

· Maintain, analyze, and reconcile general ledger accounts on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis.

· Assist with month-end and year-end close, ensuring deadlines are met.

· Support preparation of financial statements, internal reports, and audit schedules.

Banking & Cash Management

· Perform weekly and monthly bank account reconciliations and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.

· Monitor cash activity and assist with cash flow reporting.

Expense Management & Compliance

· Monitor compliance with company travel and expense policies.

· Review employee expense reports for accuracy, proper coding, and adherence to policy.

· Track corporate credit card transactions and ensure timely submission of expense reports.

· Follow up with employees on overdue or incomplete expense reports to ensure compliance.

· Coordinate with HR and department managers regarding outstanding compliance issues when needed.

Compliance & Internal Controls

· Assist with internal and external audit requests by preparing supporting documentation.

· Help improve internal processes and strengthen financial controls.

· Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and U.S. GAAP.

Reporting & Analysis

· Prepare recurring and ad-hoc schedules for management, budgeting, and forecasting.

· Assist with variance analysis and provide explanations for unusual or unexpected activity.

Other

· Perform other tasks or special projects as assigned by management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required.
  • 2-4 years of accounting experience; internship or corporate accounting experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP.
  • Bilingual: English (advance level advance required).
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, formulas).
  • Experience using ERP systems (e.g., Infor, NetSuite).
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Effective communication skills and professionalism when interacting with employees.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrates integrity, reliability, and confidentiality.

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

The Director, Global Payroll will lead and develop the global payroll delivery team to optimize and process payroll across numerous countries. Reporting directly to the VP, Finance Strategy & Operations, we are looking for a forward-thinking, innovation-driven leader who embraces technology and continuous improvement to transform our global payroll operations.


This role will drive AI-enabled process innovation, leveraging platforms like Workday HR, ADP Workforce Now and Celergo, and emerging automation tools to improve accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.


This leader will serve as a strategic partner to HR, Finance, Legal, and Technology, ensuring global payroll is compliant, employee-centric, and continuously evolving through technology and intelligent automation.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensure accurate and timely processing of the Company’s payroll in 15+ countries, in accordance with global policies, procedures, and legislative compliance requirements (including tax and labor laws).
  • Partner with HR and our Transformation Office to enhance automation between Workday HRIS and ADP and other third party benefit providers to streamline processes and improve payroll accuracy.
  • Lead the evaluation, adoption, and implementation of AI tools and advanced automation tools to streamline payroll processing, error detection, and reporting.
  • Manage setup of payroll for newly established entities and support expansion into new regions, including integration of payroll systems through M&A activities.
  • Foster a culture of innovation and excellence within the payroll team; identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process re-engineering.
  • Provide prompt, friendly, and efficient customer service to employees and ensure payroll issues are escalated and resolved, including AI-enabled root cause analysis and predictive solutions.
  • Motivate and develop a high-functioning global payroll team, instilling best practices and promoting continuous learning.
  • Report executive KPI’s to the CFO on key payroll metrics.
  • Enhance and maintain robust internal controls, including adoption of AI-supported anomaly detection and compliance checks.
  • Oversee department structure and workload to maximize efficiency.
  • Monitor and implement changes in global payroll legislation, proactively updating systems and processes accordingly.
  • Ensure timely and accurate filing of required payroll returns and issuance of W-2 and equivalent forms.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, HR, Finance, or a related field.
  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation preferred.
  • 10+ years of over payroll experience with 5+ years of leadership experience in a global company.
  • Demonstrated experience with global expansion, payroll setup, and M&A integrations.
  • Strong technical knowledge of global tax, reporting, and payroll compliance.
  • Deep experience with ADP Workforce Now and Celergo and Workday HRIS;
  • Demonstrated success leading payroll transformation initiatives, including intelligent automation, finance outsourcing, and AI adoption.
  • Strong leadership skills with a willingness to take a hands-on approach as needed.
  • Proven excellence in customer service, team development, and operational delivery.
  • Experience driving change management and digital transformation in a global setting.

Compensation:

Alteryx is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. Final compensation is determined by several factors, including but not limited to relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.


The base salary range for this role in the United States is $180,000 - $200,000 This role is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 20% of base salary, based on individual and company performance.


In addition to base pay and bonus eligibility, this role includes clear forms of additional compensation, such as:


  • A monthly Connectivity Plus stipend of $150 to support remote work-related expenses
  • An annual $200 home office reimbursement

Alteryx offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and overall well-being, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and flexible time off
  • Mental health support and wellness reimbursement
  • Career development and education assistance

jobs.excerpt: About GauntletGauntlet builds the financial systems of the future.
jobs.description:
About Gauntlet

Gauntlet builds the financial systems of the future. While much of on-chain finance is focused on point solutions, we operate across the entire stack to offer best-in-class vault products. Today we serve over $1.5B in client TVL across some of the largest fintechs/neobanks, protocols, exchanges, and capital allocators in crypto — and, increasingly, traditional asset management. Our team brings together traditional finance and crypto-native expertise to deliver durable, sophisticated products for institutional clients moving on-chain.

The role

The Capital Markets team sources institutional borrow demand into Gauntlet's credit markets, structures terms, and operates the resulting book over time. You will work directly with institutional counterparties, including market makers, OTC desks, trading firms, KYC-regulated borrowers, and tokenized asset issuers, to source, structure, and close credit relationships.

You will own the process end-to-end. Long-term relationship maintenance, renewal, and expansion are part of the role.

What you'll do;

  • Originate institutional borrow demand across collateralized lending, trading and hedging strategies, structured credit, and liquidity products — from prime brokerages, trading firms, and asset-backed lending partners.
  • Build the borrower pipeline across three segments: (1) unique-market-access counterparties (e.g. RWAs); (2) committed-supply-at-scale borrowers (market makers, OTC desks, trading desks); (3) KYC-gated counterparties (regulated borrowers who cannot legally use open pools).
  • Structure and close term sheets — negotiate rate, term, size, and collateral; coordinate KYC, gating, and onboarding through to close.
  • Maintain the book you originate. Long-term relationship maintenance, renewal, and expansion are owned by Capital Markets.
  • Operationalize and document the first on-chain borrow products (starting with our current pilot) so the process is repeatable as deal volume grows, and manage inbound interest as we execute more deals.
  • Work cross-functionally with Credit Risk, Strategy & Growth, Product, and Engineering on operational integration
  • Contribute to credit terms guidance (what we offer, minimum rate, maximum term) set with Credit Risk.

What success looks like;

    First 30 days. Ramp on Gauntlet's infrastructure and partnerships across lending markets, vaults and structured products. Meet the key internal stakeholders across Credit Risk, Strategy and Growth, Product, and Engineering, as well as counterparties in the existing book. Develop a clear view of the current pipeline and identify the gaps.

    First 3–6 months. Operating your own pipeline across the three borrower segments. Live on term-sheet negotiations and closed (or nearing close on) your first institutional credit relationship at Gauntlet. Established as the Capital Markets point of
    contact for at least one institutional counterparty, with the relationship owned end-to-end.

    In 1 year. Originated and closed multiple institutional credit relationships, contributing meaningful incremental book size. Operating an owned book with a consistent maintenance, renewal, and expansion cadence. Recognized internally and externally as a Gauntlet voice on institutional borrow origination. Contributed reusable playbooks and terms guidance that compress future deal cycles for the Capital Markets team.

What you bring;

  • 2–6 years in Investment Banking, Leveraged Finance, or Capital Markets at a leading sell-side institution. Sell-side experience is preferred, though exceptional buy-side candidates will be considered.
  • Direct experience with financing transactions, debt raises, warehouse facilities, asset-backed financing, structured credit, or other capital-markets products.
  • Credit / leveraged-finance grounding: comfort with collateralization, liquidity, leverage, covenants, counterparty risk, and funding costs.
  • Exposure to transaction execution: financial analysis, credit assessment, due diligence, term-sheet negotiation, documentation, syndication, and deal closing.
  • Experience managing institutional client relationships (corporates, financial institutions, asset managers, market makers, trading firms, funds).
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication.

    • Who We're Looking For

  • Naturally curious about digital assets, DeFi, and the evolution of institutional finance. Prior crypto experience is not required.
    • Someone who enjoys both origination and execution. You are comfortable sourcing opportunities, developing client relationships, negotiating economics, and driving transactions through closing.
    • Comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial environment with significant autonomy and responsibility. You want ownership and early direct impact.
    • Relationship-oriented. You enjoy developing long-term client partnerships, managing complex sales cycles, and building repeat business.

    • Bonus points

  • Existing relationships with funds, market makers / OTC desks, exchanges, asset managers, trading firms, and/or institutional borrowers.
  • Experience with repo, securities financing, structured lending, warehouse facilities, fund financing, prime brokerage, or other institutional credit products.
  • Exposure to private credit, asset-backed finance, specialty finance, or structured products.
  • Prior experience with digital assets, stablecoins, or on-chain infrastructure.

Benefits and Perks;

  • Remote first - work from anywhere in the US & CAN!
  • Regular in-person company retreats and cross-country "office visit" perk

jobs.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

The Senior Manager of Client Relationship Management at Human Interest plays a critical role in driving client success and retention while leading a team of managers of Client Relationship Managers. Reporting to the Director of Relationship Management, this position combines hands-on account management expertise with people leadership to execute our account management strategy and ensure clients maximize value from our retirement savings platform. Key responsibilities include coaching and developing team members, executing account management frameworks, and serving as an escalation point for complex client situations. The role emphasizes a proactive approach to client success, using data-driven insights to drive retention and expansion while maintaining exceptional client experiences. This position is perfect for an experienced people leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about helping businesses provide better retirement benefits to their employees.

About the team

The Client Relationship Management team at Human Interest sits at the intersection of customer success, product adoption, and revenue growth. As the voice of our clients internally and the face of our company externally, this team of relationship builders ensures that our clients receive exceptional value from our retirement platform. Operating with a consultative approach, they help employers and their employees maximize the benefits of our 401(k) solutions while driving retention and expansion. The team prides itself on turning complex retirement concepts into accessible solutions and building long-term partnerships with our diverse client base. As we continue to scale, we're looking for a strategic leader who can maintain our high-touch service model while implementing the systems and processes needed to support our ambitious growth goals.

  • Assist in developing team documentation, training materials, and standard operating procedures
  • Promote customer satisfaction through effective and timely service delivery, always ensuring that every aspect of the issue is permanently resolved.
  • Perform other job-related duties and special projects as required.

What you bring to the role

  • 6+ years of experience in account management, 401(k) relationship management, customer success, or client-facing roles
  • 5+ years of people management experience with a track record of developing high-performing teams
  • Extreme Ownership Culture: Highly accountable mindset with a proven history of taking total responsibility for client outcomes, driving cross-team solutions, and seeing issues through to resolution.
  • Customer Obsession: Unwavering commitment to understanding client goals, anticipating their needs, and delivering exceptional experiences.
  • Analytical & Root-Cause Mindset: Strong capability to analyze data, identify operational trends, diagnose complex client issues, and implement scalable improvements.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Outstanding communication and negotiation skills with a demonstrated ability to influence Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams without direct authority.
  • Tech & Process Savvy: Comfortable navigating product ecosystems, advocating for technical enhancements, and leveraging modern CRM/CS platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight, HubSpot) to automate workflows.
  • Proven ability to drive client retention and satisfaction in a SaaS or technology environment
  • Strong coaching and mentorship skills with experience managing individual and team performance

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services, fintech, or benefits administration
  • Track record of successfully managing enterprise-level client relationships
  • Experience with workforce management and capacity planning
  • Knowledge of 401(k) account management methodologies and best practices
  • Experience with AI tools with a focus in customer success platforms

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.

jobs.excerpt: Our PurposeAt SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future.
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Transformation Manager, Technical Support (East Coast), you will be tasked with owning the execution of our global Technical Support transformation while supporting broader strategic initiatives across the Customer Experience organization. This is not a traditional project management role: you will serve as the central execution owner for the Support transformation portfolio, turning strategy into an integrated operating plan and driving initiatives from concept through implementation and measurable business impact. Reporting into the Head of Customer Strategy and Operations, you will also support high-priority cross-CX initiatives, contribute to tooling, automation, and AI decisioning, and act as an extension of the functional leaders and CCO Office.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own the end-to-end Support transformation plan, translating strategy into clear workstreams, milestones, owners, dependencies, success measures, and implementation plans.
  • Serve as the central program owner across major transformation initiatives including AI and automation, BPO, knowledge management, self-service and deflection, tooling, process optimization, specialization, workforce efficiency, and operating-model changes.
  • Own strategic BPO relationships, including governance, performance management, capacity planning, service quality, operational reviews, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with Support and regional leaders to develop and operationalize Partner-Led Support, including new delivery models with strategic service partners.
  • Establish transformation governance, including operating reviews, executive updates, decision logs, risk management, dependencies, and clear accountability across workstreams, and provide executive-level reporting on progress, business impact, risks, decisions required, and areas that are off track.
  • Define and track the business case and measurable impact of transformation initiatives, including productivity, cost-to-serve, case deflection, backlog, resolution times, customer experience, quality, automation, and partner performance, and build mechanisms to confirm changes are delivering the expected results and adjust the roadmap accordingly.
  • Identify operational friction and recurring failure points using Support data and translate those insights into process, tooling, automation, knowledge, or organizational improvements, including further opportunities to simplify, automate, centralize, outsource, or redesign work as the Support organization evolves.
  • Partner closely with Technical Support, TAM, Public Sector, Engineering, Product, IT, Customer Experience, Finance, Procurement, and other teams to drive cross-functional execution.
  • Help Support leaders implement significant operating-model changes while maintaining continuity of day-to-day customer operations, and drive adoption and change management so new processes, tools, automation, and operating models become embedded in how Support operates.
  • Support the Head of Customer Strategy and Operations on high-priority cross-CX initiatives and on the evaluation, decisioning, and implementation of tooling, automation, and AI across Technical Support and the broader CX organization.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 5 or more years of experience in transformation, business operations, program management, Technical Support operations, Customer Experience operations, consulting, or a comparable role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or co-leading operational transformation programs from strategy through implementation, with at least one initiative at enterprise scale.
  • Experience working within or closely alongside a global enterprise Technical Support or Customer Support organization.
  • Strong program leadership skills with the ability to manage multiple interconnected workstreams, dependencies, risks, and stakeholders.
  • Experience with BPO or outsourced service delivery models, including vendor governance, performance management, SLAs and KPIs, quality, and continuous improvement, along with a strong understanding of modern Support operating models, including AI, automation, knowledge management, self-service, case deflection, workforce optimization, and digital support.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify operational problems through data and convert them into practical changes to processes, systems, and operating models, with the financial and operational acumen to build business cases and quantify productivity, capacity, customer, and cost impact.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive execution across organizations without direct authority, plus strong change-management skills and experience implementing significant changes within live customer-facing operations.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and create structure around complex problems.
  • Experience transforming a global enterprise Technical Support organization, implementing AI and automation within Customer Support, and designing, operating, or scaling partner-led support and BPO service delivery models, is preferred.
  • Cybersecurity, enterprise SaaS, or cloud technology experience, familiarity with Support platforms, CRM and case management systems, knowledge platforms, AI support tooling, and workforce-management technologies, experience with Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, PMP, or similar transformation and program methodologies, and consulting or internal strategy experience combined with hands-on operational experience, is preferred.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health and dependent care FSA
  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • ARAG pre-paid legal
  • Nationwide pet insurance
  • Cancer Care program
  • Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionNebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.
jobs.description:
Description

Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.

We are looking for an Application Security Engineer to own product security end to end — from threat modelling and secure design reviews to vulnerability management and security controls embedded into CI/CD.

You will work closely with product and platform teams to make security part of the engineering process, building secure defaults and helping prevent vulnerabilities from reaching production without slowing development down.

What you will do

  • Own application and product security end to end, from design reviews and threat modelling to vulnerability remediation and follow-up.
  • Partner with product and platform teams to embed security into the development lifecycle rather than treat it as a final review step.
  • Build and improve security controls in CI/CD, including SAST, dependency, secrets, container, and IaC scanning.
  • Review application designs and code where security risk is meaningful, and turn recurring findings into secure defaults, shared libraries, lint rules, and CI gates.
  • Drive vulnerability management across application code and cloud posture, including triage, risk-based prioritisation, remediation timelines, and external pentest findings.
  • Strengthen security in multitenant B2B systems, including tenant isolation, authentication, authorization, RBAC / ABAC, and access controls.
  • Work on cloud and Kubernetes security across AWS environments, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
  • Help translate GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 requirements into practical engineering controls and system properties.
  • Develop and support a security champions programme to help engineering teams adopt secure practices in their day-to-day work.
  • Address security risks specific to AI and LLM-powered features, including prompt injection, data leakage, and untrusted model output.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on Application Security or Product Security.
  • Strong software engineering background with the ability to read, review, and write production code; Python experience is highly preferred.
  • Deep practical knowledge of web application security, including OWASP Top 10, ASVS, authentication and session management, OAuth2 / OIDC / SAML, and authorization issues such as IDOR and broken access control.
  • Experience securing multitenant or B2B SaaS products, including tenant isolation, RBAC / ABAC, and access control models.
  • Hands-on experience embedding security into CI/CD, including SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container scanning, and IaC scanning.
  • Strong experience with threat modelling, secure design reviews, and secure code reviews in collaboration with product and engineering teams.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities based on risk, criticality, and exploitability, including remediation prioritisation and escalation when needed.

Role: Controller
Company: Ecom CFO
Location: Remote – U.S. Based

About Us

We are the modern accounting and finance partner for consumer brands across ecommerce and wholesale. Our clients rely on us to not only close the books but to help them understand profitability across retail, distributor, and e-commerce channels. We are looking for a strong Controller who thrives in a fast-paced, client-service environment and has deep expertise in QuickBooks Online (QBO), inventory-heavy accounting, ecommerce revenue recognition, and CPG trade-spend nuances.

Role Overview

The Controller is responsible for the review and quality assurance of month-end close process, financial reporting, and accounting operations across a portfolio of consumer brand clients. You will oversee the work prepared by bookkeepers – reviewing journal entries, reconciliations, and financial packages for accuracy prior to client delivery (and revising as necessary). This role sits between the preparers and the Accounting Services Manager: your job is to catch errors, enforce accounting standards, and ensure the books are clean and close-ready. This role requires a blend of technical GAAP knowledge, QBO expertise, and practical understanding of ecommerce- and CPG-specific accounting (e.g., Amazon & Shopify revenue recognition, UNFI/KeHE deductions, 3PL reconciliations, etc.).

Key Responsibilities

Month-End Close & Reporting

  • Review and sign off on month-end close packages prepared by bookkeepers for assigned clients, including journal entries, accruals, inventory adjustments, and balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Prepare client-ready month-end close financial packages with supporting commentary for client leadership teams in a timely fashion.

Systems & Tools

  • Review and maintain QBO environments for assigned clients – auditing chart of accounts structure, class and location tracking, and integration mappings (e.g., , Ramp, Expensify, Cin7, Shopify, Amazon, SPS, etc.) to ensure accuracy and consistency.

  • Identify and escalate systems issues, integration errors, and workflow inefficiencies to the Accounting Services Manager; contribute to process improvements as a subject matter expert on day-to-day accounting workflows.

Ecommerce-Specific Accounting

  • Reconcile ecommerce platform payouts and marketplace settlements (Shopify, Amazon, etc.) against the general ledger; prepare and review gross-to-net revenue analysis by channel and platform.

  • Reconcile inventory, costing entries, and COGS across multiple channels and 3PL providers; identify and resolve discrepancies against client inventory systems.

  • For clients with wholesale revenue: review and sign off on accounting for trade promotions, distributor deductions, and chargebacks.

Team Review & Internal Collaboration

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for clients on routine accounting questions and close- or financial operations-related issues, escalating relationship matters, new scope, and strategic financial questions internally as needed.

  • Serve as the primary reviewer of bookkeeper work product across assigned clients, providing written feedback, encoring accounting standards, and ensuring deliverables are close-ready.

  • Support fractional CFO services for clients across budget, forecast, and financial model preparation.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related field required; CPA preferred but not required.

  • 5–7 years of accounting experience with strong emphasis on month-end close, financial reporting, and review – ideally within CPG, wholesale, or ecommerce.

  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO), including advanced features, reporting, and integrations.

  • Familiarity with inventory management systems (e.g., Cin7, NetSuite, DEAR, etc.) and EDI preferred.

  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP as applied to inventory, trade spend, and revenue recognition in ecommerce and/or CPG environments.

  • Comfortable managing multiple client deadlines simultaneously in a fast-paced, remove accounting services environment.

  • Advanced Excel skills (e.g., pivot tables, reconciliations, modeling).

  • Excellent communication skills; able to interact confidently with client contacts on day-to-day accounting matters.

We’re not just another accounting firm — we’re trusted partners to some of the fastest-growing consumer brands, leveraging modern technology to improve efficiency, scalability, and client experience.

Why Join Us

  • Be part of a fast-growing firm redefining how consumer brand operators view their financials.

  • Exposure to some of the most innovative consumer brands in the market.

  • Growth opportunities as we scale.

  • Collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with a focus on efficiency, client impact, and career development.

Perks & Benefits

  • Healthcare: available through ICHRA reimbursement

  • Retirement: 401(k) plan incl. company match for contributions up to 3% of salary

  • Bonus: annual bonus subject to company’s discretion and performance

  • Fully remote role

🚀¿Te unes al reto?

En BIP – xTech estamos buscando a gente con ganas de crecer, aprender y enfrentarse a proyectos tecnológicos de verdad: cloud, datos, IA, seguridad, workplace moderno, automatización, DevSecOps, IoT, Industria 4.0… ¡Aquí no te vas a aburrir!

💼 ¿Qué harás?

La IA ya está escribiendo código. Herramientas como GitHub Copilot o Claude Code permiten generar aplicaciones completas en muy poco tiempo, y alguien tiene que asegurarse de que lo que llega a los entornos es seguro, cumple las normas y está bien desplegado. Ahí entras tú.

Buscamos a una persona con un conocimiento profundo de Azure DevOps para diseñar y gobernar los pipelines que despliegan aplicaciones generadas con IA. Tu misión será construir los guardarraíles: validaciones, controles de calidad y seguridad, políticas y aprobaciones que impidan que nada fuera de compliance llegue a producción, sin frenar la velocidad que aporta la IA.

✅Lo que necesitamos de ti:

Imprescindible tener al menos 3 años de experiencia trabajando con Azure DevOps, con especial foco en:

  • Diseño y mantenimiento de pipelines YAML multi-stage: templates reutilizables, extends templates obligatorios, variables y variable groups, pipelines de CI/CD para aplicaciones e infraestructura.
  • Configuración y administración de Azure DevOps: organizaciones, proyectos, repositorios, agent pools (Microsoft-hosted y self-hosted), service connections y su gobierno.
  • Gestión de permisos y seguridad: grupos, roles, herencia de permisos, principio de mínimo privilegio, protección de service connections y secretos.
  • Políticas de rama y control de calidad: branch policies, pull requests obligatorias, revisores requeridos, build validation y status checks.
  • Environments, approvals and checks: aprobaciones manuales, gates, business hours, required templates y controles previos al despliegue.
  • Integración de seguridad en el pipeline (DevSecOps): análisis estático (SAST), escaneo de dependencias (SCA), detección de secretos, escaneo de contenedores y de IaC.
  • Comprensión de Terraform: saber leer, revisar y validar código Terraform, entender el ciclo plan/apply, la gestión del state y los módulos. Si además lo has escrito y mantenido en proyectos reales, mucho mejor.
  • Conocimiento de Azure: suscripciones, grupos de recursos, identidades (Managed Identities, Service Principals, Workload Identity Federation) y Key Vault.
  • Experiencia utilizando asistentes de IA como GitHub Copilot o Claude Code, y sobre todo capacidad crítica para revisar, validar y asegurar el código y la infraestructura que generan.

🔍Nos suma mucho si además:

  • Has trabajado con herramientas de policy as code o análisis de IaC: Azure Policy, OPA/Conftest, Checkov, tfsec/Trivy, TFLint o Sentinel.
  • Conoces herramientas de seguridad de código como GitHub Advanced Security for Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Snyk o similares.
  • Tienes experiencia con despliegues en AKS y contenedores, App Services, Azure Functions o APIM.
  • Has trabajado con GitHub Actions además de Azure DevOps.
  • Te manejas con scripting en PowerShell, Bash o Python.
  • Tienes formación técnica (Informática, Telecomunicaciones, etc.).
  • Te manejas bien en inglés.
  • Tienes alguna certificación oficial (AZ-400, AZ-104, Terraform Associate…).

🧠¿Qué valoramos?

  • Mentalidad de "seguro por defecto": que lo correcto sea lo fácil para los equipos.
  • Criterio para equilibrar control y agilidad, sin convertirte en un cuello de botella.
  • Actitud consultiva y capacidad para explicar el porqué de cada control a equipos de desarrollo y negocio.
  • Ganas de aportar, trabajar en equipo y crecer.
  • Responsabilidad con tu trabajo y compromiso con el equipo.
  • Curiosidad por la IA generativa aplicada al desarrollo y sus riesgos.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Location: Remote, U.S.-based (Eastern Time Zone preferred, with easy access to Washington, DC); approximately 20% travel

Employment Type: Full-time, exempt

Work Authorization: Must meet applicable U.S. citizenship or permanent residency requirements for federal security and access

Role Focus: Technology strategy and end-to-end ownership of a FedRAMP-authorized secure data platform, including architecture, cloud operations, cybersecurity, compliance, and researcher services

Reporting: Reports to the CEO; serves on the senior leadership team and advises the Board of Directors and Technology Advisory Board

About the Role

BizFirst is assisting our client with the search for a Chief Information & Operations Officer (CIOO) who will own technology strategy and the end-to-end security, reliability, scalability, and continued evolution of its secure research and data platform. This leader will oversee platform architecture and development, cloud and production operations, cybersecurity and compliance, data infrastructure, researcher services, internal systems, and technology support. A critical first-year priority is leading the organization toward FedRAMP High authorization.

This is a strategic and operational role. The CIOO sets long-term technology direction while making sure the platform and other critical systems run securely, reliably, efficiently, and responsively. The role is accountable for the technology itself and for how successfully researchers, government agencies, and partners can use it.

As a member of the senior leadership team, the CIOO advises the CEO, Board of Directors, and Technology Advisory Board on technology strategy, investment, cybersecurity, operational readiness, and risk. The organization is small and mission-driven, so this leader combines executive judgment with a readiness to work hands-on when the situation calls for it.

Our client is a nonprofit that helps government agencies use administrative data to make better-informed public decisions. It builds data infrastructure, analytical tools, and data skills across the public sector, and it operates a FedRAMP-authorized research platform in AWS GovCloud that lets agencies securely link longitudinal data with other states and agencies. The platform supports more than 20 state agencies, several federal agencies, and approved researchers, and the organization's work is backed by leading national foundations.

What You'll Do
  • Develop and execute a technology strategy aligned with the organization's mission, business strategy, growth priorities, contractual commitments, and risk profile, supported by a multi-year platform roadmap shaped by partner and customer needs.
  • Set technology budgets, investment priorities, capacity plans, staffing models, and vendor strategies, and evaluate where emerging technologies can strengthen the platform, security, and operations.
  • Own the architecture, engineering, and modernization of the platform and related secure data infrastructure, leading development of researcher workspaces, data pipelines, analytical tools, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Translate government, researcher, and partner needs into technical requirements and development plans, and move new capabilities into secure, reliable, documented, and supportable production.
  • Own end-to-end platform operations and researcher services, including onboarding, access, workspace and data provisioning, technical support, offboarding, service levels, and escalation procedures.
  • Lead the strategy and execution for progressing toward FedRAMP High authorization within the first year, including security controls, governance, documentation, resourcing, and cross-functional coordination. Embed FedRAMP continuous monitoring into daily operations and manage relationships with the government sponsor, assessors, and partners on FedRAMP, NIST, FISMA, and contractual requirements.
  • Own reliability, availability, performance, and cloud cost across production environments, with clear standards for release and change management, monitoring, incident response, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
  • Lead the secure ingestion, processing, provisioning, and governance of sensitive administrative data, with strong controls for data movement, segregation, access, retention, and auditability.
  • Oversee internal applications, identity and access management, collaboration tools, end-user technology, and service-management practices that keep support responsive and well documented.
  • Build and lead a technology team of employees, contractors, consultants, and vendors; support business development and proposals by assessing feasibility, security, capacity, cost, and delivery; and communicate priorities, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to nontechnical audiences.

Required Qualifications

The following qualifications are essential for this role:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • At least 12 years of progressively responsible technology experience, including leadership in a CIOO, CTO, vice president, senior director, or comparable role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or playing a significant leadership role in a FedRAMP Moderate or High authorization effort, with knowledge of FISMA, NIST, and federal security requirements.
  • Experience building and operating secure cloud platforms that handle sensitive or regulated data, including FedRAMP-authorized or comparable NIST- or FISMA-aligned environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of cloud architecture, cybersecurity, software and product development, data platforms, production operations, and disaster recovery.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across engineering, cloud operations, cybersecurity, data engineering, product delivery, and internal IT.
  • Clear executive communication, including the ability to explain technology priorities, risks, and tradeoffs to leadership, board members, partners, and staff.
  • Pragmatic judgment that balances security, cost, usability, reliability, and organizational capacity, along with a willingness to work hands-on in a small, mission-driven organization.
  • Ability to meet applicable U.S. citizenship or permanent residency requirements for federal security and access, and to travel approximately 20% of the time.

Helpful Experience

Any of the following would be helpful, but none is required:

  • Technology leadership in or for federal government environments (strongly preferred), or broader public-sector or research-sector experience.
  • Hands-on work with System Security Plans, control implementation, POA&M remediation, continuous monitoring, government sponsors, or third-party assessors.
  • Architecture, security, and identity and access management decisions inside AWS GovCloud.
  • Secure research data environments, data enclaves, or platforms that link sensitive administrative or longitudinal data.
  • An advanced degree in a technical or related field.

What We're Looking For

The strongest candidate has personally led the technical, security, and organizational work required for a FedRAMP Moderate or High authorization effort. This person can point to specific decisions on security controls, audits, remediation, and continuous monitoring and can guide the platform toward FedRAMP High in the first year.

This leader is equally comfortable in a board discussion and in the details of a production issue. The CIOO will set multi-year direction with the CEO and board while also guiding technical administration, troubleshooting, and implementation, and building a team and operating model that scale with the organization's growth.

The role suits a CIO, CTO, CISO, VP of Engineering, or senior technology director from a FedRAMP-authorized software company, a secure data platform, or a government technology contractor who wants broad ownership and a clear public-sector mission.

What Success Looks Like
  • Within 90 days, understand the platform architecture, authorization boundary, production operations, researcher services, team, and vendor landscape, and identify the highest-priority FedRAMP High, security, reliability, and capacity needs.
  • Within six months, establish a multi-year technology and platform roadmap, budget, and staffing plan, with clear service levels, escalation procedures, production-readiness standards, and a coordinated plan for FedRAMP High authorization.
  • Within 12 months, lead the organization's progression toward FedRAMP High authorization while running a secure, reliable, well-documented technology operation that meets contractual commitments and sustains FedRAMP continuous monitoring.

Why This Role

This is an opportunity to lead technology for our client, a nonprofit whose platform helps public agencies and researchers use administrative data to make better decisions. You will report to the CEO, advise the Board of Directors and Technology Advisory Board, and own both the long-term direction and daily performance of a platform they rely on.

Benefits
  • Medical plan options with employer contributions toward premiums, plus dental and vision insurance; HSA available with eligible plans.
  • 403(b) retirement plan with a 3% employer match and an additional 3% employer contribution that does not require an employee contribution.
  • 15 to 25 days of paid time off based on years of full-time professional experience, 14 paid holidays, and paid sick, family, and bereavement leave.
  • Additional benefits include short- and long-term disability insurance and potential eligibility for Public Service Loan Forgiveness.
  • $1,500 annual professional development reimbursement and $100 monthly reimbursement for eligible remote-work expenses.

jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Senior Accountant, Financial Reporting to join our team.

Position Description

The Senior Accountant will play a key role in supporting Oklo’s financial reporting and accounting function. Reporting to the Financial Reporting Manager, this role will assist with the preparation and execution of Oklo’s SEC reporting requirements, including quarterly and annual financial statements and related disclosures. Other responsibilities include preparing supporting schedules and tie-outs, assisting with technical accounting research, supporting month-end and quarter-end close activities, executing internal controls, and coordinating with internal and external audit teams. The ability to produce accurate, well-supported work while managing key close and SEC reporting deadlines will be a critical success factor. These tasks will require regular interaction with members of the finance and accounting team, cross-functional business partners, third-party advisors, and external and internal auditors.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Prepare and support quarterly and annual SEC reporting, including Form 10-Q and Form 10-K financial statements, footnotes, supporting schedules, and related reporting packages.
  • Perform detailed tie-outs of financial statements and disclosures to the general ledger, supporting workpapers, and source documentation, and prepare quarterly SEC and US GAAP disclosure checklists.
  • Prepare and maintain financial reporting workpapers for assigned areas, including statements of cash flows, earnings per share, stock-based compensation, equity, leases, and other reporting matters.
  • Assist with technical accounting research and preparation of accounting analyses and memoranda for new transactions, contracts, and accounting standards, including monitoring new FASB guidance and evaluating potential impacts to Oklo’s accounting and financial reporting.
  • Assist with month-end and quarter-end close procedures, including journal entries, account reconciliations, consolidation-related schedules, flux analysis, and other analytical procedures.
  • Perform internal controls in accordance with SOX requirements and maintain complete and organized supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate with external and internal auditors by preparing requested schedules, supporting documentation, and responses to audit inquiries.
  • Support equity accounting and reporting, including stock-based compensation and other equity transactions, and assist with annual and interim accounting assessments such as impairment analyses and other recurring technical accounting matters.
  • Partner with accounting, finance, legal, payroll, equity administration, and other cross-functional teams to obtain information required for accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting processes, workpapers, and controls to increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or related field
  • Three to five years including recent public accounting experience with focus on SEC registrants
  • Strong familiarity with ASC literature; proven ability to research technical accounting topics
  • Proven project management experience
  • Active CPA

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Big 4 audit experience is highly preferred
  • Master’s degree in accountancy preferred
  • Fast growth startup or public company experience
  • Preferred remote location: U.S. Mountain or Central time zones

Competencies

We are looking for someone that is:

  • Analytical—the individual synthesizes complex or diverse information
  • Process and public company oriented
  • Pro-Active – as Oklo’s business evolves we will want to be thinking about the accounting policy and financial reporting implications well ahead of time
  • Problem solving—the individual identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner and gathers and analyzes information skillfully
  • Oral communication—the individual speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations, demonstrates group presentation skills, and conducts productive meetings
  • Organization—the individual monitors a wide range of accounting activities and ensures the execution of routine processes
  • Quality management—the individual looks for ways to improve and promote quality and demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness
  • Judgment—the individual displays willingness to make decisions, exhibits sound and accurate judgment and makes timely decisions
  • Planning/organizing—the individual prioritizes and plans work activities, uses time efficiently and develops realistic action plans

Critical for Oklo:

  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer in a modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $90,000-$110,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

jobs.description:
Department: Data & Technical Services
Location: Indianapolis, IN
Reports To: Director, EDI

Job Summary

The EDI Coordinator is the entry point into the EDI job family at Selerix. This role provides the coordination and execution backbone that keeps the EDI team's work moving—supporting file testing, preparing files for production, monitoring transmissions and tickets, resolving routine connection failures, and maintaining documentation—so that EDI Analysts stay focused on file design and build.

This is a learning role. The EDI Coordinator is not yet independently building EDI files—that comes with the Analyst level—but they are developing the foundational knowledge, habits, and relationships that make a great EDI professional. The role is the first step in a well-defined career path toward the EDI Analyst, Senior EDI Analyst, and Lead EDI Analyst levels.

This task work sits directly on the path between a completed file build and a file that actually delivers in production. That connectivity has real value—and real accountability. When tasks slip, client relationships and delivery commitments pay the price.

Key Responsibilities

Transmission & Ticket Monitoring

  • Monitor EDI file transmissions daily against expected schedules; identify delays, failures, or missing acknowledgments
  • Check the ticketing system on a defined cadence for reported file failures; work routine items—including connection failures such as fingerprint or credential resets—and escalate anything outside the defined playbook
  • Escalate errors to the assigned EDI Analyst with sufficient context—file name, client, error type, timing, and any relevant history
  • Maintain a log of open transmission issues; track status and resolution with no gaps in documentation
  • Learn to interpret transmission reports and acknowledgment codes as part of the development pathway toward independent troubleshooting

File Testing & Production Readiness

  • Support file testing on assigned tasks under the direction of an EDI Analyst—sending test files, tracking responses, and testing existing files that require no new build
  • Complete production approval and scheduling steps on assigned files; confirm the initial production run delivers as expected and document the outcome
  • Sign off completed task work and hand it to the assigned analyst for final review; surface anything unexpected before sign-off, not after

Documentation & File Maintenance

  • Maintain accurate documentation of EDI file specifications, delivery preferences, and client-specific requirements for assigned tasks
  • Update documentation promptly when specs change; documentation should be current enough that another team member could step in without losing context
  • Keep the file setup tracker current for assigned tasks through the implementation and go-live process

Process Support & Learning

  • Support EDI Analysts with defined tasks during busy periods—this is not cleanup work; it is how skills are built
  • Ask questions that go beyond task completion; understand why the process works the way it does, not just how to execute it
  • Actively pursue EDI fundamentals through assigned learning, job shadowing, and direct practice
  • Participate in team discussions, ask clarifying questions, and use every escalation as a learning opportunity

Cross-Team Coordination

  • Communicate clearly and promptly with CSMs and Case Build when information is needed; do not let coordination gaps sit
  • Flag requirements that arrive incomplete or after the point when clean setup is still possible—the sooner the issue is raised, the less it costs
  • Work with Shared Services and internal IT on credential and access resets that require another team; follow through until the connection is confirmed working

Must be eligible for US employment

  • Medical, Dental and Vision insurance
  • 4 weeks paid time off (PTO)
  • 9 paid holidays
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • 401K (with match)
  • Basic Life
  • Long-Term Disability

Description

At Ledgebrook, we are building an Excess & Surplus (E&S) lines insurance company that combines deep underwriting and pricing expertise with a modern tech platform fit for the future of insurance– truly a best of both worlds approach. Our speed and service underpin every decision we make, and our rapidly growing team is a testament to our value proposition resonating with the market. You bring the passion and entrepreneurial spirit, and we’ll provide the opportunity to unleash the very best of your talents and skills. Apply now to advance your career at Ledgebrook.

About the Role

We're seeking a Staff Data and Analytics Engineer who operates at the intersection of deep technical craft and organizational leverage. You'll set the technical direction for our data platform, raise the bar for how we build, and make everyone around you more effective.

You'll own the architecture, establish the standards others build on, and drive outcomes that span engineering, actuarial, finance, and product. When something is broken or missing, you're the one who identifies it, proposes the solution, and sees it through.

You'll work in a modern data stack with python, Airflow, dbt, Terraform, and Snowflake. Your decisions will shape how we scale underwriting intelligence, pricing models, and operational infrastructure for years.

What You’ll Do:

  • Architect the Data Platform – Own the end-to-end design of our data infrastructure. Make the foundational calls on pipeline architecture, data modeling patterns, and platform evolution across Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Terraform.
  • Define Engineering Standards – Establish and enforce practices around data quality, testing, observability, and deployment that the rest of the team builds on. Your patterns become the defaults.
  • Enable Data-Driven Decisions at Scale – Design semantic layers and data models complex enough to support underwriting, finance, and executive strategy. Simple enough that analysts can use them without hand-holding.
  • Drive Data Governance – Own the governance posture: data contracts, SLAs, lineage, and documentation. Make trusted data a property of the system, not a manual effort.
  • Shape the ML and AI Foundation – Partner with data science and engineering leadership to ensure the platform supports advanced analytics, ML pipelines, and AI initiatives.
  • Elevate the Team – Mentor engineers, conduct rigorous code and design reviews, and actively close skill gaps. Your leverage is measured in part by how much better the people around you get.
  • Partner at the Leadership Level – Engage directly with actuarial, underwriting, finance, and product leaders to translate business complexity into technical roadmap. You're a peer to stakeholders, not a ticket-taker.

About you

We love working with people who are eager to learn constantly and genuinely excited about the chaotic, rewarding process of building a company from the ground up.

You’ll be a great fit if you bring:

  • Low Ego, High Impact. You care more about getting it right than being right, and you have the credibility to back it up.
  • Strong Opinions, Weakly Held. You bring a clear point of view and defend it with evidence, but you update fast when the data changes.
  • Builder Mentality. You'd rather ship the solution than write a deck about it. You're still writing code.
  • Multiplier, Not Just Contributor. You measure your success by what the team ships, not just what you built yourself.
  • Team First. You want to win, but only if we win together.

Requirements

Must Haves:

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering or analytics engineering
  • Expert-level command of Python and SQL, with a history of production systems that others maintain and build on.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Airflow, dbt, Terraform, and Snowflake (or equivalents) in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to own platform architecture decisions end-to-end: design, tradeoffs, delivery, and iteration.
  • Track record of driving cross-functional alignment on technical direction without relying on positional authority.
  • Experience building and enforcing data quality, observability, and governance frameworks at scale.
  • Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments where you define the path, not just walk it.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in insurance, fintech, or other regulated domains.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or other BI tools.
  • Experience designing for compliance and data governance requirements (SOC 2, CCPA, etc.).
  • Prior experience building data infrastructure at a high-growth startup for growth stage.

Tech Stack:

  • Languages: Python, SQL
  • Data Stack: Snowflake, dbt, Apache Airflow (AWS MWAA)
  • Cloud Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform
  • Tools: GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Slack

Benefits

  • Full remote flexibility and asynchronous work culture
  • Unlimited PTO and fully paid sick leave
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA and FSA options
  • Additional financial protection and retirement benefits, including a 401(k), company-paid life insurance, and disability coverage
  • A high degree of ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to help build and shape a growing company
  • The chance to make a meaningful impact while working alongside an ambitious, high-performing team
  • Exposure to the challenges and opportunities of a fast-growing startup environment

Compensation

  • Base Salary Range $180,000-$220,000 This is a good-faith compensation range based on what Ledgebrook reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of relevant factors including experience, qualifications, geographic location and other relevant factors.

jobs.excerpt: Notice to applicants: We have seen a rise in recruitment scams.
jobs.description:
Notice to applicants:

We have seen a rise in recruitment scams. Please note that outreach from Khan Academy recruiters will only come from the @khanacademy.org domain. Our team does not use Gmail or other personal accounts for contacting potential candidates. Khan Academy will never solicit money, equipment fees, or sensitive financial information at any stage of the hiring process. We also do not work with external recruiting agencies, so outreach from headhunters presenting opportunities on behalf of Khan Academy is illegitimate. Please always check the email domain and cross-reference the position with the official Khan Academy Careers page to confirm an opening is valid.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMYKhan Academy is a nonprofit with the mission to deliver a free, world-class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers free, high-quality supplemental learning content and practice that cover Pre-K - 12th grade and early college core academic subjects, focusing on math and science. We have over 181 million registered learners globally and are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, focusing on learners in historically under-resourced communities.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY KIDSKhan Academy Kids is a free and fun learning program for children ages 2 to 8. Kodi Bear and a cast of animated characters lead children on a personalized education journey filled with fun, standards-aligned activities in early literacy, math, executive functioning and social emotional skills. Built by a small but mighty team, Khan Academy Kids is used by millions of children in homes and classrooms around the world.

OUR COMMUNITY Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, traditional/non-traditional education, big tech companies, and tiny startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in-house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world-class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.

THE ROLE

Khan Academy Kids is looking for a Senior Efficacy Research and Psychometrics Analyst (24 months fixed-term) to strengthen the evidence base behind our assessments and learning content for children in PreK through 2nd grade.

This role spans two complementary areas. First, you will lead the technical side of our psychometrics and efficacy research: serving as the primary point of contact for our external research partners, managing recurring data extracts, analyzing and interpreting psychometric findings, and helping translate research into product improvements. Second, you will own analytics and reporting for Khan Academy Kids: building and maintaining our KPI dashboard and preparing the recurring reporting that our leadership, philanthropy, and school partnerships teams rely on to make decisions and tell our impact story.

You will work on a small, interdisciplinary team alongside product managers, engineers, designers, and academic experts and collaborate closely with leading external research organizations. We are looking for someone with strong quantitative training — ideally in psychometrics, educational measurement, or a related field — who is energized by using rigorous evidence to improve learning experiences for young children.

Responsibilities:

(1) Psychometrics & Efficacy Research

  • Lead our psychometric research partnership: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for our external psychometric research partnership, supporting study design, data sharing, psychometric analyses, and interpretation of findings
    • Extract, clean, and securely share assessment data with research partners on a recurring schedule
    • Analyze and interpret psychometric findings, including item difficulty, score distributions, growth analyses, concurrent validity, and IRT-based scoring
    • Partner with our product and engineering teams to translate findings into product improvements, such as updates to scoring models and assessment discontinuation rules
    • Collaborate with research partners to develop and publish technical documentation, beginning with the technical manual for our PreK assessment
  • Recruit and manage research partner sites: Recruit and onboard school and district sites for psychometric and efficacy studies; execute MOUs; align on consent procedures and participant incentives; and coordinate site visits for direct child assessment data collection
  • Partner with our legal team to draft and negotiate data-sharing agreements with districts and research organizations, including requirements for pseudonymized and identified data
  • Support efficacy research. Coordinate Khan Academy Kids' participation in ongoing efficacy studies and contribute to the design of future studies, aligning internal and external stakeholders on the research approach

(2) Analytics Reporting and Data Infrastructure

  • Own Khan Kids’s KPI dashboard: Partner with our engineering team to build and maintain the Khan Academy Kids analytics dashboard, including integrations with App Store Connect and Google Play Console. Maintain the dashboard so it can be used by other teams including marketing, school partnerships, and philanthropy.
  • Lead recurring reporting: Prepare recurring app performance reporting, including monthly and quarterly business reviews and periodic target setting. Field ad hoc data requests across teams — for example, writing new SQL queries to support targeted district outreach or grant reporting.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • An advanced degree (PhD or Master's) in psychometrics, educational measurement, quantitative methods or a related field — or equivalent applied experience
  • Strong grounding in psychometric methods, including item analysis, reliability and validity evidence, growth modeling, and Item Response Theory (IRT)
  • Proficiency with SQL and a statistical programming language (e.g., R or Python) for extracting, cleaning, analyzing, and visualizing data
  • Experience with (or eagerness to learn) business intelligence tools such as Looker, and comfort building dashboards and data pipelines
  • Familiarity with responsible data-sharing practices in education research, including student data privacy considerations (e.g., FERPA, COPPA) and work with pseudonymized and deidentified data
  • Excellent communication skills: able to translate complex psychometric findings into clear implications for product teams, funders, and school partners
