Location Designation: Fully Remote

Business Unit Overview:

Group Benefit Solutions delivers comprehensive insurance and absence management solutions for mid-size and large companies. Our work fosters a healthier, happier and more secure workforce, contributing to New York Life’s legacy of being there when we’re needed most. Here, you’ll design, implement and support these solutions directly impacting customers’ lives. At our core, we provide financial security and peace of mind to people through our absence, accident, disability, voluntary benefits and life insurance solutions.

Role Overview:

The Absence Subject Matter Expert (SME), Complex Implementations, serves as the strategic and technical authority for absence and leave solutions during highly complex new business and in-force implementations. This role partners closely with the Senior Implementation Manager to deliver a seamless onboarding experience while ensuring early, high-quality discovery, accurate translation of business requirements, and strong alignment between client expectations and New York Life’s administrative capabilities.

This role serves as an expert advisor across complex absence implementations, including FMLA, PFML, ADA, state-mandated programs, company leave policies, and integrated disability/leave solutions. The SME plays a critical role in operational design, risk mitigation, client education, and implementation governance to ensure successful go-live and long-term client satisfaction.

What You’ll Do:

Strategic Client Advisory & Discovery

  • Lead early-phase discovery for complex absence implementations in partnership with the Senior Implementation Manager.
  • Document clients’ current-state absence practices, workflows, vendor relationships, and pain points.
  • Conduct comprehensive requirements gathering across FMLA, state PFML, ADA, company leaves, and integrated disability programs.
  • Translate ambiguous or highly customized client needs into structured, actionable implementation requirements.
  • Educate clients on NYL’s administrative model, case management approach, compliance framework, and service expectations.
  • Guide clients through best practices and operational transformation aligned to NYL capabilities.
  • Participate in finalist presentations to represent NYL’s absence strategy and implementation strengths.

Implementation Design & Execution

  • Serve as the absence design authority during implementation for clients typically 1,000+ lives, including large middle-market and national accounts.
  • Collaborate with Configuration, Leave Operations, Claims, Data Exchange, Premium Administration, Contracts, and Enrollment teams to ensure accurate system setup.
  • Develop and validate business requirement documents, process flows, case setup specifications, and leave policy rules.
  • Ensure accurate customization of communications, eligibility rules, file feeds, pay rules, and administrative services agreements.
  • Identify risks, gaps, red flags, and process dependencies early in onboarding and proactively implement mitigation strategies.
  • Provide expert guidance on file feed requirements, HRIS integrations, case management configurations, and downstream system impacts.
  • Partner with Electronic Interface Specialists and data teams to validate eligibility structures and integration readiness.
  • Support merger & acquisition implementations and complex in-force modifications involving absence programs.

Governance, Risk Management & Quality Assurance

  • Anticipate implementation risks before they emerge and escalate appropriately.
  • Ensure integrity and timeliness of all absence-related data elements provided to internal setup units.
  • Validate compliance alignment with federal and state leave regulations.
  • Assist IM to ensure readiness for go-live through structured validation and operational sign-off processes in regards to absence.

Client & Broker Engagement

  • Serve as primary absence subject matter authority for clients, brokers, TPAs, and internal stakeholders during complex absence implementations.
  • Participate with the IM to facilitate expert team meetings to align internal stakeholders on responsibilities and deliverables.
  • Support the IM for deliver client-facing absence education materials, process documentation, and system demonstrations when needed.
  • Incorporate Voice of Customer insights to enhance client experience and future implementation practices.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Act as dedicated mentor and functional leader for absence.
  • Serve as escalation resource for complex absence implementations.
  • Lead or participate in cross-functional process improvement initiatives.
  • Develop standardized best practices, documentation templates, and workflow enhancements.
  • Educate internal teams on absence guidelines, compliance requirements, and implementation best practices.
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives that enhance NYL’s absence implementation model and market differentiation.

What You’ll Bring:

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in absence management, disability, or leave administration (FMLA, state-mandated leaves, ADA, company policies).
  • Deep expertise in vendor-based and carrier-based absence administration models.
  • Experience leading complex client implementations or consulting engagements.
  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate risks and translate ambiguous information into structured requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of HRIS platforms, case management systems, integrations, file feeds, pay rules, and compliance frameworks.
  • Proven ability to create detailed process flows, business requirement documentation, and client-facing education materials.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated success managing large, multi-location or national clients (1,000+ lives; 5,000+ preferred).
  • Mastery of federal and state leave regulations and integrated disability programs.
  • Excellent organizational skills with ability to manage multiple complex implementations concurrently.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Preferred Competencies

  • Strategic consulting mindset with ability to influence operational transformation.
  • Strong negotiation skills and ability to gain alignment across diverse stakeholders.
  • High level of organizational agility within matrixed environments.
  • Growth mindset and commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.

Role Impact:

This role elevates absence implementation from case setup execution to strategic advisory leadership. By consolidating and enhancing the prior Senior Leave of Absence Implementation Specialist role, the Absence SME strengthens NYL’s ability to deliver high-quality, risk-mitigated absence implementations, improve operational consistency and compliance integrity, enhance client education and expectation alignment, reduce downstream rework, and position NYL as a market leader in complex absence administration.

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $85,000-$115,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

At New York Life, our 180-year legacy of purpose and integrity fuels our future. As we evolve into a more technology-, data-, and AI-enabled organization, we remain grounded in the values that drive lasting impact.

Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem-solving, and purpose-driven innovation. As a Fortune 100 mutual company, we offer a place to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and deliver solutions that matter. Your ideas drive what’s next, and your growth powers it.

The Manager of Utility & Energy owns CleanSpark's utility relationships and energy pathway. The Manager serves both the inbound and outbound sides of the Land & Power team, informing site selection with utility capacity and queue insight and supporting power-related diligence across the portfolio. Success in this role requires deep utility fluency, negotiation skill, and disciplined cross-functional coordination in a fast-paced environment.

  • Support power-related diligence for both inbound and outbound opportunities in partnership with the Site Selection and Onsite Generation teams.

  • Fluency in tariff structures, rate design, and utility cost modeling.
  • Established understanding of investor-owned, cooperative, and municipal utility structures and decision-making processes.
  • Strong negotiation, analytical, and cross-functional coordination skills.
  • Willingness to travel throughout the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Existing relationships with utilities in CleanSpark's operating regions.

This is a blended role that combines the trusted-advisor mindset of Customer Success, the commercial ownership of Account Management, and the discipline of a strong renewals motion.

This role is especially important as we continue to grow in ANZ and build a more consistent, proactive approach to existing customer revenue. You will partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Support, Customer and Technical Success, RevOps, and Finance to ensure customers have a seamless experience — from onboarding and adoption through renewal, expansion, and continued success.

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally, sharing feedback, risks, product insights, and market themes that can help improve Zensai’s offering and customer journey.

Typical Day in the Life:

  • A typical day might include reviewing customer health, renewal timelines, usage trends, support themes, and CRM updates to prioritize where your attention is most needed.

  • You could follow up on an upcoming renewal by confirming subscription details, aligning internal stakeholders, preparing the customer for the conversation, and addressing commercial questions or objections.

  • You may work with internal teams to unblock a customer issue, coordinate an escalation, or keep an account moving toward a clear outcome.

  • You might identify an expansion opportunity by spotting increased usage, new stakeholder needs, broader business priorities, or customer interest in additional Zensai capabilities.

  • You will keep account records, renewal notes, opportunities, risks, and next steps current so internal teams have reliable visibility into customer status and forecast expectations.

What You Bring

Required Experience

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, Relationship Management, Renewals, or a similar customer-facing commercial role.

  • Proven ability to manage a customer portfolio with accountability for adoption, retention, renewals, and expansion.

  • Experience leading or supporting renewal conversations, including contract timing, pricing discussions, stakeholder follow-up, negotiation, and commercial risk management.

  • Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to identify upsell, cross-sell, user growth, and product expansion opportunities from customer conversations and usage insights.

  • Ability to translate customer goals, adoption patterns, and business challenges into clear success plans, account strategies, and renewal narratives.

  • Confidence working with CRM systems, renewal/opportunity records, customer health data, and forecasting inputs; Microsoft Dynamics 365 experience is a plus.

  • Strong relationship-building skills across customer stakeholders, including champions, business owners, procurement, senior leaders, and internal partners.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical or commercial topics for different audiences.

  • Experience working with Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, HR technology, learning, engagement, or performance solutions is a strong plus.

  • Proactive, accountable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where customer success, commercial ownership, and process discipline all matter.

Why Join Zensai?

  • Join a category-defining company at a pivotal growth stage.

  • Represent a differentiated platform built for Microsoft 365 and Teams.

  • Play a meaningful role in shaping the ANZ customer lifecycle motion across adoption, renewal, retention, and growth.

  • Partner directly with experienced revenue and customer leaders committed to developing top performers.

  • Be part of a culture focused on Human Success, accountability, innovation, and growth.

  • Help shape the future of AI-enabled workforce development.

Process

Apply in just a few minutes. You’ll answer a few role-specific questions plus one about what you need to do your best work. We review applications weekly and keep you updated throughout the process. Learn more about how we hire at Zensaihere!

The benefits!

Work your way: We trust you to do your best work—wherever that happens. Home, office, or a mix. Early start or later mornings? You decide.

Learning: 10% of your working time is dedicated to development. Built in, not squeezed in.

Time off that lets you switch off: Enjoy 20 days of annual leave, plus 5 extra discretionary days on us each year, alongside public holidays and carers leave when life calls.

Family comes first: We offer 6 months paid parental leave for mothers and 4 months for fathers and co-parents—real support when it matters.

Super & security: We contribute 12% to your superannuation, helping you build long-term financial stability, plus workers compensation coverage.

Setup & connection: $1,000 AUD to get your home office right, plus weekly team lunches (or a monthly lunch if you’re remote) and regular social events.

jobs.description:
About HighLevel:HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

What are we hiring for?

Thousands of pods. 50+ kinds of deployments. Four databases. Three teams shipping fast. And until now, nobody whose whole job is the system itself.

Our teams are excellent at building products. Each service has owners, each feature has engineers, each database has experts. What we don't have is the person who holds the entire distributed system in their head, who sees that the retry policy in one service and the queue configuration two hops away are, together, a cascading failure waiting for Black Friday.

That's the seat. Your job is to find the failure before it finds production.

You start with Workflows, HighLevel's automation engine, and one of the largest systems in the company: 3.1 billion enrollments and 21.5 billion action executions every month, traffic peaking at 28,000+ requests per second, running across thousands of pods on GCP with Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Redis, and multiple database engines underneath. From there, your blast radius grows, into Conversations (2.6 billion messages a month) and a brand-new Ticketing system being built right now, where you get to make sure it's born right instead of fixed later.

This is not an architect role where you draw boxes and hand them to someone else. And it's not a feature role where you own a backlog. It's the role in between that most companies never create, and most staff engineers spend their careers wishing existed.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the architecture health of a billion-scale distributed system, its failure modes, capacity limits, consistency guarantees, and the interactions between 50+ deployments that no single team can see

  • Approve critical-path designs. Changes that touch the system's core go through you, not as bureaucracy, but as the person accountable for the whole staying sound. When there's a disagreement, you make your case on merit

  • Hunt gaps proactively, single points of failure, unbounded queues, missing idempotency, thundering herds, quiet data-loss windows, and drive the fixes before they become incidents

  • Build the parts nobody else can. No sprint tickets. You prototype the risky architectural bets yourself, ship the remediation after serious incidents, and pair into the gnarliest cross-team bugs, roughly a quarter to a third of your time in code, all of it on the hardest problems

  • Make resilience a property of the system, not a heroic act, degradation strategies, backpressure, isolation boundaries, capacity models that survive 10%+ month-over-month growth

  • Raise the teams around you. Design reviews that teach, post-mortems that change architecture (not just add alerts), and patterns that 80+ engineers build on

  • Set the standard for how AI-assisted engineering works safely on systems this critical, where a bad merge doesn't cost a demo, it costs real businesses their revenue

    • The terrain:

  • Runtime: Node.js (TypeScript), Go, thousands of pods on GKE

  • Messaging & async: GCP Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Redis

  • Storage: MongoDB, Firestore, ClickHouse, ElasticSearch

  • Scale: 21.5B automation actions/month, 2.6B messages/month, 28.5K req/s peaks, ~226B async events across the org

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of engineering experience with deep, hands-on ownership of large-scale distributed systems, comparable scale strongly preferred: hundreds of services or thousands of instances, billions of daily events

  • You've carried sole accountability for a production system through real failures, not adjacent to it, not advising on it. Owned it

  • Deep command of queueing and async architectures, delivery semantics, ordering, backpressure, idempotency, exactly-once myths and at-least-once realities

  • Strong with multiple storage engines (SQL and NoSQL), you reason about consistency models, indexing at scale, and when each engine is the wrong choice

  • Expert-level depth in Redis or comparable in-memory systems, including their failure modes under memory pressure and network partition

  • Production experience on Kubernetes at scale, resource limits, autoscaling behavior, what actually happens when a node pool dies

  • Exceptional design communication, docs, diagrams, and RCAs that drive decisions across multiple teams

  • Fluent in Node.js and/or Go, enough to prototype your own proposals and ship fixes on the critical path

What Success Looks Like

  • The critical paths of Workflows have named owners, capacity models, and tested failure modes, because you made it so

  • Incident count trends down while traffic grows double-digit percent month over month

  • Your design reviews are the ones engineers want their proposals to survive

  • Your scope has expanded on results, more systems, more surface, more trust

What you're built for

  • You've been injured in production. A lot. You've owned distributed systems at serious scale, through the outages, the migrations, the 3 AM discoveries, and every scar changed how you design

  • You've operated at staff scope, whatever your title said, the engineer everyone routed the hardest systems questions to

  • You think in failure modes by default: when you see a design, you instinctively ask what happens at the tail, under partition, at 10x load

  • You write design docs and RCAs that people reference years later, clear trade-offs, honest risks, real recommendations

  • You can disagree with a team and still make them better, influence through rigor and respect, not title

  • You'd rather prevent ten incidents quietly than be the hero of one loudly

Bonus Points

  • You've made AI agents genuinely productive on complex systems, and know how to keep AI-generated code from becoming AI-generated incidents

  • GCP-native experience: Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, GKE, Firestore

  • You've done this job before under another name, "the systems person," principal engineer, architect-who-still-codes

  • Experience taking a 0→1 system to production alongside hardening mature ones

IMO Health is committed to considering all candidates even if you don’t think you meet 100% of the qualifications listed. We look forward to receiving your application!
IMO Health is a clinical data intelligence business at the heart of a digital revolution in healthcare. Combining rich, highly nuanced medical terminology, extensive domain knowledge, and artificial intelligence (AI), we expertly structure and operationalize clinical data to generate sharper insights and inform more intelligent decision-making. Deeply embedded in the provider world, we developed a comprehensive intelligence layer that captures and encodes patient encounters with unmatched completeness and precision. Now, by weaving ethical and accountable AI into this robust content, we are improving how data is used across the healthcare landscape with powerful new applications in health tech, drug discovery, population health, and payer processes.

IMO Health is seeking a dynamic and results-driven Business Development Director to join our growing Healthcare (Non-Provider) Sales team, an area of significant investment as we expand into new markets and accelerate growth. This individual contributor role will be responsible for driving new business with healthcare technology organizations, particularly companies building products and solutions that rely on healthcare data, clinical terminology, analytics, or AI.

As a Business Development Director, you will sell IMO Health’s clinical terminology, data quality, and knowledge graph solutions to organizations looking to improve the quality, consistency, and usability of healthcare data. You’ll engage with organizations ranging from healthcare IT and analytics companies to population health platforms and emerging AI and agentic AI companies.

This is a true hunter role for someone who enjoys opening new markets, navigating complex sales cycles, and solving customer problems through a consultative approach. No two opportunities will be the same, and success will require the ability to understand a customer’s business and technology challenges, connect those challenges to IMO’s capabilities, and build a compelling path to value.

You’ll play a critical role in expanding IMO Health’s market presence and revenue while helping healthcare technology companies unlock greater value from their data.

IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE:

  • Drive growth by targeting and securing new business opportunities within healthcare IT organizations, effectively positioning IMO Health’s solutions.
  • Boost revenue by developing and executing strategic sales plans that achieve and surpass financial targets.
  • Cultivate and manage strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers to expand IMO Health’s client base and strengthen market presence.

WHAT YOU’LL LEARN:

  • Gain deep exposure to how healthcare technology companies leverage clinical data, terminology, and AI to build and enhance their products.
  • Expand your understanding of emerging applications of knowledge graphs, NLP, and AI within healthcare technology.
  • Develop new approaches to bringing complex data and technology solutions to market across a diverse range of healthcare organizations.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Identify and Secure New Opportunities: Proactively identify, qualify, and advance new business opportunities with healthcare technology organizations, from established platforms to emerging AI companies.
  • Develop Strategic Sales Plans: Build and execute account and territory strategies designed to generate new business and achieve revenue goals.
  • Understand Customer Needs: Engage with business, product, technology, and executive stakeholders to understand their challenges and connect them to IMO’s clinical terminology, data quality, and knowledge graph capabilities.
  • Drive Consultative Sales: Navigate complex, solution-oriented sales cycles by developing a clear understanding of customer requirements, addressing objections, and collaborating with internal teams to shape the right solution.
  • Build Executive Relationships: Establish credibility and trusted relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers, including C-suite and senior technology and product leaders.
  • Manage Pipeline: Build and manage a healthy revenue pipeline, ensuring opportunities progress effectively through each stage of the sales cycle.
  • Present and Communicate Value: Deliver compelling presentations, proposals, and other sales materials that clearly articulate the business and technical value of IMO’s solutions.
  • Forecast and Report: Maintain accurate forecasts and CRM data while providing clear visibility into pipeline, opportunities, and expected revenue.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

  • 12+ years of enterprise sales or business development experience, with a strong track record in healthcare and experience selling to healthcare technology organizations.
  • Strong understanding of the healthcare market and the ability to understand how healthcare data is created, managed, exchanged, and used across technology products and solutions.
  • Demonstrated success hunting for and closing new business, including experience developing leads, building pipelines, navigating complex sales cycles, crafting proposals, and closing high-value subscription or recurring-revenue accounts.
  • Current understanding of technology and AI, with the ability to credibly engage customers in conversations about how AI and emerging technologies depend on high-quality, well-structured healthcare data.
  • Experience with clinical terminology, healthcare data quality, code sets, or the relationships among clinical domains such as medications, labs, and problems is a plus.
  • Familiarity with knowledge graphs, NLP, or related data/AI technologies is a plus.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and earn trust across technical, business, and executive audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to use data and customer insights to shape sales strategies and recommendations.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and energized by opening new markets and creating opportunities where there is not yet an established playbook.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform and experience using CRM data to manage pipeline and sales performance.
At IMO Health, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. IMO Health is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.
Visa sponsorship may be available for select positions at IMO Health. Qualified candidates who require sponsorship are encouraged to apply.

Job Opening Details:

Bionews, a digital news company dedicated to creating communities for patients with rare and chronic diseases and their caregivers, is looking for members of the myasthenia gravis (MG) community to join our freelance staff of caregiver columnists on Myasthenia Gravis News.

A Bionews columnist is a patient or caregiver who shares about life with a rare or chronic disease. They write personal essays in a column format to inform, inspire, empathize, and advise. Their audience includes patients, caregivers, medical teams, and researchers. Columnists also write to a general audience interested in learning how to improve society's understanding and treatment of disease/disability communities.

All columns are reviewed with a critical eye by professional editors who will work with columnists to smooth rough spots and help the columnist grow as a writer. This is a contract position.

Please note you MUST be a member of the myasthenia gravis community -- caregiver preferred -- in order to apply for this position.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Fulfill 1x weekly deadlines as agreed upon on hire.
  • Communicate efficiently with your managers and editors.
  • Submit 400-800 word drafts that adhere to Bionews policies and procedures.
  • Aside from exceptions, drafts should not take more than 45 minutes to edit.
  • Fulfill revisions as requested by editors in a timely manner.
  • Complete training assigned by Bionews HR.

Experience Required

  • Prior experience with writing for an audience.
  • At least three months’ direct experience with caring for someone with MG.
  • Caregivers must be direct relatives, guardians, or spouses.

Experience Preferred

  • Experience in being professionally edited for publication.
  • Experienced in generating a blog or column.
  • Participation in support groups, internet forums, or community groups relevant to MG.

Knowledge Required

  • Fundamentals of how MG works.

Knowledge Preferred

  • The content needs or wants of the MG community.

Skills Required

  • A swift and independent learner of Internet technology.
  • A creative mind capable of regularly generating unique content that appeals to target audiences.
  • Time management.
  • Advanced creative writing.

Skills Preferred

  • Experience in using WordPress for content creation.
  • Experience with the Slack communication app.

Abilities Required

  • Internet access and use.
  • Native or fluent English writing and reading abilities.

Who is Bionews?
Bionews is a leading online health, science, publication, and research company with one purpose: to serve patients with a rare or chronic disease. We do this by connecting them with current, trusted, and relevant news and information. This content is delivered regularly and provided by actual patients as well as professional journalists, writers, editors, scientists, and experienced media executives. Our end customers are truly patients living with rare and chronic diseases. Visit www.bionews.com for more information.

Bionews Vision
To empower, inspire, and champion the patient voice as the preeminent resource that engages, informs, and connects the global rare and chronic disease community.

Bionews Purpose
We connect rare and chronic disease communities by providing a unified and distinctive space to engage, educate, and empower those affected by rare diseases to help improve patient health and quality of life.

Values: R.A.R.E.

  • RESPONSIBILITY
  • ADVOCACY
  • RELATIONSHIPS
  • EMPOWERMENT

We are opening a freelance opportunity for the Safety Project — Emotional Distress (Clinical track), a project focused on evaluating how AI systems respond in sensitive conversations involving emotional distress, suicidal ideation, and depression. Evaluation — review AI responses against clinical criteria, assessing risk recognition, appropriateness of safety messaging, empathy, accuracy of psychoeducation, and adherence to evidence-based crisis-response practices.

Licensed or formally trained professionals in psychiatry, clinical psychology, counseling psychology, psychiatric nursing, or related mental health fields— including those working in crisis centers, helplines, or other mental health support environments.   • Psychiatry or psychiatric nursing - Clinical or counseling psychology - Crisis intervention or suicide prevention specialists - Social work focused on mental health - Helpline or support center professionals (clinical role) - Emotional health coaching or therapy with formal training - Researchers or educators in mental health and risk assessment

Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection. Driven by our mission to protect, manage and automate every workload that businesses and lives depend on, we’ve built the industry’s only all-in-one solution.

In the role of Analyst Relations Manager you will help strengthen our position with the industry analysts and research firms shaping the cybersecurity, data protection and managed service provider markets.

You will build trusted relationships with influential analysts, translate Acronis' product and business strategy into compelling market narratives, and ensure analyst insights inform how we position our technology, products and market opportunities.

You will own analyst engagement across key areas of Acronis' business, including cybersecurity, endpoint protection, backup and disaster recovery, cyber resilience, MSP platforms, and emerging areas such as AI and OT/industrial cyber resilience.

jobs.excerpt: About VettoVetto is a tech company focused on building and scaling high-quality datasets for artificial intelligence systems.
jobs.description:
About Vetto

Vetto is a tech company focused on building and scaling high-quality datasets for artificial intelligence systems. We work at the intersection of human expertise and AI, ensuring that models are trained on technically accurate, well-defined, and realistic data.

Our projects support the training and evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs), where technical rigor and correctness are non-negotiable.

About the Project

This project focuses on the technical review and validation of coding tasks used to train AI models.
Automated code is generated in response to software engineering prompts, and your role is to evaluate whether that code is correct and truly solves what was asked.

The core questions you will be answering on every task:

  • Is the coding task technically well-defined?
  • Does the generated code actually solve the problem?
  • Are the associated tests robust, correct, and aligned with real-world software behavior?

Tests are treated as the mechanism of truth in this context. Mistakes here propagate at scale into AI systems, error criticality is high.

Languages

Tasks in this project involve code written across multiple languages. You will be expected to review and evaluate tasks in any of the following: Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, Go, Rust, and Java.

Strong command of at least two of these languages is required. Breadth across languages is a plus.

Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze generated code against the original software engineering prompt
  • Evaluate whether the coding task itself is clearly and correctly defined
  • Validate whether tests accurately reflect whether the problem has been solved
  • Identify gaps, ambiguities, false positives, and false negatives in test suites
  • Determine whether a solution that passes the tests genuinely solves the underlying problem
  • Apply strict technical criteria and quality standards consistently across tasks

Required Profile

This role is designed for mid/senior-level software engineers with real professional experience.

Technical requirements

  • Proven professional experience in software development (production environments)
  • Strong command of at least two of the listed languages
  • Experience reviewing and evaluating code written by other engineers
  • Solid understanding of automated testing — how tests validate (or fail to validate) behavior
  • Experience contributing to or working with open source projects
  • High attention to detail and strong technical judgment
  • Comfortable working fully in English (reading and writing)

Nice to have

  • Experience with test-driven development (TDD) or test design
  • Familiarity with large or complex codebases
  • Background in AI, ML, or data-centric projects

Project Details

This is expert, task-based technical work focused on analysis, validation, and judgment — not code production. Each task takes approximately 30 minutes. Tasks are reviewed under continuous QA and calibration.

Compensation is in the range of $100 per hour (task-equivalent reference), varying based on task complexity and approved volume.

Selection Process

The selection process is fully asynchronous and based on your application. There are no interviews: we evaluate candidates through their background, screening responses, and a short technical exercise focused on code review and test validation.

No traditional interviews required.

Final Note

This role is not about writing more code. It is about technical judgment, rigor, and responsibility.

If you are comfortable challenging problem definitions, questioning tests that "pass but are wrong", and acting as a technical quality gate, this project is for you!

What does a day in the life of a Technical Support Engineer look like?

Ticket Triage & Intake

  • Serve as the first point of contact for incoming Engineering & Integration requests, including Engineering Service Requests and integration tickets; review, categorize, and triage independently.
  • Confirm what a requester actually needs versus what they initially ask for, gathering the detail and required fields needed before a request is routed onward.
  • Route tickets to the correct owner and approval path, and escalate appropriately when a request is out of scope or higher-risk.
  • Prioritize a live queue against documented SLAs; identify and flag at-risk tickets early.

Integration Request Handling

  • Work integration tickets across the three request types: new integration requests, integration access changes, and integration break/fix.
  • Confirm scope with the customer (what they want to integrate or change about an existing integration, or what is broken) and capture the required intake information.
  • Follow the defined approval workflow, ensuring the necessary reviews are completed before any change proceeds.
  • Follow up with customers through the ticketing system, keeping them informed and closing the loop.

Integration Troubleshooting & Break/Fix

  • Troubleshoot integration issues across Salesforce, MuleSoft, many SaaS platforms, and custom integrations, reproducing problems and isolating root cause.
  • Own break/fix integration tickets end to end, from first report through resolution, coordinating with engineers where deeper investigation or a code change is required.
  • Document findings and resolutions as knowledge articles so recurring issues can be resolved faster and more consistently over time.
  • Problem Management & Continuous Improvement
  • Look across tickets for recurring problems and patterns rather than treating each in isolation, and surface the underlying causes.
  • Partner with engineers to drive persistent issues to a permanent upstream fix, reducing repeat tickets and overall queue volume over time.
  • Identify manual or repetitive steps that are good candidates for automation, and propose improvements to intake, triage, and support processes.

Knowledge, Documentation & Reporting

  • Own and curate the knowledge base, runbooks, and SOPs that both the team and our AI tooling rely on, keeping them accurate and current.
  • Produce clear, consistent documentation and notes in Jira and Confluence, and follow written instructions and SOPs accurately.
  • Build and run queries and reports using SQL and Snowflake databases (or similar) to support triage, reporting, and problem analysis.

AI Enablement & Support Automation

  • Help build, tune, and maintain the AI-assisted automation that supports intake and triage, including the knowledge and prompts it relies on.
  • Review the output of AI tooling, correct it where it is wrong, and handle the exceptions and edge cases it cannot resolve.
  • Use AI chat tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar) as a routine part of triage, documentation, research, and communication, and bring practical ideas for extending them into the team.

Customer Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Work with internal customers to understand what they actually need versus what they first ask for, clarifying and negotiating scope so requests are well-formed and realistic.
  • Communicate professionally through the ticketing system: acknowledge requests, ask the right clarifying questions, follow up, and confirm resolution.
  • Manage expectations across requesters and stakeholders, giving clear status and proactively flagging when documented SLAs are at risk.
  • Approach every interaction with a customer-service mindset.

Judgment & Collaboration

  • Work independently and take ownership of the queue, while knowing when to ask for help or escalate.
  • Stay effective when working with ambiguity or partial information, gathering what is missing rather than stalling.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts, and stakeholders across the team and adjacent functions.

  • 1- 2+ years experience in a technical support, service desk, operations, or coordination role, ideally including exposure to ticketing systems and cross-team troubleshooting.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, or a related field but equivalent experience considered in place of a degree.
  • Proficiency in Jira and Confluence.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce (end user experience is acceptable)
  • Foundational troubleshooting ability across integrations (Salesforce, MuleSoft, many SaaS platforms, and custom integrations or any similar tool), or a demonstrated aptitude to learn them quickly.
  • Familiarity with SQL and Snowflake databases (or similar). Foundational exposure is sufficient at hire; you will use and deepen these skills in the role.
  • Demonstrated comfort using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) in day-to-day work, and an interest in helping build and improve AI-assisted workflows.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to spot recurring patterns and think about root cause, not just the ticket in front of you.
  • Strong attention to detail and a habit of clear, consistent documentation and note-taking.

Sales Development Representative (SDR)

With our headquarters in vibrant Jacksonville, FL, and an exciting office in Bangalore, India, along with an exceptional remote workforce across the United States, we're a global team united by a powerful mission.

We're on a mission to bring the focus back to what truly matters, patient care. As the leading healthcare engagement platform, we're the heartbeat of an industry that impacts millions. Join our energetic, dynamic, and forward-thinking team where your ideas are celebrated, innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. The Sales Development Representative (SDR) supports revenue growth through a combination of outbound business development and ownership of select transactional opportunities. The SDR partners closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and cross-functional stakeholders to leverage account engagement data, Salesforce insights, AV360 intelligence, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to prioritize target accounts and identifytimely outreach opportunities. In addition to outbound prospecting, the SDR may manage assigned low-risk commercial opportunities, including low-dollar or no-dollar contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), renewals, and similar transactional engagements.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, commercially minded, highly organized, and motivated to build a successful career in sales. Success in this role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, relationship-building capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.

Sponsorship, in any form, is not available for this position.

  • You will play a direct role in driving revenue growth and expanding Availity's market presence.

  • You will partner closely with experienced Account Executives and sales leaders to develop critical sales skills and commercial acumen.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to prioritize multiple activities and opportunities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce or similar tools.

  • Strong organizational and follow-through skills.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to leverage data to drive prospecting efforts.

  • Experience identifying buying signals and qualifying opportunities.

  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships and influence outcomes across internal and external stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with contracts, Statements of Work, renewals, or transactional sales processes.

  • A desire to build a long-term career in sales and business development.

You will be:

Driving outbound sales development efforts

  • Executing outbound prospecting campaigns through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other approved channels.

  • Generating meetings and qualified opportunities for Account Executives through targeted outreach.

  • Conducting discovery conversations to understand customer needs and business challenges.

  • Re-engaging dormant opportunities, historical leads, and existing customer contacts.

Using data-driven account intelligence

  • Analyzing account engagement data, marketing activity, Salesforce insights, AV360 signals, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator intelligence.

  • Escalating opportunities that exceed established complexity, risk, or financial thresholds.

  • Tracking opportunities through completion and maintaining visibility into status, next steps, and outcomes.

Supporting sales intake and work routing

  • Providing recommendations to leadership regarding work allocation opportunities.

  • Assisting with the efficient transition and handoff of reassigned work.

  • Following established routing and operational processes.

Collaborating with Marketing and Sales teams

  • Supporting coordinated campaign follow-up activities.

  • Sharing insights regarding engagement trends, lead quality, conversion rates, and prospect feedback.

Maintaining CRM and reporting excellence

About VisionPoint Marketing

Our award-winning work is showcased on national conference stages, but our greatest pride is making life easier—and more successful—for our client partners. Headquartered in Raleigh, NC, we operate as a remote-first company with VisionPointers across every U.S. time zone, while offering hybrid and in-person options for those near our headquarters.

The Opportunity

As a CRM Strategist at VisionPoint, you'll have the opportunity to shape how we develop and execute CRM strategies that drive meaningful results for our clients. As part of our Strategy Team, you'll work alongside marketing strategists to connect marketing strategy, customer journeys, and CRM technology, helping colleges and universities create better experiences for prospective students and achieve their enrollment goals.

This role offers a unique combination of strategic thinking and hands-on execution. You'll be involved in developing the strategy, identifying opportunities, designing solutions, and bringing those solutions to life through CRM implementation and optimization. You'll have a voice in determining not just how we execute the work, but what we recommend to our clients and why.

As an official Slate and Element451 partner, VisionPoint works across multiple CRM platforms to ensure our clients have the right technology, strategy, and processes in place to achieve their goals. We remain intentionally CRM agnostic, and your expertise will help us support clients across a variety of platforms, including Salesforce and other CRM solutions.

You'll collaborate closely with marketing strategists, account directors, project managers, and other specialists while working directly with clients to understand their goals, develop solutions, and lead CRM implementations and optimization efforts.

Whether your background is in higher education or another industry, we're looking for someone who understands how CRM technology supports the customer journey and is excited about using that expertise to influence strategy, improve customer experiences, and deliver measurable results.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Marketing Strategists to develop integrated marketing and CRM strategies that support client goals and improve the customer journey.
  • Conduct audits of client CRM systems to assess current configuration, functionality, utilization, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop CRM project goals, strategies, and implementation plans that translate client objectives into actionable solutions.
  • Lead CRM implementations and optimization efforts, applying technical knowledge of CRM data structures, integrations, workflows, and user experience to translate strategy into effective solutions.
  • Provide strategic guidance and hands-on execution across key CRM functions, including
    • Data management
    • Governance
    • Lead capture, management, and nurture
    • Event management
    • Multip-channel Orchestration
    • System integrations and workflow automation
  • Interaction tracking
  • Application and forms
  • Analytics and reporting
  • Audience segmentation and personalization
  • Marketing automation and communication journeys
  • Identify gaps, risks, and opportunities within client CRM systems and recommend solutions that improve performance and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to establish project priorities, develop implementation plans, and ensure successful execution.
  • Develop reporting and analytics to measure CRM performance, marketing effectiveness, and return on investment.
  • Contribute to VisionPoint’s CRM methodologies, best practices, and technology partnership programs.
  • Support new business opportunities by providing CRM expertise during discovery, solution development, and client presentations.

Who You Are

The ideal candidate possess the following skills, interest and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on CRM experience, including system configuration, implementation, administration, or optimization.
  • Strong working knowledge of at least one major CRM platform, such as Slate, Element451, Salesforce, HubSpot, or a comparable solution. Experience across multiple platforms is a plus.
  • Experience developing and implementing CRM workflows, marketing automation, communication journeys, and reporting solutions.
  • Strong understanding of how CRM technology supports marketing strategy, customer journeys, lead management, and broader business objectives.
  • Ability to translate strategic goals and client needs into practical CRM solutions, with an interest in contributing to both strategy development and hands-on execution.
  • Strong oral, written, presentation, and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to communicate complex CRM concepts clearly to both external clients and internal teammates.
  • Tech-savvy with strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with marketing strategists, technical specialists, and other team members toward common goals.
  • Strong time management, organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.
  • Quick learner and self-starter who delivers excellent work efficiently and takes initiative in learning new technologies.
  • Sense of ownership and accountability to the goals, the client, and the team.
  • Desire to thrive in a fast-paced, often changing environment.
  • Thirst for knowledge and commitment to professional growth.
  • Proficient in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, with the ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and software platforms.
  • Actively contribute to VisionPoint’s culture.

A Quick Note

VisionPoint Marketing is committed to building a diverse and inclusive work environment and believes that skills are cultivated through a range of experiences. Even if your past work doesn’t meet all of the preferred qualifications, we still encourage you to apply if you are enthusiastic about this opportunity!

VisionPoint Culture

At VisionPoint, we believe that a strong culture is as much a valued benefit as health insurance, PTO and 401k. That’s why it’s important to us that future team members connect with – and contribute to – our culture. Our communication, our collaboration, our satisfaction and our growth are largely dependent upon whether we all, as individuals, embrace and live out our values. We believe in the work we do, we support each other, we work hard and we like to have a bit of fun too. When it comes right down to it, happy and fulfilled team members produce better work, and better work is what drives us every day.

The American Cancer Society Cancer Action Network (ACS CAN) is the nation's leading cancer advocacy organization. Together with our charitable partner, the American Cancer Society, we work in Congress, state legislatures and local jurisdictions to support evidence-based policy and legislative solutions designed to eliminate cancer as a major health problem.

The Grassroots Manager plans and executes a comprehensive grassroots advocacy program across an assigned geography. This position will cover the states of Maine, New Hampshire and Vermont. This includes attracting volunteers and developing, maintaining, and implementing a volunteer leadership program. The position is responsible for developing and implementing grassroots strategies and campaign plans for local, state, and federal legislative priorities, and facilitating the achievement of ACS CAN volunteer fundraising goals primarily through supporting volunteers in their fundraising. The position embraces diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of the role, particularly through volunteer attraction, development, and engagement. The position models the organization's values and cultural beliefs and complies with all relevant lobbying protocols for each state and executes all assigned administrative duties.

***This is a remote position that can be home based anywhere within the states of Maine, New Hampshire or Vermont. The position includes work across these states and the candidate must be able to regularly travel and work within the communities of these states as needed.***

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Grassroots Strategy, Volunteer Attraction and Engagement, and Organizing: (50%)

  • Develops and implements comprehensive local and state grassroots strategies and advocacy campaigns, demonstrating volunteer constituent support for cancer-related policy initiatives in conjunction with the state Government Relations Director.
  • Supports federal campaigns and congressional champion building for the organization's issues, working collaboratively to execute a grassroots strategy. Organizes volunteers to complete federal activities in collaboration with national teams.
  • Communicates strategically using messages that are tailored to specific political environments and attuned to the rapid pace of legislative activities in assigned state(s). Writes and disseminates e-mails to volunteers, legislative alerts, issue talking points, and training curriculum for a diverse audience of volunteers.

  • Serves as the staff manager of the volunteer structure in the assigned geography coordinating appropriately with leadership volunteers. Accountable to filling any vacancies in the structure and ensuring sufficient capacity throughout the geography.
  • Implement the fundamental principles of Direct-Action Organizing to organize and manage state legislative campaigns.
  • Coordinates campaign activities with grassroots/patient coalition partners, as well as with regional and national ACS CAN teams.
  • Accurately and effectively represents ACS CAN and its mission and in a manner commensurate with the organization's brand.
  • Establishes and maintains strategic collaborations and partnerships with other organizations, as appropriate.
  • Ensures that in leading electoral activity in the assigned state(s) through Cancer Votes, working closely with staff partners and national staff, the program adheres to all IRS and ACS CAN legal and reporting requirements.

Integration and Capacity Building: (30%)

  • Attracts, trains, and develops volunteers, through a variety of internal and external channels, implementing development, communication, training and recognition programs for volunteers.
  • Strengthens grassroots capacity through the ACS CAN's volunteer structure, maintaining excellent relationships with grasstops and grassroots volunteers.

Primary responsibility for maintaining direct local relationships, as appropriate, with elected officials and their staff members.

Volunteer Fundraising: (20%)

  • Encourages volunteer-led fundraising that comports with the organization's guidelines with the goal of raising money, engaging, and growing our volunteer base through existing volunteer networks, including volunteer-led events and volunteer participation in Lights of Hope or other national programs.

  • Supports policy forums or other fundraising events, if applicable.

EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS

  • Political issues or campaign organizing experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience attracting, developing, and engaging volunteers preferred.
  • Fundraising experience is a plus.

Job Description

Join us as a Clinical Research Associate II/Sr. Clinical Research Associate I- Make an impact at the Forefront of Innovation. We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of the global team you'll have the opportunity to perform and coordinate all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. As a Clinical Research Associate II/Sr. Clinical Research Associate I you'll conduct remote or onsite monitoring visits to assess regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You'll manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and monitoring environments (i.e. FSO, FSP, Government, etc). Acting as a site process specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigator sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix

What You'll Do:

Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root Functions cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable.

Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System, CTMS). Performs QC check of reports generated from CTMS system where required.

Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.

Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.

Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools, and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Performs additional study tasks as assigned by CTM (e.g. trip report review, newsletter creation, lead CRA team calls etc).

Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections. Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.

jobs.excerpt: Apptopia is seeking a Head of Fundamental Investor Products to set the strategy for the fundamental investor business and to guide the research that makes it worth paying for.
jobs.description:
Apptopia is seeking a Head of Fundamental Investor Products to set the strategy for the fundamental investor business and to guide the research that makes it worth paying for.

Backed by powerhouse investors like Mark Cuban and ABS Capital, Apptopia estimates worldwide downloads, revenue, and active users for every mobile app, and runs a first-party panel that shows how people actually use those apps: who is engaging, how often, in which cohorts, and what they use alongside it. Institutional investors, equity research teams, and the platforms that serve them rely on that data to read a company's business between earnings prints. Our numbers reach the buy side directly through our own tools and APIs, and through distribution inside the terminals and platforms analysts already live in.

As Head of Fundamental Investor Products, you will own the strategy, the roadmap, and the research agenda for the analyst or portfolio manager who holds a position in a company and needs to know what is happening to that company right now. You decide what we build, which sectors we cover, and what our data has to prove before we sell a claim on it.You decide how we turn our data into value for this user: which products to build, which research to deliver, and which new data points to add. This position reports directly to the Chief Product Officer.

Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy for the fundamental investor business: where we play, which sectors we cover, what we build next, and what we decline to build. Bring a point of view on the market and defend it with evidence.
  • Set the direction the team executes. You define the problem, the user, the success criteria, and the priority order, and the team turns that into end-user product or delivered research. Stay close enough to make the tradeoff calls, far enough to keep your focus on the next 6 months rather than the next sprint.
  • Set the research agenda with data science: which signals we build, which questions are worth answering, and what gets shipped, refined, or shelved.
  • Hold the validation bar. A usage chart is not a product until the signal is shown to track the KPI the company actually reports. Own the standard for that proof (growth-on-growth fit, out-of-sample testing, lead time before the print, performance against consensus) and apply it before we make a read-through claim.
  • Pick sectors where mobile is already top of mind for the investor, and start from the buy-side question rather than from the metric we happen to have.
  • Sponsor the development of the new data points this user will pay for: transaction and subscription metrics, payer identification, demographic and engagement cohorts.. Inform what we build from the panel and what we license, based on what actually moves an investment decision
  • Work across the company as the owner of this user. Partner with data science and engineering on what is possible, with Sales and CS on what customers are actually asking for and where we are losing, with Marketing and Research on how our work reaches the market, and with Partnerships on the platforms that distribute our data inside institutions.
  • Be in front of customers regularly. Sit in on analyst calls, run win/loss and churn reviews with CS and Sales, and turn what you hear into roadmap decisions rather than a backlog of requests.
  • Measure the impact of the strategy and report performance to the executive team and the board.

Skills & Requirements

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product line or business rather than a feature set.
  • Experience setting direction that a team executes. You are comfortable being accountable for outcomes you do not personally specify, and you know how to give a team enough context to make good decisions without you in the room.
  • Fluency with how a fundamental investor works: how a model is built, what a reported KPI is, why consensus matters, and what happens in the weeks before a print. You do not need to have been an analyst, but you need to be able to hold a credible conversation with one.
  • Experience with alternative data, market data, or another data product sold into financial services, ideally including both an application and a raw feed or API.
  • Proven cross-functional influence. You can get research, engineering, sales, and marketing moving in the same direction without owning their teams.
  • Quantitative comfort. You can work in SQL and notebooks, read a regression, and tell the difference between a signal that predicts a KPI and one that merely moves with it.
  • Judgment about data honesty. You can decide what a number is good enough to claim, and you hold that line when there is commercial pressure to overstate it.
  • Experience turning complex data into products a non-expert can use, including AI and agent-driven surfaces where the customer never touches a query.
  • Experience seeking out and incorporating customer and usage data to understand behavior and make better prioritization decisions.
  • Able to reach objectively good negotiation results, efficiently, while maintaining relationships.
  • Creative and analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail.

What do we offer you?

  • Flexible hours, location, and paid time off options
  • Life Improvement Benefit (monthly stipend for employee wellness)
  • Medical and Dental Insurance
  • Company-sponsored 401(k)
  • Free lunch on Fridays

Apptopia is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity and inclusion among our teammates are critical to our success! Apptopia is not able to provide visa sponsorship at this time.

As Digital Experience Marketing Manager, you bring the Ergomed brand to life across three channels: LinkedIn, business presentations, and our brand websites. You improve the quality of output, shorten time to completion, and translate manual workflows into automated ones with appropriate human oversight. You apply these tools to raise the standard and pace of work across all three channels while keeping quality, accuracy, and brand integrity firmly under human control.

This is a hands-on specialist role built on deep channel expertise. You are the team’s expert on LinkedIn, brand websites, and PowerPoint, and you are accountable for channel performance: growing visibility and engagement on LinkedIn, driving the right audiences to convert through the websites, and using PowerPoint to create a premium, persuasive brand experience. You will not define the brand’s core positioning. You will express it clearly and consistently through the right format, design, and message structure for each channel, and you will own the results those channels deliver.

What You’ll Focus On

LinkedIn: organic and paid

  • Grow Ergomed’s brand visibility and engagement on LinkedIn through both organic content and paid campaigns.
  • Create channel-native posts, graphics, carousels, and short-form video that capture attention and motivate the audience to share, comment, and follow.

Desirable

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world.

You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us.

Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.

The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.

Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.

Job Title: Sr. Pricing Analyst

Location: Atlanta, GA, New York, NY, or Remote, USA

Who We Are

Impiricus is the first and only AI-powered HCP Engagement Engine. In 2025, Deloitte named Impiricus the #1 fastest growing company in North America for their prestigious Fast 500 list. Founded by a practicing physician and a senior pharmaceutical executive, Impiricus was created to transform how life sciences companies support physicians. We ethically connect HCPs to pharma resources, reduce go-to-market costs and accelerate patient access to the treatments they need.

With our unique access to the largest opted-in network of HCPs, their insights, and clinical expertise, we are the leading provider of AI technology and real-time channels that life science companies need to deliver clear, reliable, and evidence-based resources directly into the hands of HCPs. Guided by a council of 2000+ trusted HCP advisors, we ensure every interaction is clinically meaningful, ethically grounded and leads to better patient care.

Job Summary

The Senior Pricing Analyst owns the systems, data, and quantitative backbone of Impiricus's pricing function, and owns day-to-day pricing quote support for the Ascend business. This role is the final point of accountability for the pricing platform (DealHub) as new business models go live, and for the integrity of pricing data across our CRM and finance reporting.

This role combines hands-on ownership of day-to-day deal support including quote strategy, deal history, and pricing on individual deals with systems and analytics ownership across the pricing function, translating pricing strategy into scalable systems, dynamic pricing logic, and the dashboards the commercial org runs on every day. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and is expected to set the standard for how pricing systems, data, and deal support are administered, not simply execute against someone else's specification.

Responsibilities

Deal Support

  • Own day-to-day pricing support on individual deals, including dedicated research into the history and terms of prior deals to inform quoting
  • Own quote strategy and quote requests, communicating clearly with sales, deal desk, and leadership stakeholders
  • Support structuring and defending non-standard deal terms, and support review of strategic or large deals led by the Pricing Lead

Dynamic & Inventory-Based Pricing

  • Own the analysis of supply and demand by therapeutic area and launch stage to set and continuously adjust pricing
  • Build, own, and maintain inventory-based dynamic pricing models

DealHub & Pricing Systems Ownership

  • Serve as the company's subject-matter expert for DealHub (Impiricus's CPQ platform); own platform administration and track usage across the sales organization
  • Translate new business-model logic into DealHub configuration and push changes live as models evolve
  • Train sellers on DealHub, track and resolve platform issues, and drive continuous improvement of the system as the single source of truth for pricing

Cross-Product Pricing Analysis & Reporting

  • Execute cross-product pricing analyses and pricing optimization initiatives in support of the Pricing Lead and Pricing Strategy Manager
  • Build, maintain, and enhance pricing KPI dashboards (average discount, price realization, margin by segment, approval cycle time, floor-price compliance)
  • Run recurring analysis of existing product pricing performance across Ascend, Pulse, and Spark and surface findings that inform strategy

Pricing Operations & Data Integrity

  • Own HubSpot/CRM data cleanliness and hygiene for all pricing-related fields and deal data
  • Support finance reporting and other ad hoc operational requests as the pricing function's operational backbone

Pricing Governance Support

  • Help enforce pricing adherence in proposals, SOWs, and contracts
  • Support tactical governance, including approval workflows, discount rules, and deal review

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a quantitative, business, or related field; advanced degree a plus
  • 5+ years of direct experience in pricing, monetization, or related roles, ideally supporting or structuring enterprise deal pricing and quoting in a deal desk or sales-facing pricing capacity; OR strong analytical experience with demonstrated ability to partner effectively with sales teams, even without direct pricing experience
  • Demonstrated, hands-on ownership of a CPQ or pricing platform supporting a multi-million dollar book of business, configuring pricing logic, training end users, and driving adoption
  • Strong quantitative background with direct experience building supply-and-demand or inventory-based dynamic pricing models
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Experience owning CRM data hygiene
  • Track record operating autonomously as the final point of accountability for pricing systems and data - setting standards, not just following them
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to train sales teams directly and translate technical pricing logic for non-technical, cross-functional stakeholders

The base salary range for this role is $80,000 - $110,000

Where you land within the range will reflect your skills, experience, and location, while keeping team parity in mind and leaving room for future growth.

Impiricus focuses on taking care of our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being.

Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents + on-demand healthcare concierge
HSA, FSA & DCFSA: Pre-tax savings options for healthcare and dependent care, with monthly employer contributions to HSA (if enrolled in a high-deductible plan)

Your Work, Your Way: If you’re close to an office, we encourage spending some time in-person to collaborate and connect. If not, remote is always an option.
Home Office Setup: We’ll ship you the gear you need to create a comfortable workspace at home.
401(k): Save for your future with tax advantages (and company match!)

Assisting with candidate screening and recruitment administration

Extremely dependable - if you say you are going to do something, it gets done
Professional and trustworthy
Loyal and interested in growing with the company
Highly organised and detail-oriented
