jobs.description:
Job Profile Summary

The GPUaaS Acquisition / New Pursuits Sales Executive is a senior individual contributor responsible for creating and closing net-new GPU as a Service business. The role owns the full pursuit lifecycle - target-account identification, outbound prospecting, opportunity qualification, discovery, solution orchestration, commercial strategy, proposal, negotiation, contracting, and booking - with a primary focus on new logos and material new GPU workloads. The executive acts as the single-threaded sales owner for assigned pursuits and mobilizes Rackspace GPUaaS specialists, solution architecture, Product, Capacity/Operations, Finance, Legal, Delivery, and strategic ecosystem partners to win complex accelerated-compute opportunities.

Role Mission

Create net-new demand and convert qualified enterprise AI, training, inference, HPC, and accelerated-compute opportunities into profitable GPUaaS bookings. Build a focused pursuit engine that prioritizes high-value accounts and workloads, maintains sufficient qualified pipeline coverage, advances opportunities with urgency and discipline, and wins based on customer outcomes, technical fit, capacity availability, commercial competitiveness, and execution credibility.

Career Level Summary

  • Operates as a senior P5 individual contributor and expert seller for complex GPUaaS pursuits; no people-management responsibility is required.
  • Owns the customer relationship and sales outcome for assigned new-logo and new-pursuit opportunities from first engagement through contract execution and handoff.
  • Leads cross-functional pursuit teams through influence and establishes clear owners, actions, dates, decision criteria, and close plans.
  • Uses customer, workload, competitive, capacity, financial, and pipeline data to determine where to invest pursuit resources and when to qualify out.
  • Contributes field intelligence to GPUaaS GTM strategy, including ideal customer profile, use cases, competitive positioning, pricing signals, buying patterns, and product/capacity requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own an assigned GPUaaS bookings quota and deliver profitable net-new bookings consistent with approved pricing, capacity, contractual, and gross-margin guardrails.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized target-account and workload list focused on organizations with credible accelerated-compute demand, funding, timing, technical fit, and buying authority.
  • Generate new opportunities through direct outbound pursuit, executive networks, marketing-generated demand, strategic technology partners such as AMD and NVIDIA, channel/referral partners, ecosystem relationships, and customer introductions.
  • Qualify opportunities rigorously across workload/use case, GPU platform requirements, cluster size, geography, capacity timing, term, commercial value, decision process, competition, funding, and customer urgency before committing material pursuit resources.
  • Lead customer discovery and translate business and technical requirements into a clear pursuit strategy and differentiated GPUaaS value proposition.
  • Orchestrate Solution Architecture, Product, Engineering, Capacity/Operations, Delivery, Finance, Legal, Security, and executive sponsors to develop executable customer solutions and proposals.
  • Develop and maintain a written close plan for material pursuits, including customer decision criteria, buying process, technical validation, commercial milestones, competition, risks, executive relationships, next actions, owners, and dates.
  • Own proposal, bid/RFP, pricing, negotiation, and contracting strategy in partnership with Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, and GPUaaS leadership; protect approved economics while maximizing probability of close.
  • Create multithreaded customer relationships across economic buyer, technical buyer, procurement, finance, legal, infrastructure/AI leadership, and executive sponsors.
  • Use AMD, NVIDIA, OEM, ISV, channel, and other ecosystem relationships strategically when they improve access, technical credibility, solution differentiation, or probability of winning the pursuit.
  • Maintain accurate CRM data and forecast discipline, including source, stage, amount, term, probability, close date, capacity requirement, next step, blockers, and forecast category.
  • Inspect pipeline weekly for stage movement, aging, qualification quality, capacity alignment, competitive risk, and gap-to-goal; proactively create new pipeline when coverage or conversion is insufficient.
  • Ensure clean transition of booked business to implementation/delivery and the designated post-sale owner while remaining engaged through critical launch milestones when necessary to protect customer confidence and expansion potential.
  • Capture win/loss insights and feed recurring customer, competitive, pricing, product, capacity, and contracting themes back into the GPUaaS operating model.

Knowledge

  • Expert-level enterprise acquisition selling and complex pursuit management, including prospecting, qualification, discovery, executive selling, negotiation, contracting, and closing.
  • Strong working knowledge of GPUaaS, accelerated computing, AI/ML training and inference, HPC, cloud/data-center infrastructure, and the commercial drivers of enterprise AI infrastructure purchases.

Position Summary

We are on a mission to build an industry-leading product on a strong foundation built by a world-class engineering, product, and design team!

We seek an Intermediate DevOps Engineer to join our growing Engineering team. You will also contribute and collaborate with the broader Engineering, Product, and Design teams to understand scalability challenges, development lifecycle bottlenecks, and pain points, make informed decisions about our technology, and deliver frictionless solutions for continuous development and release.

If you are a results-oriented DevOps Engineer who takes pride in their work, is obsessed about reliability, performance, security, and quality, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, and you enjoy driving and owning your work - we want to hear from you!

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Incident Response and Resolution: Participate in incident response efforts and training, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and conducting post-mortem analysis to identify root causes and prevent recurrence
  • Operational Efficiency: Implement best practices and patterns around operating our systems through defining and enforcing rigorous SLAs for availability, performance and security
  • Capacity Planning: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to forecast capacity requirements and scale infrastructure to meet growing demand, optimizing resource utilization and cost efficiency
  • Security and Compliance: Implement security best practices and compliance standards, ensuring the integrity and confidentiality of data and systems
  • Continuous Improvement: Drive a culture of continuous improvement, implementing new technologies and processes to enhance system reliability, scalability, and efficiency

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field
  • You have 4-6+ years of experience in DevOps engineering or a similar role, with a strong focus on building and maintaining highly available, scalable, and secure systems
  • Strong scripting and programming skills
  • Proficiency in cloud platforms, in particular AWS, with hands-on experience in infrastructure provisioning and management tools like Terraform/OpenTofu
  • Experience working in Windows, Linux environments
  • Expertise in containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or similar
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar

Our Tech Stack:

  • .NET, AngularJS/jquery, Angular, and TypeScript
  • [Mobile] Cordova, Java, Objective-C
  • MongoDB, S3, SQS, Lambda - AWS
  • CoffeeScript, Puma, Ruby on Rails
  • Github, Trello, Jira, Slack, Github Actions

Compensation & Pay Transparency

At Practice Better, we believe in pay transparency, equity, and fairness. We benchmark compensation against similar-stage, high-growth SaaS companies in both Canada and the United States and review our salary bands regularly to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with market trends.

Each role has a defined pay range based on its level, scope, and geographic location. Final offers are determined by several factors, including experience, demonstrated skills, and location, to ensure consistency and equity across our team.

Anticipated Salary Range (Canada): $110,000 - $120,000 CAD

We take a holistic approach to compensation, combining salary, benefits, and flexibility. Our goal is to provide total rewards that support both your professional growth and personal well-being.

The range above reflects our expected compensation for this role, based on current market data. Final offers may vary depending on factors such as location, skills, depth of experience, and relevant certifications. All compensation ranges are reviewed regularly and may evolve over time to reflect changes in the market.

We offer a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage from day 1, as well as RRSP matching, generous paid parental leave, and annual learning stipends.

Remote-First, Connected CultureOur remote-first model gives you autonomy and flexibility, with optional access to our downtown Toronto office for in-person collaboration. We also host regular off-sites and team gatherings across North America, because connection, creativity, and shared moments matter.

Thriving at Practice Better

At Practice Better, you are not just an employee. You are part of a mission-driven community dedicated to helping others thrive. You will be trusted with autonomy, encouraged to take ownership, and supported by a team that values curiosity, compassion, and meaningful results.

We believe great culture and great performance go hand in hand. Delivering on our commitments is how we earn the trust of our practitioners and continue to expand our impact. Here, you will find the freedom to experiment, a focus on follow-through, and the opportunity to grow, along with the satisfaction of knowing your work directly improves lives every day.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Belonging

If you do not meet every requirement listed above, we still encourage you to apply. Research shows that underrepresented groups often hesitate unless they feel 100% qualified. We are far more interested in your potential, curiosity, and alignment with our values.

jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Voor de verdere uitbouw en professionalisering van een Microsoft Fabric-dataplatform wordt een senior data architect gezocht, die deels ook als solution architect optreedt. De opdracht focust op het uitwerken van een toekomstbestendige visie op data-architectuur, governance en operationeel beheer, en op het begeleiden van strategische, architecturale en technische keuzes.

  • Meewerken aan de verdere opbouw, vervollediging en verbetering van het dataplatform.
  • Vertalen van conceptuele informatiemodellen naar logische datamodellen.
  • Uitwerken van een datastrategie en data-architectuur voor een duurzame, schaalbare en beheersbare oplossing.
  • Definiëren en toepassen van standaarden rond dataopslag, datamodellering, data-integratie, analytics, security, deployment en operationeel beheer.
  • Ondersteunen bij de uitbouw van governance rond onder meer eigenaarschap van data, rollen en verantwoordelijkheden, toegangsbeheer, datakwaliteit, metadatabeheer en levenscyclusbeheer van dataproducten.
  • Begeleiden van de inrichting van een veilige en efficiënte self-service dataomgeving binnen Microsoft Fabric en Power BI.
  • Adviseren over werkruimtes, semantische modellen, rapporten, apps, publicatieprocessen en gecontroleerde samenwerking tussen verschillende gebruikersgroepen.
  • Samenwerken met betrokken business- en ICT-medewerkers, ICT-architectuur en operations om de juiste invulling aan de opdracht te geven.
  • Afstemmen van keuzes en beslissingen met de betrokken medewerkers en stakeholders via overleg, projectgroepen en stuurgroepen.
  • Coachen van interne medewerkers, kennis delen via terugkoppelsessies en bijdragen aan kennisoverdracht zodat het interne team implementaties maximaal zelfstandig kan uitvoeren en beheren.
  • Waar nodig actief bijdragen aan concrete end-to-end implementaties binnen één of meerdere datadomeinen.
  • Proactief advies formuleren rond verbeteringen die bijdragen aan de verdere maturiteit van het dataplatform.

Het beoogde resultaat is een duurzaam en beheersbaar dataplatform met uitgewerkte architectuurprincipes, governance-richtlijnen, operationele standaarden en één of meerdere geïmplementeerde datadomeinen volgens deze principes.

📌 Context

Er wordt gewerkt aan een robuust en gestandaardiseerd dataplatform op basis van Microsoft Fabric op Azure. Een eerste traject resulteerde in een initiële Fabric-omgeving, de migratie van data van een on-premise SQL Server naar de cloud en een eerste rapporteringsoplossing in Power BI. De volgende fase richt zich op verdere professionalisering, standaardisering en governance, met bijzondere aandacht voor architectuurvisie, best practices en beheersbaarheid.

Een belangrijke pijler binnen deze ontwikkeling is het self-service principe, waarbij businessgebruikers, analisten en data engineers op een gecontroleerde en veilige manier toegang krijgen tot data en analytische mogelijkheden. Dit vereist een doordachte inrichting van Microsoft Fabric, met aandacht voor datagovernance, toegangsbeheer, metadata- en datacatalogisering, werkruimtebeheer en monitoring.

Technologische context van het dataplatform en de bredere omgeving omvat onder meer Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure DevOps, MS SQL Server, Python, SQL en Spark. Daarnaast is er een bredere ontwikkel- en productieomgeving met onder meer .NET, C#, ASP.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, Entity Framework Core, Dapper, RabbitMQ, IIS, REST, GraphQL, Azure Monitor, SonarQube en ArcGIS Server.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Aantoonbare ervaring als data architect in meerdere projecten met complexe data-architectuurproblematiek.
  • Ervaring met het opzetten en uitwerken van datastrategie en data-architectuur.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring in het vertalen van conceptuele informatiemodellen naar logische datamodellen.
  • Ervaring met datastandaarden en data management.
  • Ervaring met programmeertalen en scriptingtalen.
  • Senior ervaring met MS Azure DevOps.
  • Ervaring met MS Fabric.
  • Senior ervaring met Power BI.
  • Ervaring binnen de publieke of overheidssector is een meerwaarde.
  • Algemene kennis van of ervaring met wetgeving en procedures binnen landbouw en mestbeleid is een pluspunt.
  • Nederlandstalig op Europees CEFR-niveau C2.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

jobs.description:
About Nymbus

Nymbus is a high-growth fintech company, ‘Built to Move,’ empowering banks and financial institutions to transform faster, compete smarter, and deliver greater value in today’s digital marketplace. At Nymbus, we’re revolutionizing banking technology. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based solutions help financial institutions modernize, scale, and succeed. As part of our team, you won’t just be part of a tech revolution; you’ll be at the forefront of it, driving innovation and delivering exceptional client experiences.

Nymbus is building the next generation of fintech platforms, and that takes people who are ready to challenge convention, move with purpose, and reimagine what’s possible. We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work, and the value we deliver to our clients.

We want our partners to be thrilled about the possibilities we are creating together and the lasting impact our collaboration will bring to the industry and consumers. The journey to growth begins with doing something different. And that journey starts with the great people who make Nymbus.

We challenge the status quo, question assumptions, and work together to turn bold ideas into meaningful progress.

The Opportunity

Nymbus is seeking a Business Intelligence Architect to lead the data warehouse and reporting transformation for a key financial institution client currently operating on a Microsoft SQL Server data warehouse platform (SQL Server, SSIS, and SSRS). This role will serve as the technical lead guiding the client's migration from its existing Microsoft stack to a modern data platform built on Snowflake (database) and Sigma (analytics and reporting).

The Business Intelligence Architect will maintain and support the client's existing SQL Server-based data warehouse and reporting environment while simultaneously designing, building, and migrating data models, ETL pipelines, and reports to Snowflake and Sigma.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role requiring strong data modeling, database development, and BI/reporting expertise, along with the ability to translate an existing Microsoft-based architecture into an equivalent (and improved) design on the new platform.

You will work both independently and collaboratively with cross-functional partners (including data engineering, product, and client stakeholders) to deliver a well documented, low-disruption transition from the legacy stack to Snowflake and Sigma, while keeping existing reporting and data operations running smoothly throughout the migration.

What You Will Own

Legacy Platform Support & Data Architecture

  • Understand database design methodologies and assist in the design, implementation, and maintenance of data models using data modeling tools (Sparx, Oxygen, Altova, Erwin, etc.).
  • Develop and document ETL data flows using SSIS, PowerShell, PowerPoint, Visio, and T-SQL to support the client's existing SQL Server environment.
  • Use the Microsoft technology stack (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio) to support application and operations systems throughout the transition period.
  • Create new and manage existing reports, dashboards, and agents in the Business Intelligence system (SSRS) to ensure timely and accurate data reporting for use by bank managers for decision-making purposes.

Snowflake & Sigma Migration Leadership

  • Serve as the lead technical architect for converting the client's data warehouse and reporting environment from SQL Server/SSIS/SSRS to Snowflake and Sigma.
  • Design target-state data models in Snowflake that faithfully translate (and where appropriate, improve upon) the client's existing SQL Server schemas and data relationships.
  • Re-engineer existing SSIS-based ETL data flows into Snowflake-native ingestion and transformation pipelines.
  • Rebuild existing SSRS reports and dashboards as equivalent Sigma workbooks and reports, validating parity in logic, output, and accuracy against the legacy versions.
  • Document source-to-target mappings for both data integration and report output (covering mappings from SQL Server to Snowflake and from SSRS to Sigma) in a form that reporting team members and client stakeholders can easily understand.
  • Sequence and coordinate the migration to minimize disruption to the client's ongoing reporting and data operations, including planning cutover phases and parallel-run validation.

Collaboration, Communication & Support

  • Communicate proactively with team members and client stakeholders about potential system issues, migration risk, and status. Support off-hours upgrade and/or migration work when necessary.
  • Actively participate in data and application development peer reviews, interdepartmental requirements-gathering sessions, troubleshooting, and project support.
  • Identify data inconsistencies, anomalies, and scripting issues to support increasing overall system performance through code/script reviews, and develop and implement recommendations accordingly.
  • Ensure end-user issues are identified, tracked, reported on, and resolved in a timely manner.
  • Complete all yearly compliance training and testing, and comply with bank, Federal,and State regulations. Adhere to departmental and bank-wide service standards.

What You Will Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of relevant experience for this role.
  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in a traditional financial institution (bank or credit union).
  • Excellent attention to detail, data accuracy, and quality of output.
  • Proficient in the areas of statistics, finance, and retail and commercial banking business concepts.
  • Passion to self-educate and stay current on the latest analytics and data platform trends in marketing, banking, and other fields, including modern cloud data warehousing and BI tools.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills to articulate effectively in forums and meetings with technical and non-technical teams, and to explain migration decisions and trade-offs clearly to client stakeholders.
  • Ability to provide clear and concise project documentation to various stakeholders, including source-to-target mapping and migration plans.
  • Strong time management skills, with proficiency in prioritizing, scheduling, and managing multiple project schedules and differing levels of criticality across legacy support and migration work.
  • Proficient in the Microsoft Development and Office Suite.
  • Proficient in the areas of application development (programming), database and system/application design. Knowledge of legacy and web-based systems and intrinsic interfaces (WebAPI, TCP, UDP, Database, etc.).
  • Legacy platform: SQL Server; SSIS, SSRS, SSAS.
  • Target platform: Snowflake; Sigma.
  • Visio, Lucid.
  • Data modeling: Sparx, Oxygen, Altova, Erwin, SQL Developer (Oracle), SQL Data Modeler (Oracle).
  • Reporting and Integration frameworks: Sigma, Tableau, Power BI, SSRS, SSIS.
  • Visual Studio VB and/or C# — software development (Web, WinForm, Services, API, WebAPI).

How We Work

Nymbus is a remote-first company. Success in our remote environment requires self-motivation, initiative, and strong personal accountability. Team members are expected to manage their priorities independently, communicate proactively, remain responsive, and participate on camera during virtual meetings.

A strong remote culture requires intentional effort from everyone. We expect team members to engage in our global community, proactively build relationships, participate actively in team and company conversations, seek opportunities to collaborate, and take shared ownership of creating a connected and inclusive remote community including showing up on camera.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base salary range: $135,000 to $150,000 annually
  • Annual cash bonus and equity eligibility, if applicable.
  • Remote Work Environment
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, including HSA/FSA/DCA
  • 401(k) plan
  • Flexible time-off and company holidays
  • Additional paid volunteer day
  • Supplemental Insurance Programs, including voluntary Life, Accident, Critical Illness, Pet Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programs [EAP]
  • Wellness programs
  • Growth and development programs

Actual compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, role scope, and location.

Hiring at Nymbus

As an AI-first company, we embrace the power of AI tools throughout our hiring process. Nymbus remains committed to finding the right match for our teams and candidates alike. While we are excited about the AI tools available to us today, including AI-enabled video interview tools, we remain equally committed to maintaining human involvement and oversight throughout the hiring process.

Nymbus is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Wellspring Worldwide, Inc. is a leading provider of web-based software systems for managing research, technology commercialization, and innovation operations for universities, companies, government agencies, and independent labs. POSITION SUMMARY

We are hiring a Quality Engineer to help shape how quality is engineered in an AI-driven development environment. Quality Engineers at Wellspring operate with a high degree of autonomy and technical ownership, with meaningful cross-team influence. This role is ideal for an engineer who wants to remain hands-on, technically deep, and influential in shaping modern, AI-driven quality practices.

What You'll Do

Automated Quality Engineering

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites using Playwright
  • Develop and maintain performance and load tests using JMeter
  • Create reusable test utilities, data strategies, and scalable testing patterns
  • Build and curate the shared foundation that AI-assisted authoring depends on so generated tests come out consistent
  • Keep the suite healthy as authoring volume increases

AI-Driven Quality Practices

  • Use AI-assisted tools to generate, refine, and maintain test cases, and test data
  • Direct coding agents through the full authoring loop providing context and reviewing output
  • Review generated tests with a critical eye for the ways they fail quietly
  • Use AI to find coverage gaps and propose edge cases, then apply your own judgment about which ones carry real risk
  • Use AI-assisted triage as a first pass on failures, separating likely regressions from flakes
  • Apply self-healing and auto-repair tooling deliberately, with guardrails, recognizing that a test which silently repairs itself can mask a genuine product regression
  • Apply risk-based testing to focus effort on business-critical and defect-prone areas
  • Validate AI-enabled product behavior for correctness, reliability, and unintended outcomes
  • Feed recurring defect and failure patterns back into shared context and conventions so the same class of miss does not recur

CI/CD & Engineering Integration

  • Integrate automated tests into GitHub Actions–based CI/CD pipelines
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to improve pipeline quality gates
  • Manage test scope and execution sequencing to balance coverage, risk, and feedback time
  • Write tests and failure output that are legible to agents as well as engineers
  • Ensure quality gates hold as change volume increases, so higher delivery throughput does not quietly become higher-confidence mistakes

Quality Leadership & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Architecture to clarify requirements and identify quality risks early

  • Document and communicate testing strategies, tradeoffs, and outcomes

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience as a Quality Engineer, SDET, or Test Automation Engineer on production systems
  • Strong hands-on experience with Playwright (UI and API testing)
  • Experience with performance and load testing using JMeter or similar tools
  • Solid programming skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, Java, or Python
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitHub Actions
  • Working knowledge of modern architectures, including web applications, APIs, and cloud-based systems
  • Demonstrated, sustained daily use of at least one modern AI-assisted development tool
  • Ability to critically review AI-generated tests and code — identifying shallow coverage, incorrect assumptions, and plausible-looking output that does not hold up

Ways You'll Stand Out

  • Experience testing AI-enabled or data-driven systems
  • Experience designing automation frameworks or shared testing infrastructure
  • Familiarity with observability, monitoring, or quality metrics beyond pass/fail testing
  • Experience building evaluation harnesses or test strategies for non-deterministic systems
  • Experience structuring context for AI tooling — prompt design, retrieval, or packaging codebase and domain knowledge for code and test generation
  • A point of view on where AI-assisted testing genuinely helps

  • Design metadata-driven frameworks that move thousands of tables through batch, incremental, change data capture (CDC), and streaming patterns.
  • Serve reporting and machine learning workloads through the Synapse Dedicated Pool, Databricks SQL, Power BI, and model training pipelines.

You'll be at the forefront of cloud innovation, working on projects that directly impact people's lives. We offer a high-growth, entrepreneurial environment that values fresh ideas and authentic teamwork.

If you're ready to take your data engineering career to new heights and contribute to meaningful projects that push the boundaries of technology, we want to hear from you. Join BlueFlag and be part of a team that's shaping the future of AI solutions!

Requirements

  • 12+ years in data engineering and data architecture, starting as a hands-on data engineer, with 5+ years as a lead or principal architect
  • Proven leadership of engineering teams, including mentoring senior engineers and setting technical direction
  • A demonstrated history of customer-facing work: leading architecture discussions, briefing executives, and writing for technical and non-technical readers
  • Expert, hands-on cloud data engineering and data warehousing on Azure: Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics (including Synapse Dedicated Pool), Databricks, Delta Lake, and ADLS Gen2

  • Working knowledge of HIPAA, NIST 800-53, and FISMA requirements for PHI and PII
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field.
  • US Citizen: Must be a citizen of the United States
  • Security Clearance: Must be able to obtain a public trust clearance. Must be eligible to work in the United States.

Desired

  • Experience with Databricks SQL, serverless compute, Microsoft Fabric, or Power BI semantic models

jobs.excerpt: We are looking to join a Senior consultant within the Cyber Security Operations Center (CSOC), a globally distributed team of cybersecurity professionals responsible for protecting complex and diverse technology environments.
jobs.description:
We are looking to join a Senior consultant within the Cyber Security Operations Center (CSOC), a globally distributed team of cybersecurity professionals responsible for protecting complex and diverse technology environments.

The role is primarily focused on enhancing threat detection and cybersecurity operations capabilities through activities such as security content management, quality assurance and validation of detection mechanisms, detection use case lifecycle management, onboarding and integration of new security data sources, reporting, and process optimization.

This is an excellent opportunity for professionals interested in working within a large-scale international cybersecurity environment, where they will play a key role in the continuous improvement of security monitoring and threat detection services across multiple customer landscapes. The position combines elements of Security Operations, Threat Detection Engineering, SIEM optimization, cyber risk management, and operational excellence, offering exposure to a wide variety of cybersecurity technologies and challenges.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the development, implementation, validation, tuning, and maintenance of security monitoring, analytics, and detection capabilities across SIEM, EDR, cloud, and other cybersecurity platforms.
  • Support the operation, maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement of security monitoring and threat detection services.
  • Participate in the onboarding, integration, testing, and validation of security data sources, telemetry feeds, and monitoring capabilities.
  • Contribute to security content management activities, including use case lifecycle management, rule reviews, testing, tuning, and content quality assurance.
  • Collaborate with cyber threat intelligence, incident response, and cybersecurity operations teams to translate operational and threat intelligence requirements into effective detection and monitoring capabilities.
  • Under guidance, participate in cybersecurity architecture reviews of new or existing solutions and provide recommendations to enhance security monitoring and detection effectiveness.
  • Contribute to the preparation and maintenance of cybersecurity operations metrics, dashboards, KPIs, and service performance reports.
  • Review, validate, and assess the effectiveness of detections, monitoring configurations, operational processes, and service deliverables, identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Gather and analyze operational feedback to identify opportunities for tuning, optimization, reduction of false positives, and improvement of overall detection quality.
  • Contribute to quality assurance activities, including process reviews, control validation, service quality assessments, and implementation of corrective actions.
  • Support the development, review, and maintenance of CSOC procedures, standards, documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational guidance materials.
  • Prepare and present technical reports, summaries, findings, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.

On-Call Availability (On-Call Shift System)

  • Mandatory 24/7 On-Call Rotation: You will be required to participate in a rotating on-call shift schedule from Monday to Sunday.

  • What this means: This does not mean you will be actively working 24/7 or during late-night shifts. Instead, you will be on standby outside of standard working hours, meaning you must be reachable and available to log in and resolve critical system incidents only if they arise.

  • Frequency: The approximate rotation frequency is one full week (7 consecutive days) every X months, depending on the number of team members

Must have:

  • +5 years of relevant experience in information technology field, including triage of alerts and supporting security incidents
  • Proven experience on administering a SIEM platform, preferably either Splunk or MicrosoftSentinel SIEM
  • Proven experience with the usual toolbox available in a SOC (e.g., SIEMs, EDRs) and being able to autonomously perform technical analysis of security threats and collaborate with Incident Response team
  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Security Tools (e.g. M365, Cloud App Security, Azure,Defender for Endpoints, Azure Security, Azure Sentinel and XDR)
  • Deep Knowledge of Cloud technologies (e.g. Azure, AWS and GCP)
  • Deep knowledge of SIEM tools like Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, MS Sentinel, ELK Stac
  • Knowledge of at least one EDR solution (MS Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike)
  • Knowledge of email security, network monitoring, and incident response
  • Knowledge of Linux/Mac/Windows
  • C1 English proficiency

Nice to have:

  • Experience in building SIEM architectures from initial design to implementation, including designing data ingestion pipelines for diverse log sources across cloud and on-prem environments
  • Proven knowledge of monitoring AWS environment (Iaas, Saas, Paas)
  • Knowledge of at least one general-purpose or shell scripting language (e.g. Ruby, Bash, PowerShell, Python, etc.)

Desirable certifications:

  • MCSE, CCNA, Microsoft Azure (e.g., SC-200), GCIH, CEH, GCFA or any GIAC/similar certification

Required Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication skills
  • Customer-facing experience and oral communication skills
  • Ability to write documentation & reports
  • Creativity/ ability to find innovative solutions
  • Willingness to learn on the job
  • Conflict management & cooperation

What do we offer you?

  • Remote Position
  • Freelance, full-time contract.
  • Training and career development.
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

Не через cheating, а через якісніший і глибший рісьорч, швидшу роботу з великими обсягами інформації та автоматизацію формальних і рутинних задач. Так у студентів і дослідників залишається більше часу на те, що справді має значення — мислення, навчання та власні ідеї.

Основна мета цієї ролі — побудувати engineering-функцію, яка дозволяє JustDone швидко експериментувати й шипити продуктові зміни, водночас зберігаючи стабільність ключових систем.

Сьогодні JustDone це

  • 3+ млн преміум користувачів;
  • #1 позиція в США в ніші AI Writing Assistants;
  • 90%+ одиниць контенту, створених користувачами, знаходять реальне застосування;
  • понад 3 млн одиниць контенту, який генерується користувачами щомісяця;
  • власні AI та NLP рішення: AI Detector, Text Humanization Engines, AI Research Assistant.

Твоє майбутнє середовище

Наша головна перевага — це люди. Ми працюємо з тими, хто щодня прагне до самовдосконалення та задає високу планку гри.

Лідер напрямку — Роман Гмиря, COO. Він цінує відкриту й зрозумілу комунікацію, швидкість у прийнятті рішень та здоровий прагматизм — уміння знаходити рішення, які найкраще працюють для продукту й команди.

Саме в цій ролі ти отримаєш

  • Повний технічний оунершип над продуктом, що вже має трекшн;
  • Сильну команду поруч — працюватимеш з лідерами напрямків: NLP Lead, Lead Product Manager, Lead Product Designer, Lead Product Manager.
  • Прямий вплив на команду з 15 скілових інженерів, архітектуру і стратегію;
  • Філософію та умови для твого постійного росту та розвитку;
  • Великий простір для втілення власних ідей і впливу на продукт.

Твоя зона впливу

  • Переклад бізнес-стратегії у чіткий технічний роадмап і реалізація його у вигляді систем, коду та результатів;
  • Прийняття ключових архітектурних рішень для вебу, native apps (desktop, mobile) та браузерних розширень (React, Next.js, Go, Postgres, AWS, AI-стек);
  • Розвиток AI-native інженерії;
  • Лідерство інженерної команди: код-рев’ю, менторство, допомога в адаптації нових інженерів, допомога в пріоритизації;
  • People management задачі: проведення 1:1, онбординг нових гравців, розробка PDP планів;
  • Побудова ефективної взаємодії з NLP, продуктовою, дизайн-командою та growth-напрямком;
  • Відповідальність за надійність інфраструктури та налаштування DevOps-процесів.

Для цього тобі знадобиться

  • 7+ років технічного досвіду (пріоритет — back-end розробка), з них щонайменше 2 роки у ролі Team Lead / Engineering Manager / Head of Engineering або на співставній позиції.
  • Досвід управління engineering-командами від 10 людей.
  • Сильна технічна база та глибоке розуміння архітектури web і mobile продуктів.
  • Глибокі знання в архітектурі веб та мобільних застосунків: React.js, Web SPA (платформа), Next.js; Go + PostgresDB +AWS + AI стек;
  • Практичний досвід з AI/ML/NLP: впровадження моделей, робота з LLM та інтеграціями через API.
  • Розуміння та практичний досвід із CI/CD, Docker і DevOps practices.
  • Досвід роботи у продуктових компаніях або стартапах, що проходили етап швидкого масштабування.
  • Англійська на рівні B2+.

Твій шлях до команди Boosters

Pre-screen з рекрутером (45 хвилин) → Інтервʼю з СOО → Кейсове інтервʼю з Lead NLP Engineer → Bar-raising (1 година)

Ми пропонуємо

Кар’єрний та персональний розвиток

  • Планові performance review і розробка PDP;
  • Підтримка в розвитку твого персонального бренду в соцмережах Boosters і експертних медіа;
  • Профільні комʼюніті Genesis з безкоштовними курсами і можливістю нетворкінгу;
  • Бюджет на курси, конференції та вивчення англійської;
  • Техніка від компанії та оплата всіх необхідних сервісів для роботи.

Автономію та гнучкість

  • Можливість обирати між роботою в офісі (Київ або Львів) та remote-first форматом (Україна та закордон);

  • 20 дей-офів на рік, вихідні на державні свята та безлімітні лікарняні.

Турботу про здоров’я

  • Медичне страхування;

  • Індивідуальний бенефіт на заняття спортом;

scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and

AI Driven Skills

Character & Mindset

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Builder
jobs.excerpt: Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with.
jobs.description:
Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with. Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.

You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.

Why This Role Exists

We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.

The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.

What You Will Do

  • Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself.
  • Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits.
  • Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten.
  • Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix.
  • Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit.
  • Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted.

Who You Are

  • You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you.
  • High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts.
  • Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you.
  • Fluent with AI. You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully.
  • Care about humans on the other end. Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point.

Your Toolbox

We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week.

What We Expect at This Level

  • 6+ years building production systems. Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained.
  • Real AI experience. You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here.
  • Strong fundamentals. OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher.
  • Cloud comfort. AWS, Azure, or GCP. At least one in depth, the rest enough to hold a conversation.
  • Communication. You can explain a tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder in two minutes and to an engineer in one.

Not Suitable for the Role If…

  • You prefer tickets assigned to you over choosing what to build.
  • You measure your work in lines of code, not outcomes.
  • You see AI as a buzzword to put on your CV rather than a tool you have actually used in anger.
  • You want a process-heavy environment with detailed specs handed down from product.
  • You are looking for a maintenance role on a finished platform.

Why CoverGo

Insurance is the rare industry where AI can save people hours of their worst weeks. We are already shipping AI-powered claims, underwriting, distribution, and document automation to enterprise carriers across five continents. The platform is real. The customers are real. The next chapter is yours to help write.

jobs.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

Where you'll leave your mark?

  • Own quality outcomes, not activities — the question is never "how many test cases did you write this sprint," it's "what quality metric moved and what did you build to move it."
  • Drive CI pass rate to 90%+ and keep it there — the percentage of pipeline runs that pass without manual intervention.
  • Own bug leakage rate — target under 2–3% of bugs escaping QA to staging or production, with a root cause analysis you own for every bug that gets through.
  • Build the system that keeps flaky tests out of the suite — preventing flakiness from entering and quarantining it when it does.
  • Shape automation coverage at the right layer — E2E where it matters, API where it's faster and more reliable, unit where developers should own it — not just chasing a coverage percentage.
  • Stay 50–60% hands-on — writing Playwright TypeScript to evolve the framework, building diagnostic tools that analyse test-run data for flakiness patterns, and reviewing PRs to catch structural problems in AI-generated test code.
  • Build AI-native quality infrastructure — systems that use LLMs, agents, and AI tooling to solve quality problems at scale, like pipelines that auto-analyse every PR for risk across security, product, and UX dimensions.
  • Deliver engineering-wide quality impact — at least one initiative per quarter that changes how developers or PMs ship, not just how QA tests. Our current guardrail system prevents 90 bugs per month without manual QA; that's the bar.
  • Partner and present — sit with product engineers to define quality gates before features ship, and present quality metrics (CI pass rate, bug leakage, flaky test trends) to engineering leadership.

The kind of builder we're looking for -

  • An engineer who has chosen quality as their specialisation — this is not a pure coding role and not a management role; it lives exactly in between (~40–50% strategy, cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring).
  • Engineering-wide in scope, not QA-internal — you want to improve how the entire engineering organisation thinks about quality, not just how the QA team works.
  • AI-native, not AI-assisted — you don't just use Copilot for test authoring; you build quality systems on LLMs and agents, and you can test AI features themselves — validating agent behaviour, checking LLM output quality, and handling non-deterministic systems.
  • A test pyramid thinker, not just an E2E automator — with developers now writing feature automation themselves, you push testing responsibility to the developer layer while QA owns integration, workflow, and AI feature quality. A candidate who only thinks Playwright and E2E is too narrow.
  • Fluent in the modern stack — Playwright, TypeScript, CI pipelines, and the data behind them.
  • Comfortable influencing without authority — defining quality gates with product engineers and changing developer behaviour through systems, not mandates.

How we care for our Sprinters?

  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.


Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

jobs.description:
About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role:

    We're hiring a Staff Data Scientist, Core Revenue Retention to own one outcome — keeping and growing revenue from existing customers — across every team that shapes it. Revenue retention isn't the property of a single product: it spans CPaaS (phone, SMS, email, WhatsApp) as our largest MRR surface, add-on monetization including emerging AI features, the Customer Success motions that protect accounts, and Finance's forecasts.

    This is a broad, cross-functional role. You'll work closely with Communications/CPaaS, Customer Success, the AI teams pursuing add-on revenue, Finance, and other revenue-driving product teams; you report centrally to Product Analytics & Data Science for craft and standards and carry the revenue-retention outcome across organizational boundaries. You'll build the retention/value model, separate real churn signal from data-maturity and mix artifacts, and turn diagnosis into a prioritized, evidence-based retention and add-on-monetization agenda. You'll work amid a data foundation still being built, consuming governed sources rather than rebuilding them, and raising the bar as you go. This is a hands-on, direction-setting Staff role — you advise Customer Success, Finance, and CPaaS leaders and set retention-measurement standards that analysts on adjacent teams adopt, with a path to grow a pod as the mandate scales.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the causal read on core revenue retention and add-on monetization — gross and net revenue retention, MRR churn (voluntary vs involuntary), attach and usage of add-ons — across CPaaS, AI add-ons, and other revenue surfaces
  • Quantify add-on revenue opportunity across CPaaS and emerging AI features, and the drivers behind attach and consumption
  • Apply rigorous causal inference (matching, diff-in-diff, survival/hazard, synthetic control) where clean experiments aren't feasible — separating real signal from selection bias, seasonality, and mix
  • Partner with Finance/RevOps on single-source-of-truth definitions and forecasting inputs; drive the revenue-retention insights
  • Partner with the Product Strategy & Growth org on the TTP/churn charter, and with the Experimentation lead to test retention interventions rigorously
  • Act as a trusted analytical advisor to Customer Success, Finance, and Communications/CPaaS leaders, and set the analytical standards that DS and analysts on adjacent teams adopt — raising the bar without direct authority
  • Set the technical direction for how revenue retention is measured company-wide — own the canonical GRR/NRR, churn, and add-on metrics on governed, certified data that other teams build on; shape the taxonomy retention analytics depends on with Analytics Engineering
  • Build the retention and causal-inference framework — the standards and reusable methods (survival/hazard, diff-in-diff, synthetic control) that Analytics Engineering and adjacent DS teams reuse beyond this mandate
  • Use AI tooling (Claude and similar) to move faster on exploration, documentation, and analysis

Requirements:

  • 9+ years in revenue/retention analytics, data science, or applied statistics, with deep experience on churn, retention, and monetization
  • Practical causal inference with sound judgment about when a result is causal vs. an artifact of how the data was generated
  • Comfort untangling messy financial/billing/usage data and defining metrics that survive scrutiny from Finance and product alike
  • Strong SQL and working proficiency in Python; comfort in a Snowflake + dbt environment
  • Track record where a retention or monetization diagnosis changed a product, pricing, CS, or lifecycle decision
  • Comfort amid imperfect, in-progress data — you consume governed sources and raise the bar rather than rebuilding pipelines
  • Cross-functional influence — you align product, Customer Success, Finance, and leadership on shared numbers without direct authority

Nice to Have:

  • CPaaS (telephony/messaging) or usage-based/consumption revenue experience
  • B2B SaaS or CRM background; experience with MRR/subscription billing, dunning, and involuntary-churn recovery
  • Familiarity with Statsig or a comparable experimentation platform
  • Exposure to AI-assisted analytics workflows; experience mentoring analysts

Success in this role looks like:

  • CPaaS, AI add-ons, and Customer Success act on your model, and drives strong positive business results.
  • Finance/RevOps and Product Analytics report the consistent metrics with clear insight and recommendations.
  • Leaders across the revenue domain make roadmap and spend calls off your analysis, not gut feel
  • The revenue-retention mandate has reusable patterns and the foundation to scale beyond one IC

jobs.title: Director of Strategic Finance
jobs.excerpt: OleOle is seeking a Director of Strategic Finance to build and own the financial model behind a global football platform with multiple interconnected businesses.
jobs.description:
OleOle is seeking a Director of Strategic Finance to build and own the financial model behind a global football platform with multiple interconnected businesses.

This is not a traditional accounting or controllership role. We are looking for someone who can take a complex platform strategy and translate it into a rigorous, investor-grade financial model that demonstrates how OleOle’s businesses develop individually and collectively as the platform scales.

Your first major responsibility will be building the OleOle master financial model. The model will examine the business at approximately 50 million, 100 million and 400 million global users, allowing assumptions around adoption, engagement, transaction volume, pricing, margins and penetration to change dynamically across the ecosystem.

You will build detailed economic models for OleOleSport ticketing, travel and VIP hospitality; Bad Monkey, our planned hybrid fixed-odds and prediction-market gaming business; Mini Programs and third-party commerce; sponsorship and commercial partnerships; and NewZeros, OleOle’s planned financial infrastructure encompassing payments, wallets, transaction processing and exchange capabilities.

NewZeros represents a particularly important long-term opportunity. The model must go beyond conventional exchange economics to examine what happens if OleOle’s financial infrastructure participates in payments and transactions generated throughout an ecosystem serving tens or potentially hundreds of millions of users.

OleOleSport requires a different approach. Because ticketing, travel and hospitality can potentially generate revenue before OleOle develops a large social audience, you will build a detailed bottom-up model for this business and help demonstrate its role as an early commercial engine.

You will also model OleOle’s capital requirements, cash utilization, operating expenses, unit economics, gross margins and long-term profitability. The objective is not to manufacture aggressive revenue projections. It is to create a defensible model in which management and investors can change assumptions and immediately understand their effect on the business.

You will work directly with the Founder & CEO and, as the company grows, with our CFO and business-unit leadership. The financial model you create will become a permanent management and fundraising tool and will evolve as actual operating data replaces assumptions.

Following funding, this role will continue as a senior member of OleOle’s finance organization, owning strategic planning, forecasting, budgeting, business-unit economics, KPI development, scenario analysis and financial reporting while helping build the company’s broader finance function.

We are looking for someone with exceptional financial modeling and analytical ability who understands how to model businesses such as marketplaces, payments, fintech, exchanges, gaming, consumer platforms or other transaction-driven businesses. Experience in investment banking, strategic finance, growth-stage technology, private equity, venture-backed companies or similarly rigorous financial environments would be particularly relevant.

The right person must be comfortable starting with ambiguity. OleOle is creating businesses that do not fit neatly into a conventional SaaS model. You will be expected to understand how each economic engine actually works, challenge assumptions, identify missing variables and construct the financial framework from the ground up.

This is ultimately the person who turns our vision into numbers sophisticated investors can interrogate.

OleOle is currently being built by a team working under deferred compensation while we complete our funding. This is not an unpaid or volunteer position: compensation is agreed upon in writing and accrues during the deferred period, becoming payable following funding. Once funded, this role will transition to a traditional compensation structure including a competitive salary, equity ownership and participation in the OleX token program. We are looking for someone who understands the realities of building an ambitious company before institutional funding and wants to remain with OleOle as the company grows.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in strategic finance, investment banking, private equity, growth equity, corporate development, venture-backed technology, fintech, payments, marketplaces, gaming, exchanges or other transaction-driven businesses.
  • Exceptional financial modeling skills, with demonstrated experience building complex, multi-business operating models from the ground up rather than maintaining models created by others.
  • Experience building integrated financial models encompassing revenue drivers, unit economics, transaction volume, gross margin, operating expenses, cash flow, capital requirements, scenario analysis and long-term profitability.
  • Demonstrated ability to model businesses at significant scale, including scenarios involving tens or hundreds of millions of users, large transaction volumes, multiple geographies and multiple interconnected revenue streams.
  • Deep understanding of payments and financial-network economics, including transaction volume, take rates, basis-point economics, merchant payments, wallets, cross-border transactions, payment-processing costs and network effects.
  • Strong understanding of marketplace and platform economics, including GMV, buyer/seller participation, merchant adoption, transaction frequency, take rates, contribution margins and network effects.
  • Experience with exchange or trading economics, including trading volume, liquidity, spreads, transaction fees and the economics of operating financial marketplaces.
  • Experience with gaming, sports betting or prediction-market economics is highly desirable, particularly an understanding of fixed-odds betting, hold, liquidity, market making, prediction markets, gaming taxes and jurisdiction-specific economics.
  • Experience evaluating or modeling consumer internet/social platforms at substantial scale, including user acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, cohort behavior and monetization.
  • Ability to build sophisticated scenario models in which assumptions can be dynamically changed and flow through individual business units and consolidated company financials.
  • Demonstrated experience producing financial models and investment materials capable of withstanding scrutiny from institutional investors, venture capital firms, private equity firms, investment banks, family offices and sophisticated financial counterparties.
  • Experience supporting significant capital raises, M&A transactions, strategic investments, IPO preparation or institutional financing is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to translate an ambitious strategic vision into measurable financial assumptions without confusing opportunity with forecast. Must be comfortable challenging founders and senior executives when assumptions cannot be financially supported.
  • Strong understanding of three-statement financial modeling, valuation methodologies, discounted cash flow analysis, comparable-company analysis, sensitivity analysis, capital structure and financing scenarios.
  • Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets modeling skills are essential. Experience using SQL, Python, BI platforms, financial planning systems or AI-assisted financial analysis is highly desirable.
  • MBA, CFA, CPA or advanced degree in finance, economics, accounting or a quantitative discipline preferred. Exceptional professional experience may substitute for formal credentials.
  • Previous experience at a leading investment bank, private equity/growth equity firm, major fintech/payments company, global technology platform or highly successful venture-backed company would be particularly attractive.
  • Experience working internationally and modeling businesses across multiple currencies, regulatory environments and geographic markets is strongly preferred.
  • Must be capable of working directly with the Founder & CEO and senior technical/product leadership in an early-stage environment where significant portions of the business are still being designed.
  • Must be willing to personally build the model. This is not a role for someone who has reached the point in their career where all detailed financial analysis is delegated to analysts.

Solutions not problems .

  • Creative problem solver who can courageously propose and support new ideas to our organization. Not interested in best practices, lets build something better!
  • Ability to adapt. An ideal candidate will welcome the opportunity to solve a broad range of problems using a wide array of technologies.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities and general growing pains of an early-stage technology company
  • An exceptional entrepreneurial judgment that fosters independence over micro-management
  • Understanding of football and international sports a huge plus

Ole Ole is located in beautiful Austin Texas, however, this role requires some travel we are privately held and rapidly growing!

OleOle is building a global social, messaging and commerce platform designed specifically for the more than three billion football fans around the world.

The platform brings together social media, short-form video, encrypted messaging and calling, live scores, real-time translation and football content within a single global ecosystem. Our goal is to connect fans across clubs, countries and languages while creating an infrastructure that extends well beyond social media.

Every OleOle user receives a persistent Wallet ID that connects their identity across the ecosystem. Over time, OleOle will integrate payments, commerce, Mini Programs, ticketing and travel, gaming, digital assets and financial services. Mini Programs will allow clubs, brands, merchants and third-party developers to build services directly within OleOle, using the platform’s identity, social and payment infrastructure.

OleOleSport, our ticketing and travel business, provides an important early commercial opportunity through tickets, VIP hospitality and travel experiences around major sporting events. As the OleOle audience grows, additional businesses are designed to scale alongside it, including Mini Programs, payments, gaming and NewZeros, our planned financial infrastructure combining exchange capabilities with a broader payments and transaction network.

We are currently a team of approximately 20 people building across backend infrastructure, social, video, messaging, AI and translation, payments, football data, product and design.

OleOle is being built around a long-term thesis: football is the world’s largest shared passion, yet its global audience remains fragmented across social networks, messaging applications, sports platforms and commerce providers. We believe there is an opportunity to bring those experiences together in one global platform and build significant businesses around the resulting network.

OleOle — Where Fans Kick Off.
